{"content":"1: name: win-test
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_call:
5:     inputs:
6:       build-environment:
7:         required: true
8:         type: string
9:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
10:       cuda-version:
11:         required: true
12:         type: string
13:         description: What CUDA version to build with, "cpu" for none.
14:       test-matrix:
15:         required: true
16:         type: string
17:         description: JSON description of what test configs to run.
18:       sync-tag:
19:         required: false
20:         type: string
21:         default: ""
22:         description: |
23:           If this is set, our linter will use this to make sure that every other
24:           job with the same `sync-tag` is identical.
25:       timeout-minutes:
26:         required: false
27:         type: number
28:         default: 240
29:         description: |
30:           Set the maximum (in minutes) how long the workflow should take to finish
31:       disable-monitor:
32:         description: |
33:           [Experimental] Disable utilization monitoring for tests.
34:           Currently, by default we disable the monitor job and only look for specific tests,
35:           since we are investigating the behaviour of the monitor script with different tests.
36:         required: false
37:         type: boolean
38:         default: true
39:       monitor-log-interval:
40:         description: |
41:           Set the interval for the monitor script to log utilization.
42:         required: false
43:         type: number
44:         default: 5
45:       monitor-data-collect-interval:
46:         description: |
47:           Set the interval for the monitor script to collect data.
48:         required: false
49:         type: number
50:         default: 1
51: env:
52:   GIT_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
53: 
54: jobs:
55:   test:
56:     # Don't run on forked repos or empty test matrix
57:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch' && toJSON(fromJSON(inputs.test-matrix).include) != '[]'
58:     strategy:
59:       matrix: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.test-matrix) }}
60:       fail-fast: false
61:     runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
62:     timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check == 'mem_leak_check' && 600 || inputs.timeout-minutes }}
63:     defaults:
64:       run:
65:         shell: bash
66:     steps:
67:       # Duplicated in win-build because this MUST go before a checkout
68:       - name: Enable git long paths and symlinks on Windows and disable fsmonitor daemon
69:         shell: bash
70:         run: |
71:           git config --global core.longpaths true
72:           git config --global core.symlinks true
73:           git config --global core.ignorecase false
74: 
75:           # https://git-scm.com/docs/git-fsmonitor--daemon.  The daemon could lock
76:           # the directory on Windows and prevent GHA from checking out as reported
77:           # in https://github.com/actions/checkout/issues/1018
78:           git config --global core.fsmonitor false
79: 
80:       - name: Setup SSH (Click me for login details)
81:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-ssh@main
82:         with:
83:           github-secret: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
84:           instructions: |
85:             To forward remote desktop on your local machine ssh as follows:
86:               ssh -L 3389:localhost:3389 %%username%%@%%hostname%%
87:             And then change password using `passwd` command.
88: 
89:             To start tests locally, change working folder to \actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\test,
90:             Activate miniconda and Visual Studio environment and set PYTHON_PATH, by running:
91:               call C:\Jenkins\Miniconda3\Scripts\activate.bat C:\Jenkins\Miniconda3
92:               call "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x64
93:               set PYTHONPATH=C:\actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\build\win_tmp\build
94: 
95:       # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
96:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
97:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
98:         with:
99:           no-sudo: true
100: 
101:       - name: Setup Windows
102:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-win
103:         with:
104:           cuda-version: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
105: 
106:       - name: Get workflow job id
107:         id: get-job-id
108:         uses: ./.github/actions/get-workflow-job-id
109:         if: always()
110:         with:
111:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
112: 
113:       - name: Start monitoring script
114:         id: monitor-script
115:         env:
116:           JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
117:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
118:           WORKFLOW_NAME: ${{ github.workflow }}
119:           WORKFLOW_RUN_ID: ${{github.run_id}}
120:           MONITOR_LOG_INTERVAL: ${{ inputs.monitor-log-interval }}
121:           MONITOR_DATA_COLLECT_INTERVAL: ${{ inputs.monitor-data-collect-interval }}
122:         shell: bash
123:         if: ${{ !inputs.disable-monitor }}
124:         continue-on-error: true
125:         run: |
126:           # Windows conda doesn't have python3 binary, only python, but it's python3
127:           ${CONDA_RUN} python -m pip install psutil==5.9.8 dataclasses_json==0.6.7 nvidia-ml-py==11.525.84
128:           ${CONDA_RUN} python -m tools.stats.monitor --log-interval "$MONITOR_LOG_INTERVAL" --data-collect-interval "$MONITOR_DATA_COLLECT_INTERVAL" > usage_log.txt 2>&1 &
129:           echo "monitor-script-pid=${!}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
130: 
131:       - name: Download PyTorch Build Artifacts
132:         uses: seemethere/download-artifact-s3@1da556a7aa0a088e3153970611f6c432d58e80e6 # v4.2.0
133:         with:
134:           name: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
135:           path: C:\${{ github.run_id }}\build-results
136: 
137:       - name: Check build-results folder
138:         shell: powershell
139:         run: |
140:           tree /F C:\$Env:GITHUB_RUN_ID\build-results
141: 
142:       - name: Download TD artifacts
143:         continue-on-error: true
144:         uses: ./.github/actions/download-td-artifacts
145: 
146:       - name: Check for keep-going label and re-enabled test issues
147:         # This uses the filter-test-configs action because it conveniently
148:         # checks for labels and re-enabled test issues.  It does not actually do
149:         # any filtering.  All filtering is done in the build step.
150:         id: keep-going
151:         uses: ./.github/actions/filter-test-configs
152:         with:
153:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
154:           test-matrix: ${{ inputs.test-matrix }}
155:           job-name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
156: 
157:       - name: Set Test step time
158:         id: test-timeout
159:         shell: bash
160:         env:
161:           JOB_TIMEOUT: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check == 'mem_leak_check' && 600 || inputs.timeout-minutes }}
162:         run: |
163:           echo "timeout=$((JOB_TIMEOUT-30))" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
164: 
165:       - name: Test
166:         id: test
167:         shell: bash
168:         timeout-minutes: ${{ fromJson(steps.test-timeout.outputs.timeout) }}
169:         env:
170:           USE_CUDA: ${{ inputs.cuda-version != 'cpu' && '1' || '0' }}
171:           INSTALL_WINDOWS_SDK: 1
172:           PYTHON_VERSION: "3.10"
173:           CONTINUE_THROUGH_ERROR: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.keep-going }}
174:           VERBOSE_TEST_LOGS: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-verbose-test-logs }}
175:           TEST_SHOWLOCALS: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-test-showlocals }}
176:           NO_TEST_TIMEOUT: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-no-test-timeout }}
177:           NO_TD: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-no-td }}
178:           VC_PRODUCT: "BuildTools"
179:           VC_VERSION: ""
180:           VS_VERSION: "17.4.1"
181:           VC_YEAR: "2022"
182:           AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1
183:           PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
184:           GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
185:           GITHUB_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}
186:           GITHUB_JOB: ${{ github.job }}
187:           GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
188:           GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
189:           GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
190:           JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
191:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
192:           SHA1: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
193:           CUDA_VERSION: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
194:           PYTORCH_FINAL_PACKAGE_DIR: /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results/
195:           BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
196:           ALPINE_IMAGE: "308535385114.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/tool/alpine"
197:           SHARD_NUMBER: ${{ matrix.shard }}
198:           NUM_TEST_SHARDS: ${{ matrix.num_shards }}
199:           TEST_CONFIG: ${{ matrix.config }}
200:           REENABLED_ISSUES: ${{ github.event.pull_request.reenabled-issues }}
201:           TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "8.6"
202:           PYTORCH_TEST_CUDA_MEM_LEAK_CHECK: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check && '1' || '0' }}
203:           PYTORCH_TEST_RERUN_DISABLED_TESTS: ${{ matrix.rerun_disabled_tests && '1' || '0' }}
204:         run: |
205:           pushd "${PYTORCH_FINAL_PACKAGE_DIR}"
206:           # shellcheck disable=SC2046,SC2102
207:           python3 -mpip install $(echo *.whl)[opt-einsum,optree] optree==0.13.0
208:           popd
209: 
210:           .ci/pytorch/win-test.sh
211: 
212:       - name: Upload pytest cache if tests failed
213:         uses: ./.github/actions/pytest-cache-upload
214:         continue-on-error: true

216:         with:
217:           cache_dir: .pytest_cache
218:           shard: ${{ matrix.shard }}
219:           sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
220:           test_config: ${{ matrix.config }}
221:           job_identifier: ${{ github.workflow }}_${{ inputs.build-environment }}
222: 
223:       - name: Print remaining test logs
224:         shell: bash
225:         if: always() && steps.test.conclusion
226:         run: |
227:           cat test/**/*_toprint.log || true
228: 
229:       - name: Stop monitoring script
230:         if: ${{ always() && steps.monitor-script.outputs.monitor-script-pid }}
231:         shell: bash
232:         continue-on-error: true
233:         env:
234:           MONITOR_SCRIPT_PID: ${{ steps.monitor-script.outputs.monitor-script-pid }}

236:           kill "$MONITOR_SCRIPT_PID"
237: 
238:       - name: Upload test artifacts
239:         uses: ./.github/actions/upload-test-artifacts
240:         if: always() && steps.test.conclusion && steps.test.conclusion != 'skipped'
241:         with:
242:           file-suffix: ${{ github.job }}-${{ matrix.config }}-${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ matrix.num_shards }}-${{ matrix.runner }}_${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
243:

246:         continue-on-error: true
247:         uses: ./.github/actions/upload-utilization-stats

249:           job_id: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
250:           job_name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}

158:       - name: Check for keep-going label and re-enabled test issues

177:       - name: Test
178:         id: test
179:         env:

189:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
190:           BRANCH: ${{ steps.parse-ref.outputs.branch }}

196:           VERBOSE_TEST_LOGS: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-verbose-test-logs }}
197:           NO_TEST_TIMEOUT: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-no-test-timeout }}
198:           NO_TD: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-no-td }}
199:           TEST_CONFIG: ${{ matrix.config }}
200:           SHARD_NUMBER: ${{ matrix.shard }}
201:           NUM_TEST_SHARDS: ${{ matrix.num_shards }}
202:           REENABLED_ISSUES: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.reenabled-issues }}
203:           DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.docker-image }}

208:           DASHBOARD_TAG: ${{ inputs.dashboard-tag }}
209:           HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN }}
210:         timeout-minutes: ${{ fromJson(steps.test-timeout.outputs.timeout) }}
211:         run: |
212:           # Fetch aws credential from IMDs

218:           # detached container should get cleaned up by teardown_ec2_linux

276:           )

279:           # jenkins user does not have write permission to mounted workspace; work-around by copying within container to jenkins home

{"content":"1: name: Lint
2: # Workflow that runs lint checks and also unittests for tools, and scripts.
3: 
4: on:
5:   pull_request:
6:     branches-ignore:
7:       - nightly
8:   push:
9:     branches:
10:       - main
11:       - release/*
12:       - landchecks/*
13:     tags:
14:       - ciflow/pull/*
15:       - ciflow/trunk/*
16:   workflow_dispatch:
17: 
18: permissions: read-all
19: # The names of steps that actually test the code should be suffixed with `(nonretryable)`.
20: # When any other step fails, it's job will be retried once by retryBot.
21: jobs:
22:   get-label-type:
23:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
24:     name: get-label-type
25:     uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/workflows/_runner-determinator.yml@main
26:     with:
27:       triggering_actor: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
28:       issue_owner: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login || github.event.issue.user.login }}
29:       curr_branch: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
30: 
31:   get-changed-files:
32:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
33:     name: Get changed files
34:     uses: ./.github/workflows/_get-changed-files.yml
35:     with:
36:       all_files: ${{ contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'lint-all-files') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'Reverted') || github.event_name == 'push' }}
37: 
38:   lintrunner-clang:
39:     uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
40:     # Needed to prevent deduping on HUD
41:     name: lintrunner-clang-${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files == '*' && 'all' || 'partial' }}
42:     needs: [get-label-type, get-changed-files]
43:     # Only run if there are changed files relevant to clangtidy / clangformat
44:     if: |
45:       github.repository_owner == 'pytorch' && (
46:         needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files == '*' ||
47:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.h') ||
48:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cpp') ||
49:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cc') ||
50:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cxx') ||
51:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.hpp') ||
52:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.hxx') ||
53:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cu') ||
54:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cuh') ||
55:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.mm') ||
56:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.metal')
57:       )
58:     with:
59:       timeout: 120
60:       runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
61:       docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-cuda12.8-cudnn9-py3.10-linter
62:       # NB: A shallow checkout won't work here because calculate-docker-image requires a full checkout
63:       # to run git rev-parse HEAD~:.ci/docker when a new image is needed
64:       fetch-depth: 0
65:       submodules: true
66:       ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
67:       script: |
68:         CHANGED_FILES="${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files }}"
69:         if [ "$CHANGED_FILES" = "*" ]; then
70:           export ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--take CLANGTIDY,CLANGFORMAT --all-files"
71:         else
72:           export ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--take CLANGTIDY,CLANGFORMAT $CHANGED_FILES"
73:         fi
74:         export CLANG=1
75:         .github/scripts/lintrunner.sh
76: 
77:   # NOTE: mypy needs its own job because it depends on --all-files, without assessing all files it sometimes
78:   #       fails to find types when it should
79:   # NOTE: We should be able to disable this and consolidate with Pyrefly
80:   lintrunner-pyrefly:
81:     uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
82:     name: lintrunner-pyrefly-${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files == '*' && 'all' || 'partial' }}
83:     needs: [get-label-type, get-changed-files]
84:     # Only run if there are changed files relevant to pyrefly
85:     if: |
86:       github.repository_owner == 'pytorch' && (
87:         needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files == '*' ||
88:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.py') ||
89:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.pyi')
90:       )
91:     with:
92:       timeout: 120
93:       runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
94:       docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-linter
95:       # NB: A shallow checkout won't work here because calculate-docker-image requires a full checkout
96:       # to run git rev-parse HEAD~:.ci/docker when a new image is needed
97:       fetch-depth: 0
98:       submodules: true
99:       ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
100:       script: |
101:         CHANGED_FILES="${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files }}"
102:         echo "Running pyrefly"
103:         ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--take PYREFLY --all-files" .github/scripts/lintrunner.sh
104: 
105:   lintrunner-noclang:
106:     uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
107:     name: lintrunner-noclang-${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files == '*' && 'all' || 'partial' }}
108:     needs: [get-label-type, get-changed-files]
109:     with:
110:       timeout: 120
111:       runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
112:       docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-linter
113:       # NB: A shallow checkout won't work here because calculate-docker-image requires a full checkout
114:       # to run git rev-parse HEAD~:.ci/docker when a new image is needed
115:       fetch-depth: 0
116:       submodules: true
117:       ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
118:       script: |
119:         CHANGED_FILES="${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files }}"
120:         echo "Running all other linters"
121:         if [ "$CHANGED_FILES" = '*' ]; then
122:           ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--skip CLANGTIDY,CLANGTIDY_EXECUTORCH_COMPATIBILITY,CLANGFORMAT,PYREFLY --all-files" .github/scripts/lintrunner.sh
123:         else
124:           ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--skip CLANGTIDY,CLANGTIDY_EXECUTORCH_COMPATIBILITY,CLANGFORMAT,PYREFLY ${CHANGED_FILES}" .github/scripts/lintrunner.sh
125:         fi
126: 
127:   quick-checks:
128:     uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
129:     needs: get-label-type
130:     with:
131:       timeout: 120
132:       runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
133:       docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-linter
134:       fetch-depth: 0
135:       ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
136:       script: |
137:         # Ensure no non-breaking spaces
138:         # NB: We use 'printf' below rather than '\u000a' since bash pre-4.2
139:         # does not support the '\u000a' syntax (which is relevant for local linters)
140:         (! git --no-pager grep -In "$(printf '\xC2\xA0')" -- . || (echo "The above lines have non-breaking spaces (U+00A0); please convert them to spaces (U+0020)"; false))
141: 
142:         # Ensure cross-OS compatible file names
143:         (! git ls-files | grep -E '([<>:"|?*]|[ .]$)' || (echo "The above file names are not valid across all operating systems. Please ensure they don't contain the characters '<>:""|?*' and don't end with a white space or a '.' "; false))
144: 
145:         # Ensure no versionless Python shebangs
146:         (! git --no-pager grep -In '#!.*python$' -- . || (echo "The above lines have versionless Python shebangs; please specify either python2 or python3"; false))
147: 
148:         # Ensure ciflow tags mentioned in config
149:         python3 .github/scripts/collect_ciflow_labels.py --validate-tags
150: 
151:         # C++ docs check
152:         pushd docs/cpp/source
153:         ./check-doxygen.sh
154:         popd
155: 
156:         # CUDA kernel launch check
157:         set -eux
158:         python3 torch/testing/_internal/check_kernel_launches.py |& tee cuda_kernel_launch_checks.txt
159: 
160:   pr-sanity-checks:
161:     name: pr-sanity-checks
162:     needs: get-label-type
163:     runs-on: [self-hosted, "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.large"]
164:     # Only run this on pull requests. This check is simple enough to be done without a Docker image
165:     if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && !contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'skip-pr-sanity-checks')
166:     steps:
167:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
168:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
169:         with:
170:           submodules: false
171:           fetch-depth: -1
172: 
173:       - name: PR size check (nonretryable)
174:         env:
175:           BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
176:           HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
177:         run: |
178:           bash .github/scripts/pr-sanity-check.sh
179: 
180:   workflow-checks:
181:     uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
182:     needs: get-label-type
183:     with:
184:       timeout: 120
185:       runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
186:       docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-linter
187:       fetch-depth: -1
188:       submodules: true
189:       ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
190:       script: |
191:         # Regenerate workflows
192:         .github/scripts/generate_ci_workflows.py
193: 
194:         RC=0
195:         # Assert that regenerating the workflows didn't change them
196:         if ! .github/scripts/report_git_status.sh .github/workflows; then
197:           echo
198:           echo 'As shown by the above diff, the committed .github/workflows'
199:           echo 'are not up to date according to .github/templates.'
200:           echo 'Please run this command, commit, and push again to your PR:'
201:           echo
202:           echo '    .github/scripts/generate_ci_workflows.py'
203:           echo
204:           echo 'If running that command does nothing, you may need to rebase'
205:           echo 'onto a more recent commit from the PyTorch main branch.'
206:           RC=1
207:         fi
208: 
209:         # Check that jobs will be cancelled
210:         .github/scripts/ensure_actions_will_cancel.py
211: 
212:         exit $RC
213: 
214:   toc:
215:     uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
216:     needs: get-label-type
217:     with:
218:       timeout: 120
219:       runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
220:       docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-linter
221:       fetch-depth: 0
222:       ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
223:       script: |
224:         # Regenerate ToCs and check that they didn't change
225:         set -eu
226: 
227:         export PATH=~/.npm-global/bin:"$PATH"
228:         for FILE in $(git grep -Il '<!-- toc -->' -- '**.md'); do
229:           markdown-toc --bullets='-' -i "$FILE"
230:         done
231: 
232:         if ! .github/scripts/report_git_status.sh .; then
233:           echo
234:           echo 'As shown by the above diff, the table of contents in one or'
235:           echo 'more Markdown files is not up to date with the file contents.'
236:           echo 'You can either apply that Git diff directly to correct the'
237:           echo 'table of contents, or if you have npm installed, you can'
238:           echo 'install the npm package markdown-toc and run the following'
239:           # shellcheck disable=SC2016
240:           echo 'command (replacing $FILE with the filename for which you want'
241:           echo 'to regenerate the table of contents):'
242:           echo
243:           # shellcheck disable=SC2016
244:           echo "    markdown-toc --bullets='-' -i \"\$FILE\""
245:           false
246:         fi
247: 
248:   test-tools:
249:     name: Test tools
250:     if: ${{ github.repository == 'pytorch/pytorch' }}
251:     uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
252:     needs: get-label-type
253:     with:
254:       timeout: 120
255:       runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
256:       docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-linter
257:       fetch-depth: 0
258:       ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
259:       script: |
260:         # Test tools
261:         PYTHONPATH=$(pwd) pytest tools/stats

{"content":"1: name: Update viable/strict
2: 
3: on:
4:   schedule:
5:     - cron: 17,47 * * * *
6:   workflow_dispatch:
7: 
8: concurrency:
9:   group: ${{ github.workflow }}
10:   cancel-in-progress: true
11: 
12: jobs:
13:   do_update_viablestrict:
14:     permissions:
15:       id-token: write
16:     if: ${{ github.repository_owner == 'pytorch' }}
17:     runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
18:     environment: ${{ (github.event_name == 'schedule') && 'mergebot' || '' }}
19:     steps:
20:       - name: Update viable/strict
21:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/update-viablestrict@main
22:         id: update_viablestrict
23:         with:
24:           repository: pytorch/pytorch
25:           stable-branch: viable/strict
26:           requires: '[\"pull\", \"trunk\", \"lint\",  \"linux-aarch64\"]'
27:           secret-bot-token: ${{ secrets.MERGEBOT_TOKEN }}
28:           clickhouse-url: ${{ secrets.CLICKHOUSE_URL }}
29:           clickhouse-username: ${{ secrets.CLICKHOUSE_VIABLESTRICT_USERNAME }}
30:           clickhouse-password: ${{ secrets.CLICKHOUSE_VIABLESTRICT_PASSWORD }}
31: 
32:       - name: Authenticate to AWS with OIDC
33:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0
34:         with:
35:           role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::308535385114:role/upload_to_ossci_raw_job_status
36:           aws-region: us-east-1
37: 
38:       - name: Print sha
39:         env:
40:           LATEST_SHA: ${{ steps.update_viablestrict.outputs.latest_viable_sha }}
41:           PUSH_RESULT: ${{ steps.update_viablestrict.outputs.push_result }}
42:           TIME: ${{ steps.update_viablestrict.outputs.time }}
43:         run: |
44:           echo "${PUSH_RESULT}"
45:           if [ "$PUSH_RESULT" = "Everything up-to-date" ]; then
46:             echo "No update pushed"
47:           elif [ "${LATEST_SHA}" == "None" ]; then
48:             echo "No viable/strict candidate found"
49:           else
50:             echo "{\"sha\": \"${LATEST_SHA}\", \"repository\":\"pytorch/pytorch\", \"timestamp\": ${TIME}}" > "/tmp/${LATEST_SHA}.json"
51:             pip install awscli==1.29.40
52:             aws s3 cp "/tmp/${LATEST_SHA}.json" "s3://ossci-raw-job-status/stable_pushes/pytorch/pytorch/${LATEST_SHA}.json"
53:             # Push new viable/strict tag
54:             cd pytorch/pytorch
55:             git push origin "${LATEST_SHA}:refs/tags/viable/strict/${TIME}"
56:           fi
57: ","url":"https://sourcegraph.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/pytorch--863edc78@76b8fdafad537579cd97b5ec2502c6ac3bc473e0/-/blob/.github/workflows/update-viablestrict.yml"}

{"content":"1: name: Upload test stats
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_run:
5:     workflows:
6:       - pull
7:       - trunk
8:       - trunk-rocm-mi300
9:       - periodic
10:       - periodic-rocm-mi200
11:       - periodic-rocm-mi300
12:       - inductor
13:       - unstable
14:       - slow
15:       - slow-rocm-mi200
16:       - unstable-periodic
17:       - inductor-periodic
18:       - rocm-mi200
19:       - rocm-mi300
20:       - rocm-mi355
21:       - rocm-navi31
22:       - inductor-micro-benchmark
23:       - inductor-micro-benchmark-x86
24:       - inductor-cu124
25:       - inductor-rocm-mi200
26:       - inductor-rocm-mi300
27:       - mac-mps
28:       - linux-aarch64
29:     types:
30:       - completed
31: 
32: jobs:
33:   # the conclusion field in the github context is sometimes null
34:   # solution adapted from https://github.com/community/community/discussions/21090#discussioncomment-3226271
35:   get_workflow_conclusion:
36:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
37:     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
38:     outputs:
39:       conclusion: ${{ fromJson(steps.get_conclusion.outputs.data).conclusion }}
40:     steps:
41:       - name: Get workflow run conclusion
42:         # TODO (huydhn): Pin this once https://github.com/octokit/request-action/issues/315 is resolved
43:         uses: octokit/request-action@05a2312de9f8207044c4c9e41fe19703986acc13 # v2.x
44:         id: get_conclusion
45:         with:
46:           route: GET /repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}/attempts/${{ github.event.workflow_run.run_attempt }}
47:         env:
48:           GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
49: 
50:   upload-test-stats:
51:     needs: get_workflow_conclusion
52:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
53:     runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
54:     environment: upload-stats
55:     permissions:
56:       id-token: write
57:     name: Upload test stats for ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}, attempt ${{ github.event.workflow_run.run_attempt }}
58:     steps:
59:       - name: Print workflow information
60:         env:
61:           TRIGGERING_WORKFLOW: ${{ toJSON(github.event.workflow_run) }}
62:         run: echo "${TRIGGERING_WORKFLOW}"
63: 
64:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
65:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
66: 
67:       - name: Configure aws credentials
68:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0
69:         continue-on-error: true
70:         with:
71:           role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::308535385114:role/gha_workflow_upload-torch-test-stats
72:           aws-region: us-east-1
73: 
74:       - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5.6.0
75:         with:
76:           python-version: '3.11'
77:           cache: pip
78: 
79:       - run: |
80:           pip3 install requests==2.32.2 boto3==1.35.42
81: 
82:       - name: Upload test artifacts
83:         id: upload-s3
84:         env:
85:           GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
86:           WORKFLOW_ARTIFACTS_URL: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.artifacts_url }}
87:           WORKFLOW_RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
88:           WORKFLOW_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.run_attempt }}
89:           REPO_FULLNAME: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.repository.full_name }}
90:         run: |
91:           echo "${WORKFLOW_ARTIFACTS_URL}"
92: 
93:           # Note that in the case of Linux and Windows, their artifacts have already been uploaded to S3, so there simply won't be
94:           # anything on GitHub to upload. The command should return right away
95:           python3 -m tools.stats.upload_artifacts --workflow-run-id "${WORKFLOW_RUN_ID}" --workflow-run-attempt "${WORKFLOW_RUN_ATTEMPT}" --repo "${REPO_FULLNAME}"
96: 
97:       - name: Upload test stats
98:         env:
99:           GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
100:           WORKFLOW_RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
101:           WORKFLOW_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.run_attempt }}
102:           WORKFLOW_URL: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.html_url }}
103:           HEAD_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name }}
104:           HEAD_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch }}
105:         run: |
106:           echo "${WORKFLOW_URL}"
107:           python3 -m tools.stats.upload_test_stats --workflow-run-id "${WORKFLOW_RUN_ID}" --workflow-run-attempt "${WORKFLOW_RUN_ATTEMPT}" --head-branch "${HEAD_BRANCH}" --head-repository "${HEAD_REPOSITORY}"
108:           python3 -m tools.stats.upload_sccache_stats --workflow-run-id "${WORKFLOW_RUN_ID}" --workflow-run-attempt "${WORKFLOW_RUN_ATTEMPT}"
109: 
110:       - name: Analyze disabled tests rerun
111:         env:
112:           GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
113:           WORKFLOW_ARTIFACTS_URL: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.artifacts_url }}
114:           WORKFLOW_RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
115:           WORKFLOW_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.run_attempt }}
116:           REPO_FULLNAME: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.repository.full_name }}
117:         run: |
118:           # Analyze the results from disable tests rerun and upload them to S3
119:           python3 -m tools.stats.check_disabled_tests --workflow-run-id "${WORKFLOW_RUN_ID}" --workflow-run-attempt "${WORKFLOW_RUN_ATTEMPT}" --repo "${REPO_FULLNAME}"
120: 
121:       - name: Upload gpt-fast benchmark results to s3
122:         if: steps.upload-s3.outcome && steps.upload-s3.outcome == 'success' && contains(github.event.workflow_run.name, 'inductor-micro-benchmark')
123:         env:
124:           WORKFLOW_RUN_ID: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
125:           WORKFLOW_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.run_attempt }}
126:           REPO_FULLNAME: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.repository.full_name }}

   The task is to implement the PyTorch 2.10 release branch CI/CD configuration update (equivalent to PR #170112 / commit `7cd90e5e9a5553aacc155e17e2bde3ccfa9b002d`). This involves updating approximately 110 files across `.github/workflows/`, `.github/templates/`, `.github/scripts/`, `.github/ci_commit_pins/`, `.ci/pytorch/`, and `tools/stats/` to pin all `@main` references to `@release/2.10`. The scoring formula is `0.35 * file_recall + 0.45 * line_recall + 0.20 * line_precision`, requiring accurate reproduction of the ground-truth diff from the release commit. The strategy is to write "before" files from the pre-release commit, make a git commit, then apply forward transformations so the git diff matches the ground truth.

239:           set -x
240:           mkdir -p artifacts/
241:           container_name=$(docker run \
242:             -e BINARY_ENV_FILE \
243:             -e BUILD_ENVIRONMENT \
244:             -e DESIRED_CUDA \
245:             -e DESIRED_PYTHON \
246:             -e GITHUB_ACTIONS \

253:             -e SKIP_ALL_TESTS \
254:             -e PYTORCH_EXTRA_INSTALL_REQUIREMENTS \
255:             --tty \
256:             --detach \
257:             -v "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/pytorch:/pytorch" \
258:             -v "${RUNNER_TEMP}/artifacts:/artifacts" \
259:             -w / \
260:             "${DOCKER_IMAGE}"
261:           )
262:           docker exec -t -w "${PYTORCH_ROOT}" "${container_name}" bash -c "bash .circleci/scripts/binary_populate_env.sh"

264:           docker exec -t "${container_name}" bash -c "source ${BINARY_ENV_FILE} && bash /pytorch/.ci/${{ inputs.PACKAGE_TYPE }}/build.sh"
265: 
266:       - name: Chown artifacts
267:         if: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' && inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel' }}
268:         shell: bash
269:         run: |

275:         with:
276:           name: ${{ inputs.build_name }}
277:           if-no-files-found: error
278:           path:
279:             ${{ runner.temp }}/artifacts/*
280: 
281:       - name: Teardown Linux
282:         if: always() && inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
283:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/teardown-linux@main
284: 
285:       - name: Chown workspace
286:         if: always() && inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
287:         uses: ./pytorch/.github/actions/chown-workspace
288:         with:
289:           ALPINE_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.ALPINE_IMAGE }}
290: 
291:       - name: Cleanup docker
292:         if: always() && inputs.build_environment == 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
293:         shell: bash
294:         run: |
295:           # on s390x stop the container for clean worker stop
296:           # ignore expansion of "docker ps -q" since it could be empty
297:           # shellcheck disable=SC2046
298:           docker stop $(docker ps -q) || true

15:         required: false

{"content":"1: name: build docs
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_call:
5:     inputs:
6:       build-environment:
7:         required: true
8:         type: string
9:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
10:       docker-image:
11:         required: true
12:         type: string
13:         description: Docker image to run in.
14:       push:
15:         required: false
16:         type: boolean
17:         default: false
18:         description: If set, push the docs to the docs website.
19:       run-doxygen:
20:         required: false
21:         type: boolean
22:         default: false
23:         description: If set, will enable C++ API doc generation using doxygen / breathe / exhale.
24:       sync-tag:
25:         required: false
26:         type: string
27:         default: ""
28:         description: |
29:           If this is set, our linter will use this to make sure that every other
30:           job with the same `sync-tag` is identical.
31:       s3-bucket:
32:         description: S3 bucket to download artifact
33:         required: false
34:         type: string
35:         default: "gha-artifacts"
36:       aws-role-to-assume:
37:         description: role to assume for downloading artifacts
38:         required: false
39:         type: string
40:         default: ""
41:       upload-aws-role-to-assume:
42:         description: role to assume for downloading artifacts
43:         required: false
44:         type: string
45:         default: ""
46:       runner_prefix:
47:         description: prefix for runner label
48:         type: string
49:         default: ""
50:     secrets:
51:       GH_PYTORCHBOT_TOKEN:
52:         required: false
53:         description: Permissions for pushing to the docs site.
54: 
55: jobs:
56:   build-docs:
57:     # Don't run on forked repos.
58:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
59:     runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
60:     environment: ${{ (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) && 'pytorchbot-env' || '' }}
61:     strategy:
62:       fail-fast: false
63:       matrix:
64:         include:
65:           - docs_type: cpp
66:             # We recently seeing lots of exit code 137 running this in Docker indicating
67:             # an OOM issue when running the job, so this upgrades the runner from 4xlarge
68:             # to the next available tier of 12xlarge. So much memory just to generate cpp
69:             # doc
70:             runner: ${{ inputs.runner_prefix }}linux.12xlarge.memory
71:             # TODO: Nightly cpp docs take longer and longer to finish (more than 3h now)
72:             # Let's try to figure out how this can be improved
73:             timeout-minutes: 360
74:           - docs_type: python
75:             runner: ${{ inputs.runner_prefix }}linux.c7i.2xlarge
76:             # It takes less than 30m to finish python docs unless there are issues
77:             timeout-minutes: 30
78:     # Set a fixed name for this job instead of using the current matrix-generated name, i.e. build-docs (cpp, linux.12xlarge, 180)
79:     # The current name requires updating the database last docs push query from test-infra every time the matrix is updated
80:     name: build-docs-${{ matrix.docs_type }}-${{ inputs.push }}
81:     steps:
82:       - name: Setup SSH (Click me for login details)
83:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-ssh@main
84:         with:
85:           github-secret: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
86:           instructions: |
87:             All builds are done inside the container, to start an interactive session run:
88:               docker exec -it $(docker container ps --format '{{.ID}}') bash
89:             To start Python docs build type:
90:               cd docs && make html && make coverage
91: 
92:       # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
93:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
94:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
95: 
96:       - name: Setup Linux
97:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-linux
98: 
99:       - name: configure aws credentials
100:         if : ${{ inputs.aws-role-to-assume != '' }}
101:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0
102:         with:
103:           role-to-assume: ${{ inputs.aws-role-to-assume }}
104:           role-session-name: gha-linux-test
105:           aws-region: us-east-1
106: 
107:       - name: Calculate docker image
108:         id: calculate-docker-image
109:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/calculate-docker-image@main
110:         with:
111:           docker-image-name: ${{ inputs.docker-image }}
112: 
113:       - name: Pull docker image
114:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/pull-docker-image@main
115:         with:
116:           docker-image: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
117: 
118:       - name: Download build artifacts
119:         uses: ./.github/actions/download-build-artifacts
120:         with:
121:           name: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
122:           s3-bucket: ${{ inputs.s3-bucket }}
123: 
124:       - name: Generate netrc (only for docs-push)
125:         if: inputs.push
126:         env:
127:           GITHUB_PYTORCHBOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PYTORCHBOT_TOKEN }}
128:         run: |
129:           # sometimes .netrc exists as a directory even though this is the temp folder
130:           rm -rf "${RUNNER_TEMP}/.netrc"
131:           # set credentials for https pushing
132:           echo "machine github.com" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/.netrc"
133:           echo "login pytorchbot" >> "${RUNNER_TEMP}/.netrc"
134:           echo "password ${GITHUB_PYTORCHBOT_TOKEN}" >> "${RUNNER_TEMP}/.netrc"
135: 
136:       - name: Build ${{ matrix.docs_type }} docs
137:         timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.timeout-minutes }}
138:         id: build-docs
139:         env:
140:           # After https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/88373, pull workflow can now be run periodically,
141:           # so using a schedule event to determine if the docs should be pushed or not doesn't hold true
142:           # anymore
143:           WITH_PUSH: ${{ inputs.push }}
144:           DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.docker-image }}
145:           DOCS_TYPE: ${{ matrix.docs_type }}
146:           RUN_DOXYGEN: ${{ inputs.run-doxygen }}
147:           BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
148:         run: |
149:           set -ex
150:           # Convert refs/tags/v1.12.0rc3 into 1.12
151:           if [[ "${GITHUB_REF}" =~ ^refs/tags/v([0-9]+\.[0-9]+)\.* ]]; then
152:             target="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
153:           else
154:             target="main"
155:           fi
156:           # detached container should get cleaned up by teardown_ec2_linux
157:           container_name=$(docker run \
158:             -e BUILD_ENVIRONMENT \
159:             -e MAX_JOBS="$(nproc --ignore=2)" \
160:             -e SHA1="$GITHUB_SHA" \
161:             -e DOCS_VERSION="${target}" \
162:             -e DOCS_TYPE \
163:             -e RUN_DOXYGEN \
164:             -e WITH_PUSH \
165:             --env-file="/tmp/github_env_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" \
166:             --security-opt seccomp=unconfined \
167:             --cap-add=SYS_PTRACE \
168:             --tty \
169:             --detach \
170:             --user jenkins \
171:             -v "${RUNNER_TEMP}/.netrc":/var/lib/jenkins/.netrc \
172:             -v "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}:/var/lib/jenkins/workspace" \
173:             -w /var/lib/jenkins/workspace \
174:             "${DOCKER_IMAGE}"
175:           )
176:           docker exec -t "${container_name}" bash -c "sudo chown -R jenkins . && pip install $(echo dist/*.whl)[opt-einsum] && ./.ci/pytorch/${DOCS_TYPE}_doc_push_script.sh"
177: 
178:       - name: Chown workspace
179:         uses: ./.github/actions/chown-workspace
180:         if: always()
181: 
182:       - name: configure aws credentials
183:         if : ${{ inputs.upload-aws-role-to-assume != '' }}
184:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0
185:         with:
186:           role-to-assume: ${{ inputs.upload-aws-role-to-assume }}
187:           role-session-name: gha-linux-test
188:           aws-region: us-east-1
189: 
190:       - name: Upload Python Docs Preview
191:         uses: seemethere/upload-artifact-s3@baba72d0712b404f646cebe0730933554ebce96a # v5.1.0
192:         if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && matrix.docs_type == 'python' && steps.build-docs.outcome == 'success' }}
193:         with:
194:           retention-days: 14
195:           s3-bucket: doc-previews
196:           if-no-files-found: error
197:           path: pytorch_docs/main/
198:           s3-prefix: pytorch/pytorch/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
199: 
200:       - name: Upload C++ Docs Preview
201:         uses: seemethere/upload-artifact-s3@baba72d0712b404f646cebe0730933554ebce96a # v5.1.0
202:         if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && matrix.docs_type == 'cpp' && steps.build-docs.outcome == 'success' }}
203:         with:
204:           retention-days: 14
205:           if-no-files-found: error
206:           s3-bucket: doc-previews
207:           path: cppdocs/
208:           s3-prefix: pytorch/pytorch/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/cppdocs
209: 
210:       - name: Teardown Linux
211:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/teardown-linux@main
212:         if: always()

{"content":"1: # The point of this workflow is to test that a FA3 wheel that was built based off the
2: # stable ABI as of torch nightly 20250830 can still run on the newer torch.
3: #
4: # This workflow is very similar to the _linux-test.yml workflow, with the following
5: # differences:
6: #   1. It is simpler (there is no test matrix)
7: #   2. It pulls flash-attention as a secondary repository in order to access the tests.
8: #      Note that it does not BUILD anything from flash-attention, as we have a prebuilt
9: #      wheel. We pull flash-attention only to run a few tests.
10: #   3. It runs only FA3 tests. No PyTorch tests are run.
11: name: linux-test-stable-fa3
12: 
13: on:
14:   workflow_call:
15:     inputs:
16:       build-environment:
17:         required: true
18:         type: string
19:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
20:       docker-image:
21:         required: true
22:         type: string
23:         description: Docker image to run in.
24:       timeout-minutes:
25:         required: false
26:         type: number
27:         default: 30
28:         description: |
29:           Set the maximum (in minutes) how long the workflow should take to finish
30:       s3-bucket:
31:         description: S3 bucket to download artifact
32:         required: false
33:         type: string
34:         default: "gha-artifacts"
35:     secrets:
36:       HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN:
37:         required: false
38:         description: |
39:           HF Auth token to avoid rate limits when downloading models or datasets from hub
40:       VLLM_TEST_HUGGING_FACE_TOKEN:
41:         required: false
42:         description: |
43:           HF Auth token to test vllm
44:       SCRIBE_GRAPHQL_ACCESS_TOKEN:
45:         required: false
46:         description: |
47:           FB app token to write to scribe endpoint
48: 
49: env:
50:   GIT_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
51: 
52: jobs:
53:   test:
54:     # Don't run on forked repos
55:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
56:     runs-on: linux.aws.h100
57:     timeout-minutes: ${{ inputs.timeout-minutes || 30 }}
58:     permissions:
59:       id-token: write
60:       contents: read
61:     steps:
62:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
63:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
64:         with:
65:           no-sudo: true
66: 
67:       - name: Checkout flash-attention as a secondary repository
68:         uses: actions/checkout@v4
69:         with:
70:           repository: Dao-AILab/flash-attention
71:           path: flash-attention
72: 
73:       - name: Setup Linux
74:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-linux
75: 
76:       - name: Calculate docker image
77:         id: calculate-docker-image
78:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/calculate-docker-image@main
79:         with:
80:           docker-image-name: ${{ inputs.docker-image }}
81: 
82:       - name: Use following to pull public copy of the image
83:         id: print-ghcr-mirror
84:         env:
85:           ECR_DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
86:         shell: bash
87:         run: |
88:           tag=${ECR_DOCKER_IMAGE##*:}
89:           echo "docker pull ghcr.io/pytorch/ci-image:${tag/:/-}"
90: 
91:       - name: Pull docker image
92:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/pull-docker-image@main
93:         with:
94:           docker-image: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
95:

99:         run: echo "IN_CONTAINER_RUNNER=$(if [ -f /.inarc ] || [ -f /.incontainer ]; then echo true ; else echo false; fi)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
100:

{"content":"1: name: linux-test
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_call:

23:           If this is set, our linter will use this to make sure that every other

37:         required: false
38:         type: string
39:         default: ""

46:         description: role to assume for downloading artifacts

51:         description: |
52:           [Experimental] Disable utilization monitoring for tests.
53:           Currently, by default we disable the monitor job and only look for specific tests,
54:           since we are investigating the behaviour of the monitor script with different tests.
55:         required: false
56:         type: boolean
57:         default: false

59:         description: |

84: env:

94:     environment: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && 'scribe-protected' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/release/') && 'scribe-protected' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci-scribe') && 'scribe-pr' || '' }}
95:     runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}

100:     steps:
101:       - name: Setup SSH (Click me for login details)

125:

128:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0

139:

154:           tag=${ECR_DOCKER_IMAGE##*:}

267:       - name: Parse ref

281: 
282:       - name: Set Test step time
283:         id: test-timeout
284:         shell: bash

287:         run: |
288:           echo "timeout=$((JOB_TIMEOUT-30))" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
289:

291:         shell: bash
292:         run: |
293:           env | grep '^GITHUB' >> "/tmp/github_env_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
294:           env | grep '^CI' >> "/tmp/github_env_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"

296:       - name: Test
297:         id: test
298:         timeout-minutes: ${{ fromJson(steps.test-timeout.outputs.timeout) }}
299:         env:
300:           BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
301:           PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
302:           GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
303:           GITHUB_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}
304:           GITHUB_JOB: ${{ github.job }}
305:           GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
306:           GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
307:           GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
308:           JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
309:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
310:           BRANCH: ${{ steps.parse-ref.outputs.branch }}
311:           SHA1: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
312:           BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.sha }}

321:           TEST_SHOWLOCALS: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-test-showlocals }}
322:           NO_TEST_TIMEOUT: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-no-test-timeout }}

330:           DOCKER_IMAGE_S390X: ${{ inputs.docker-image }}
331:           XLA_CUDA: ${{ contains(inputs.build-environment, 'xla') && '0' || '' }}
332:           XLA_CLANG_CACHE_S3_BUCKET_NAME: ossci-compiler-clang-cache-circleci-xla
333:           PYTORCH_TEST_CUDA_MEM_LEAK_CHECK: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check && '1' || '0' }}
334:           PYTORCH_TEST_RERUN_DISABLED_TESTS: ${{ matrix.rerun_disabled_tests && '1' || '0' }}
335:           DASHBOARD_TAG: ${{ inputs.dashboard-tag }}
336:           VLLM_TEST_HUGGING_FACE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VLLM_TEST_HUGGING_FACE_TOKEN }}
337:           HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN }}
338:           SCRIBE_GRAPHQL_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SCRIBE_GRAPHQL_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
339:           ARTIFACTS_FILE_SUFFIX: ${{ github.job }}-${{ matrix.config }}-${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ matrix.num_shards }}-${{ matrix.runner }}_${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
340:         run: |
341:           set -x
342: 
343:           if [[ $TEST_CONFIG == 'multigpu' ]]; then
344:             TEST_COMMAND=.ci/pytorch/multigpu-test.sh
345:           elif [[ $BUILD_ENVIRONMENT == *onnx* ]]; then
346:             TEST_COMMAND=.ci/onnx/test.sh
347:           else
348:             TEST_COMMAND=.ci/pytorch/test.sh
349:           fi
350: 
351:           # Leaving 1GB for the runner and other things
352:           TOTAL_AVAILABLE_MEMORY_IN_GB=$(awk '/MemTotal/ { printf "%.3f \n", $2/1024/1024 - 1 }' /proc/meminfo)
353:           # https://docs.docker.com/engine/containers/resource_constraints/#--memory-swap-details, the 3GB swap
354:           # comes from https://github.com/pytorch/test-infra/pull/6058
355:           TOTAL_MEMORY_WITH_SWAP=$(("${TOTAL_AVAILABLE_MEMORY_IN_GB%.*}" + 3))
356: 
357:           if [[ ${BUILD_ENVIRONMENT} == *"s390x"* ]]; then
358:             SHM_OPTS=
359:             JENKINS_USER=
360:             # ensure that docker container cleanly exits in 12 hours
361:             # if for some reason cleanup action doesn't stop container
362:             # when job is cancelled
363:             DOCKER_SHELL_CMD="sleep 12h"
364:             USED_IMAGE="${DOCKER_IMAGE_S390X}"
365:           else
366:             SHM_OPTS="--shm-size=${SHM_SIZE}"
367:             JENKINS_USER="--user jenkins"
368:             DOCKER_SHELL_CMD=
369:             USED_IMAGE="${DOCKER_IMAGE}"
370:           fi
371: 
372:           # detached container should get cleaned up by teardown_ec2_linux
373:           # TODO: Stop building test binaries as part of the build phase
374:           # Used for GPU_FLAG, SHM_OPTS, JENKINS_USER and DOCKER_SHELL_CMD since that doesn't play nice
375:           # shellcheck disable=SC2086,SC2090
376:           container_name=$(docker run \
377:             ${GPU_FLAG:-} \
378:             ${SCCACHE_SERVER_PORT_DOCKER_FLAG:-} \
379:             -e BUILD_ENVIRONMENT \
380:             -e PR_NUMBER \
381:             -e GITHUB_ACTIONS \
382:             -e GITHUB_REPOSITORY \
383:             -e GITHUB_WORKFLOW \
384:             -e GITHUB_JOB \
385:             -e GITHUB_RUN_ID \
386:             -e GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER \
387:             -e GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT \
388:             -e JOB_ID \
389:             -e JOB_NAME \
390:             -e BASE_SHA \
391:             -e BRANCH \
392:             -e SHA1 \
393:             -e AWS_DEFAULT_REGION \
394:             -e IN_WHEEL_TEST \
395:             -e SHARD_NUMBER \
396:             -e TEST_CONFIG \
397:             -e NUM_TEST_SHARDS \
398:             -e REENABLED_ISSUES \
399:             -e CONTINUE_THROUGH_ERROR \
400:             -e VERBOSE_TEST_LOGS \
401:             -e TEST_SHOWLOCALS \
402:             -e NO_TEST_TIMEOUT \
403:             -e NO_TD \
404:             -e TD_DISTRIBUTED \
405:             -e PR_LABELS \
406:             -e MAX_JOBS="$(nproc --ignore=2)" \
407:             -e SCCACHE_BUCKET \
408:             -e SCCACHE_REGION \
409:             -e XLA_CUDA \
410:             -e XLA_CLANG_CACHE_S3_BUCKET_NAME \

412:             -e PYTORCH_TEST_RERUN_DISABLED_TESTS \
413:             -e SKIP_SCCACHE_INITIALIZATION=1 \
414:             -e HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN \
415:             -e VLLM_TEST_HUGGING_FACE_TOKEN \
416:             -e SCRIBE_GRAPHQL_ACCESS_TOKEN \
417:             -e DASHBOARD_TAG \
418:             -e ARTIFACTS_FILE_SUFFIX \
419:             --memory="${TOTAL_AVAILABLE_MEMORY_IN_GB%.*}g" \
420:             --memory-swap="${TOTAL_MEMORY_WITH_SWAP}g" \
421:             --env-file="/tmp/github_env_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" \
422:             --security-opt seccomp=unconfined \
423:             --cap-add=SYS_PTRACE \
424:             --ipc=host \
425:             ${SHM_OPTS} \
426:             --tty \
427:             --detach \
428:             --name="${container_name}" \
429:             ${JENKINS_USER} \
430:             -v "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}:/var/lib/jenkins/workspace" \
431:             -w /var/lib/jenkins/workspace \
432:             "${USED_IMAGE}" \
433:             ${DOCKER_SHELL_CMD}
434:           )

436: 
437:           if [[ ${BUILD_ENVIRONMENT} == *"s390x"* ]]; then
438:             docker exec -t "${container_name}" sh -c "python3 -m pip install -r .ci/docker/requirements-ci.txt"
439:           fi

442: 
443:       - name: Upload pytest cache if tests failed
444:         uses: ./.github/actions/pytest-cache-upload
445:         continue-on-error: true

458:           role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::308535385114:role/gha_workflow_upload-benchmark-results

465:         if: inputs.build-environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'

471: 
472:       - name: Print remaining test logs
473:         shell: bash
474:         if: always() && steps.test.conclusion

478:       - name: Stop monitoring script

487:       - name: Upload test artifacts
488:         uses: ./.github/actions/upload-test-artifacts

490:         with:
491:           file-suffix: ${{ github.job }}-${{ matrix.config }}-${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ matrix.num_shards }}-${{ matrix.runner }}_${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
492:           use-gha: ${{ inputs.use-gha }}

496:         if: always()

514:         with:
515:           job_id: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
516:           job_name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
517:           workflow_name: ${{ github.workflow }}
518:           workflow_run_id: ${{github.run_id}}
519:           workflow_attempt: ${{github.run_attempt}}
520: 
521:       - name: Teardown Linux
522:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/teardown-linux@main
523:         if: always() && steps.check_container_runner.outputs.IN_CONTAINER_RUNNER == 'false'
524: 
525:       # NB: We are currently having an intermittent GPU-related issue on G5 runners with
526:       # A10G GPU. Once this happens, trying to reset the GPU as done in setup-nvidia does
527:       # not seem to help. Here are some symptoms:
528:       #   * Calling nvidia-smi timeouts after 60 second
529:       #   * Fail to run nvidia-smi with an unable to determine the device handle for GPU
530:       #     unknown error
531:       #   * Test fails with a missing CUDA GPU error when initializing CUDA in PyTorch
532:       #   * Run docker --gpus all fails with error response from daemon
533:       #
534:       # As both the root cause and recovery path are unclear, let's take the runner out of
535:       # service so that it doesn't get any more jobs
536:       - name: Check NVIDIA driver installation step
537:         if: failure() && steps.install-nvidia-driver.outputs.has-nvidia == 'true' && !contains(matrix.runner, 'b200')
538:         shell: bash
539:         run: |
540:           set +e
541:           set -x
542: 
543:           nvidia-smi
544:           # NB: Surprisingly, nvidia-smi command returns successfully with return code 0 even in
545:           # the case where the driver has already crashed as it still can get the driver version
546:           # and some basic information like the bus ID.  However, the rest of the information
547:           # would be missing (ERR!), for example:
548:           #
549:           # +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
550:           # | NVIDIA-SMI 525.89.02    Driver Version: 525.89.02    CUDA Version: 12.0     |
551:           # |-------------------------------+----------------------+----------------------+
552:           # | GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id        Disp.A | Volatile Uncorr. ECC |
553:           # | Fan  Temp  Perf  Pwr:Usage/Cap|         Memory-Usage | GPU-Util  Compute M. |
554:           # |                               |                      |               MIG M. |
555:           # |===============================+======================+======================|
556:           # |   0  ERR!                Off  | 00000000:00:1E.0 Off |                 ERR! |
557:           # |ERR!  ERR! ERR!    ERR! / ERR! |   4184MiB / 23028MiB |    ERR!      Default |
558:           # |                               |                      |                 ERR! |
559:           # +-------------------------------+----------------------+----------------------+
560:           #
561:           # +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
562:           # | Processes:                                                                  |
563:           # |  GPU   GI   CI        PID   Type   Process name                  GPU Memory |
564:           # |        ID   ID                                                   Usage      |
565:           # |=============================================================================|
566:           # +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
567:           #
568:           # This should be reported as a failure instead as it will guarantee to fail when
569:           # Docker tries to run with --gpus all
570:           #
571:           # So, the correct check here is to query one of the missing piece of info like
572:           # GPU name, so that the command can fail accordingly
573:           nvidia-smi --query-gpu=gpu_name --format=csv,noheader --id=0
574:           NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS=$?
575: 
576:           # These are acceptable return code from nvidia-smi as copied from setup-nvidia GitHub action
577:           if [ "$NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS" -ne 0 ] && [ "$NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS" -ne 14 ]; then
578:             echo "NVIDIA driver installation has failed, shutting down the runner..."
579:             .github/scripts/stop_runner_service.sh
580:           fi
581: 
582:           # For runner with multiple GPUs, we also want to confirm that the number of GPUs are the
583:           # power of 2, i.e. 1, 2, 4, or 8. This is to avoid flaky test issue when one GPU fails
584:           # https://github.com/pytorch/test-infra/issues/4000
585:           GPU_COUNT=$(nvidia-smi --list-gpus | wc -l)
586:           NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS=$?
587: 
588:           # These are acceptable return code from nvidia-smi as copied from setup-nvidia GitHub action
589:           if [ "$NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS" -ne 0 ] && [ "$NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS" -ne 14 ]; then
590:             echo "NVIDIA driver installation has failed, shutting down the runner..."
591:             .github/scripts/stop_runner_service.sh
592:           fi
593: 
594:           # Check the GPU count to be a power of 2
595:           if [ "$GPU_COUNT" -le 8 ] && [ "$GPU_COUNT" -ne 1 ] && [ "$GPU_COUNT" -ne 2 ] && [ "$GPU_COUNT" -ne 4 ] && [ "$GPU_COUNT" -ne 8 ]; then
596:             echo "NVIDIA driver detects $GPU_COUNT GPUs. The runner has a broken GPU, shutting it down..."
597:             .github/scripts/stop_runner_service.sh
598:           fi
599: 
600:       - name: Cleanup docker
601:         if: always() && inputs.build-environment == 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
602:         shell: bash
603:         run: |
604:           # on s390x stop the container for clean worker stop
605:           docker stop -a || true
606:           docker kill -a || true

{"content":"1: name: mac-build
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_call:
5:     inputs:
6:       build-environment:
7:         required: true
8:         type: string
9:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
10:       runner-type:
11:         required: true
12:         type: string
13:         description: Name of the GitHub-managed runner type to use for the build.
14:       build-generates-artifacts:
15:         required: true
16:         type: boolean
17:         description: If set, upload generated build artifacts.
18:       xcode-version:
19:         required: false
20:         type: string
21:         default: ""
22:         description: What xcode version to build with.
23:       sync-tag:
24:         required: false
25:         type: string
26:         default: ""
27:         description: |
28:           If this is set, our linter will use this to make sure that every other
29:           job with the same `sync-tag` is identical.
30:       python-version:
31:         required: false
32:         type: string
33:         default: "3.12"
34:         description: |
35:           The python version to be used. Will be 3.9 by default
36:       test-matrix:
37:         required: false
38:         type: string
39:         description: |
40:           An option JSON description of what test configs to run later on. This
41:           is moved here from the Linux test workflow so that we can apply filter
42:           logic using test-config labels earlier and skip unnecessary builds
43:       sccache-use-gha:
44:         required: false
45:         type: boolean
46:         default: false
47:         description: If true, use the Github cache as the storage option for sccache instead of S3.
48: 
49:     outputs:
50:       test-matrix:
51:         value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.test-matrix }}
52:         description: An optional JSON description of what test configs to run later on.
53:       build-outcome:
54:         value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.build-outcome }}
55:         description: The outcome of the build step. This is used to influence test filtering logic later on.
56:       build-environment:
57:         value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.build-environment }}
58:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
59: 
60: jobs:
61:   build:
62:     # Don't run on forked repos.
63:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
64:     runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner-type }}
65:     env:
66:       BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
67:       SCCACHE_USE_GHA: ${{ inputs.sccache-use-gha }}  # this is placed here instead of the sccache step to appease actionlint
68:     outputs:
69:       build-outcome: ${{ steps.build.outcome }}
70:       test-matrix: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.test-matrix }}
71:       build-environment: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
72:     steps:
73:       - name: Clean up disk space before running MacOS workflow
74:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/check-disk-space@main
75: 
76:       # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
77:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
78:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
79: 
80:       - name: Set xcode version
81:         env:
82:           XCODE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.xcode-version }}
83:         run: |
84:           if [ -n "${XCODE_VERSION}" ]; then
85:             echo "DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode_${XCODE_VERSION}.app/Contents/Developer" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
86:           fi
87: 
88:       - name: Setup Python
89:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-python@main
90:         with:
91:           python-version: ${{ inputs.python-version }}
92:           pip-requirements-file: .ci/docker/requirements-ci.txt
93: 
94:       - name: Install sccache (only for non-forked PRs, and pushes to trunk)
95:         uses: nick-fields/retry@7152eba30c6575329ac0576536151aca5a72780e # v3.0.0
96:         if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository }}
97:         with:
98:           timeout_minutes: 5
99:           max_attempts: 3
100:           retry_wait_seconds: 90
101:           command: |
102:             set -ex
103: 
104:             DOWNLOAD_SCCACHE=0
105:             SCCACHE_VERSION="0.4.1"
106:             LOCAL_PATH="/usr/local/bin"
107: 
108:             if [ ! -f "${LOCAL_PATH}/sccache" ]; then
109:               DOWNLOAD_SCCACHE=1
110:             else
111:               LOCAL_VERSION=$("${LOCAL_PATH}/sccache" --version | cut -d" " -f2)
112: 
113:               if [ "${LOCAL_VERSION}" != "${SCCACHE_VERSION}" ]; then
114:                 DOWNLOAD_SCCACHE=1
115:               fi
116:             fi
117: 
118:             if [ "${DOWNLOAD_SCCACHE}" == "1" ]; then
119:               sudo curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors "https://s3.amazonaws.com/ossci-macos/sccache/sccache-v0.4.1-${RUNNER_ARCH}" --output "${LOCAL_PATH}/sccache"
120:               sudo chmod +x "${LOCAL_PATH}/sccache"
121:             fi
122: 
123:             if [[ "${SCCACHE_USE_GHA}" == "true" ]]; then
124:               echo "ACTIONS_CACHE_URL=${ACTIONS_CACHE_URL}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
125:               echo "ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN=${ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
126:               echo "SCCACHE_GHA_ENABLED=on" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
127:             else
128:               # The runner has access to the S3 bucket via IAM profile without the need
129:               # for any credential
130:               echo "SCCACHE_BUCKET=ossci-compiler-cache-circleci-v2" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
131:               echo "SCCACHE_S3_KEY_PREFIX=${GITHUB_WORKFLOW}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
132:             fi
133: 
134:             # This is needed so that later build script could find sccache (which sccache)
135:             echo "${LOCAL_PATH}" >> $GITHUB_PATH
136: 
137:       - name: Get workflow job id
138:         id: get-job-id
139:         uses: ./.github/actions/get-workflow-job-id
140:         if: always()
141:         with:
142:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
143: 
144:       # Apply the filter logic to the build step too if the test-config label is already there
145:       - name: Select all requested test configurations (if the test matrix is available)
146:         id: filter
147:         uses: ./.github/actions/filter-test-configs
148:         with:
149:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
150:           test-matrix: ${{ inputs.test-matrix }}
151:           job-name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
152: 
153:       - name: Build
154:         if: steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' || inputs.test-matrix == ''
155:         id: build
156:         env:
157:           OUR_GITHUB_JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
158:         run: |
159:           # TODO: Remove me later, and properly activate venv
160:           PATH="$VENV_PATH/bin:$PATH"
161:           export PATH
162: 
163:           # NB: Same trick as Linux, there is no need to initialize sccache with the risk of getting
164:           # it hangs or timeout at initialization. The cache will be started automatically
165:           export SKIP_SCCACHE_INITIALIZATION=1
166:           .ci/pytorch/macos-build.sh
167: 
168:       - name: Archive artifacts into zip
169:         if: inputs.build-generates-artifacts && steps.build.outcome != 'skipped'
170:         run: |
171:           zip -1 -r artifacts.zip dist/ build/.ninja_log build/compile_commands.json .additional_ci_files
172: 
173:       - name: Store PyTorch Build Artifacts on GHA
174:         uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
175:         if: inputs.build-generates-artifacts && steps.build.outcome != 'skipped'
176:         with:
177:           name: ${{ env.BUILD_ENVIRONMENT }}
178:           retention-days: 14
179:           if-no-files-found: error
180:           path: artifacts.zip
181: 
182:       - name: Upload sccache stats to GHA
183:         uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
184:         # Only if sccache is installed, see above
185:         if: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository) && steps.build.outcome != 'skipped' }}
186:         with:
187:           name: sccache-stats-${{ inputs.build-environment }}-runattempt${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
188:           retention-days: 14
189:           if-no-files-found: warn
190:           path: sccache-stats-*.json
191: 
192:       - name: Clean up disk space
193:         if: always()
194:         continue-on-error: true
195:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/check-disk-space@main

80:           """
81:           This runner determinator is used to determine which set of runners to run a
82:           GitHub job on. It uses the first comment of a GitHub issue (by default
83:           https://github.com/pytorch/test-infra/issues/5132) to define the configuration
84:           of which runners should be used to run which job.
85: 
86:           The configuration has two parts, the settings and a list of opted-in users,
87:           separated by a line containing "---".  If the line is not present, the
88:           settings are considered to be empty with only the second part, the user
89:           list, defined.
90: 
91:           The first part is a YAML block that defines the rollout settings. This can be
92:           used to define any settings that are needed to determine which runners to use.
93:           It's fields are defined by the RolloutSettings class below.
94: 
95:           The second part is a list of users who are explicitly opted in to the LF fleet.
96:           The user list is also a comma separated list of additional features or
97:           experiments which the user could be opted in to.
98: 
99:           The user list has the following rules:
100: 
101:           - Users are GitHub usernames, which must start with the @ prefix
102:           - Each user is also a comma-separated list of features/experiments to enable
103:           - A "#" prefix opts the user out of all experiments
104: 
105:           Example config:
106:               # A list of experiments that can be opted into.
107:               # This defines the behavior they'll induce when opted into.
108:               # Expected syntax is:
109:               #   [experiment_name]: # Name of the experiment. Also used for the label prefix.
110:               #      rollout_perc: [int] # % of workflows to run with this experiment when users are not opted in.
111: 
112:               experiments:
113:                 lf:
114:                   rollout_percent: 25
115:                   all_branches: false
116:                   default: true
117:               ---
118: 
119:               # Opt-ins:
120:               # Users can opt into the LF fleet by adding their GitHub username to this list
121:               # and specifying experiments to enable in a comma-separated list.
122:               # To always opt out of an experiment, prefix it with a "-".
123:               # Experiments should be from the above list.
124: 
125:               @User1,-lf,split_build
126:               @User2,lf
127:               @User3,split_build

301:               repo = gh.get_repo(repo)

305:           def get_potential_pr_author(
306:               github_token: str, repo: str, username: str, ref_type: str, ref_name: str
307:           ) -> str:
308:               # If the trigger was a new tag added by a bot, this is a ciflow case
309:               # Fetch the actual username from the original PR. The PR number is
310:               # embedded in the tag name: ciflow/<name>/<pr-number>
311: 
312:               gh = get_gh_client(github_token)
313: 
314:               if username == "pytorch-bot[bot]" and ref_type == "tag":
315:                   split_tag = ref_name.split("/")
316:                   if (
317:                       len(split_tag) == 3
318:                       and split_tag[0] == "ciflow"
319:                       and split_tag[2].isnumeric()
320:                   ):
321:                       pr_number = split_tag[2]
322:                       try:
323:                           repository = gh.get_repo(repo)
324:                           pull = repository.get_pull(number=int(pr_number))
325:                       except Exception as e:
326:                           raise Exception(  # noqa: TRY002
327:                               f"issue with pull request {pr_number} from repo {repository}"
328:                           ) from e
329:                       return pull.user.login  # type: ignore[no-any-return]

334:           def is_exception_branch(branch: str) -> bool:
335:               """
336:               Branches that get opted out of experiments by default, until they're explicitly enabled.
337:               """
338:               return branch.split("/")[0] in {"main", "nightly", "release", "landchecks"}

341:           def load_yaml(yaml_text: str) -> Any:
342:               try:
343:                   data = yaml.safe_load(yaml_text)
344:                   return data
345:               except yaml.YAMLError:
346:                   log.exception("Error loading YAML")
347:                   raise
