{"content":"1: name: build docs
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_call:
5:     inputs:
6:       build-environment:
7:         required: true
8:         type: string
9:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
10:       docker-image:
11:         required: true
12:         type: string
13:         description: Docker image to run in.
14:       push:
15:         required: false
16:         type: boolean
17:         default: false
18:         description: If set, push the docs to the docs website.
19:       run-doxygen:
20:         required: false
21:         type: boolean
22:         default: false
23:         description: If set, will enable C++ API doc generation using doxygen / breathe / exhale.
24:       sync-tag:
25:         required: false
26:         type: string
27:         default: ""
28:         description: |
29:           If this is set, our linter will use this to make sure that every other
30:           job with the same `sync-tag` is identical.
31:       s3-bucket:
32:         description: S3 bucket to download artifact
33:         required: false
34:         type: string
35:         default: "gha-artifacts"
36:       aws-role-to-assume:
37:         description: role to assume for downloading artifacts
38:         required: false
39:         type: string
40:         default: ""
41:       upload-aws-role-to-assume:
42:         description: role to assume for downloading artifacts
43:         required: false
44:         type: string
45:         default: ""
46:       runner_prefix:
47:         description: prefix for runner label
48:         type: string
49:         default: ""
50:     secrets:
51:       GH_PYTORCHBOT_TOKEN:
52:         required: false
53:         description: Permissions for pushing to the docs site.
54: 
55: jobs:
56:   build-docs:
57:     # Don't run on forked repos.
58:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
59:     runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
60:     environment: ${{ (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) && 'pytorchbot-env' || '' }}
61:     strategy:
62:       fail-fast: false
63:       matrix:
64:         include:
65:           - docs_type: cpp
66:             # We recently seeing lots of exit code 137 running this in Docker indicating
67:             # an OOM issue when running the job, so this upgrades the runner from 4xlarge
68:             # to the next available tier of 12xlarge. So much memory just to generate cpp
69:             # doc
70:             runner: ${{ inputs.runner_prefix }}linux.12xlarge.memory
71:             # TODO: Nightly cpp docs take longer and longer to finish (more than 3h now)
72:             # Let's try to figure out how this can be improved
73:             timeout-minutes: 360
74:           - docs_type: python
75:             runner: ${{ inputs.runner_prefix }}linux.c7i.2xlarge
76:             # It takes less than 30m to finish python docs unless there are issues
77:             timeout-minutes: 30
78:     # Set a fixed name for this job instead of using the current matrix-generated name, i.e. build-docs (cpp, linux.12xlarge, 180)
79:     # The current name requires updating the database last docs push query from test-infra every time the matrix is updated
80:     name: build-docs-${{ matrix.docs_type }}-${{ inputs.push }}
81:     steps:
82:       - name: Setup SSH (Click me for login details)
83:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-ssh@main
84:         with:
85:           github-secret: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
86:           instructions: |
87:             All builds are done inside the container, to start an interactive session run:
88:               docker exec -it $(docker container ps --format '{{.ID}}') bash
89:             To start Python docs build type:
90:               cd docs && make html && make coverage
91: 
92:       # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
93:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
94:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
95: 
96:       - name: Setup Linux
97:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-linux
98: 
99:       - name: configure aws credentials
100:         if : ${{ inputs.aws-role-to-assume != '' }}
101:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0
102:         with:
103:           role-to-assume: ${{ inputs.aws-role-to-assume }}
104:           role-session-name: gha-linux-test
105:           aws-region: us-east-1
106: 
107:       - name: Calculate docker image
108:         id: calculate-docker-image
109:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/calculate-docker-image@main
110:         with:
111:           docker-image-name: ${{ inputs.docker-image }}
112: 
113:       - name: Pull docker image
114:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/pull-docker-image@main
115:         with:
116:           docker-image: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
117: 
118:       - name: Download build artifacts
119:         uses: ./.github/actions/download-build-artifacts
120:         with:
121:           name: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
122:           s3-bucket: ${{ inputs.s3-bucket }}
123: 
124:       - name: Generate netrc (only for docs-push)
125:         if: inputs.push
126:         env:
127:           GITHUB_PYTORCHBOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PYTORCHBOT_TOKEN }}
128:         run: |
129:           # sometimes .netrc exists as a directory even though this is the temp folder
130:           rm -rf "${RUNNER_TEMP}/.netrc"
131:           # set credentials for https pushing
132:           echo "machine github.com" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/.netrc"
133:           echo "login pytorchbot" >> "${RUNNER_TEMP}/.netrc"
134:           echo "password ${GITHUB_PYTORCHBOT_TOKEN}" >> "${RUNNER_TEMP}/.netrc"
135: 
136:       - name: Build ${{ matrix.docs_type }} docs
137:         timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.timeout-minutes }}
138:         id: build-docs
139:         env:
140:           # After https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/88373, pull workflow can now be run periodically,
141:           # so using a schedule event to determine if the docs should be pushed or not doesn't hold true
142:           # anymore
143:           WITH_PUSH: ${{ inputs.push }}
144:           DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.docker-image }}
145:           DOCS_TYPE: ${{ matrix.docs_type }}
146:           RUN_DOXYGEN: ${{ inputs.run-doxygen }}
147:           BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
148:         run: |
149:           set -ex
150:           # Convert refs/tags/v1.12.0rc3 into 1.12
151:           if [[ "${GITHUB_REF}" =~ ^refs/tags/v([0-9]+\.[0-9]+)\.* ]]; then
152:             target="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
153:           else
154:             target="main"
155:           fi
156:           # detached container should get cleaned up by teardown_ec2_linux
157:           container_name=$(docker run \
158:             -e BUILD_ENVIRONMENT \
159:             -e MAX_JOBS="$(nproc --ignore=2)" \
160:             -e SHA1="$GITHUB_SHA" \
161:             -e DOCS_VERSION="${target}" \
162:             -e DOCS_TYPE \
163:             -e RUN_DOXYGEN \
164:             -e WITH_PUSH \
165:             --env-file="/tmp/github_env_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" \
166:             --security-opt seccomp=unconfined \
167:             --cap-add=SYS_PTRACE \
168:             --tty \
169:             --detach \
170:             --user jenkins \
171:             -v "${RUNNER_TEMP}/.netrc":/var/lib/jenkins/.netrc \
172:             -v "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}:/var/lib/jenkins/workspace" \
173:             -w /var/lib/jenkins/workspace \
174:             "${DOCKER_IMAGE}"
175:           )
176:           docker exec -t "${container_name}" bash -c "sudo chown -R jenkins . && pip install $(echo dist/*.whl)[opt-einsum] && ./.ci/pytorch/${DOCS_TYPE}_doc_push_script.sh"
177: 
178:       - name: Chown workspace
179:         uses: ./.github/actions/chown-workspace
180:         if: always()
181: 
182:       - name: configure aws credentials
183:         if : ${{ inputs.upload-aws-role-to-assume != '' }}
184:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0
185:         with:
186:           role-to-assume: ${{ inputs.upload-aws-role-to-assume }}
187:           role-session-name: gha-linux-test
188:           aws-region: us-east-1
189: 
190:       - name: Upload Python Docs Preview
191:         uses: seemethere/upload-artifact-s3@baba72d0712b404f646cebe0730933554ebce96a # v5.1.0
192:         if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && matrix.docs_type == 'python' && steps.build-docs.outcome == 'success' }}
193:         with:
194:           retention-days: 14
195:           s3-bucket: doc-previews
196:           if-no-files-found: error
197:           path: pytorch_docs/main/
198:           s3-prefix: pytorch/pytorch/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
199: 
200:       - name: Upload C++ Docs Preview
201:         uses: seemethere/upload-artifact-s3@baba72d0712b404f646cebe0730933554ebce96a # v5.1.0
202:         if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && matrix.docs_type == 'cpp' && steps.build-docs.outcome == 'success' }}
203:         with:
204:           retention-days: 14
205:           if-no-files-found: error
206:           s3-bucket: doc-previews
207:           path: cppdocs/
208:           s3-prefix: pytorch/pytorch/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/cppdocs
209: 
210:       - name: Teardown Linux
211:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/teardown-linux@main
212:         if: always()

{"content":"1: name: Get Changed Files
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_call:
5:     inputs:
6:       all_files:
7:         description: "Whether to return all files instead of just changed files"
8:         required: false
9:         type: boolean
10:         default: false
11:     outputs:
12:       changed-files:
13:         description: "List of changed files (space-separated) or '*' if not in a PR"
14:         value: ${{ jobs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files }}
15: 
16: jobs:
17:   get-changed-files:
18:     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
19:     outputs:
20:       changed-files: ${{ steps.get-files.outputs.changed-files }}
21: 
22:     steps:
23:       - name: Get changed files
24:         id: get-files
25:         env:
26:           GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
27:         run: |
28:           # Check if we're in a pull request context
29:           if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "pull_request" ] || [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "pull_request_target" ]; then
30:             echo "Running in PR context"
31: 
32:             # Get the PR number from the github context
33:             PR_NUMBER="${{ github.event.number }}"
34: 
35:             # Check if all_files is requested
36:             if [ "${{ inputs.all_files }}" = "true" ]; then
37:               echo "all_files input is true, returning all files"
38:               echo "changed-files=*" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
39:             else
40:               # Use gh CLI to get changed files in the PR with explicit repo
41:               CHANGED_FILES=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/files --paginate --jq '.[] | select(.status != "removed") | .filename' | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/ $//')
42: 
43:               # See https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/134215#issuecomment-2332128790
44:               PYI_FILES_TO_ADD=""
45:               for file in ${CHANGED_FILES}; do
46:                 if [[ "${file}" == *".pyi.in" ]]; then
47:                   PYI_FILES_TO_ADD="${PYI_FILES_TO_ADD} ${file//.in/}"
48:                 fi
49:               done
50:               CHANGED_FILES="${CHANGED_FILES}${PYI_FILES_TO_ADD}"
51: 
52:               if [ -z "$CHANGED_FILES" ]; then
53:                 echo "No changed files found, setting to '*'"
54:                 CHANGED_FILES="*"
55:               fi
56: 
57:               echo "Changed files: $CHANGED_FILES"
58:               echo "changed-files=$CHANGED_FILES" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
59:             fi
60: 
61:           else
62:             echo "Not in PR context, setting changed files to '*'"
63:             echo "changed-files=*" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
64:           fi
65: ","url":"https://sourcegraph.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/pytorch--863edc78@76b8fdafad537579cd97b5ec2502c6ac3bc473e0/-/blob/.github/workflows/_get-changed-files.yml"}

356:             ${JENKINS_USER} \
357:             -v "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}:/var/lib/jenkins/workspace" \
358:             -w /var/lib/jenkins/workspace \
359:             "${USED_IMAGE}" \
360:             ${DOCKER_SHELL_CMD}
361:           )
362: 
363:           if [[ ${BUILD_ENVIRONMENT} == *"s390x"* ]]; then
364:             docker exec -t "${container_name}" sh -c "python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt"

{"content":"1: # The point of this workflow is to test that a FA3 wheel that was built based off the
2: # stable ABI as of torch nightly 20250830 can still run on the newer torch.
3: #
4: # This workflow is very similar to the _linux-test.yml workflow, with the following
5: # differences:
6: #   1. It is simpler (there is no test matrix)
7: #   2. It pulls flash-attention as a secondary repository in order to access the tests.
8: #      Note that it does not BUILD anything from flash-attention, as we have a prebuilt
9: #      wheel. We pull flash-attention only to run a few tests.
10: #   3. It runs only FA3 tests. No PyTorch tests are run.
11: name: linux-test-stable-fa3
12: 
13: on:
14:   workflow_call:
15:     inputs:
16:       build-environment:
17:         required: true
18:         type: string
19:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
20:       docker-image:
21:         required: true
22:         type: string
23:         description: Docker image to run in.
24:       timeout-minutes:
25:         required: false
26:         type: number
27:         default: 30
28:         description: |
29:           Set the maximum (in minutes) how long the workflow should take to finish
30:       s3-bucket:
31:         description: S3 bucket to download artifact
32:         required: false
33:         type: string
34:         default: "gha-artifacts"
35:     secrets:
36:       HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN:
37:         required: false

525:       # NB: We are currently having an intermittent GPU-related issue on G5 runners with
526:       # A10G GPU. Once this happens, trying to reset the GPU as done in setup-nvidia does
527:       # not seem to help. Here are some symptoms:
528:       #   * Calling nvidia-smi timeouts after 60 second
529:       #   * Fail to run nvidia-smi with an unable to determine the device handle for GPU
530:       #     unknown error
531:       #   * Test fails with a missing CUDA GPU error when initializing CUDA in PyTorch
532:       #   * Run docker --gpus all fails with error response from daemon
533:       #
534:       # As both the root cause and recovery path are unclear, let's take the runner out of
535:       # service so that it doesn't get any more jobs
536:       - name: Check NVIDIA driver installation step
537:         if: failure() && steps.install-nvidia-driver.outputs.has-nvidia == 'true' && !contains(matrix.runner, 'b200')
538:         shell: bash
539:         run: |
540:           set +e
541:           set -x
542: 
543:           nvidia-smi
544:           # NB: Surprisingly, nvidia-smi command returns successfully with return code 0 even in
545:           # the case where the driver has already crashed as it still can get the driver version
546:           # and some basic information like the bus ID.  However, the rest of the information
547:           # would be missing (ERR!), for example:
548:           #
549:           # +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
550:           # | NVIDIA-SMI 525.89.02    Driver Version: 525.89.02    CUDA Version: 12.0     |
551:           # |-------------------------------+----------------------+----------------------+
552:           # | GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id        Disp.A | Volatile Uncorr. ECC |
553:           # | Fan  Temp  Perf  Pwr:Usage/Cap|         Memory-Usage | GPU-Util  Compute M. |
554:           # |                               |                      |               MIG M. |
555:           # |===============================+======================+======================|
556:           # |   0  ERR!                Off  | 00000000:00:1E.0 Off |                 ERR! |
557:           # |ERR!  ERR! ERR!    ERR! / ERR! |   4184MiB / 23028MiB |    ERR!      Default |
558:           # |                               |                      |                 ERR! |
559:           # +-------------------------------+----------------------+----------------------+
560:           #
561:           # +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
562:           # | Processes:                                                                  |
563:           # |  GPU   GI   CI        PID   Type   Process name                  GPU Memory |
564:           # |        ID   ID                                                   Usage      |
565:           # |=============================================================================|
566:           # +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
567:           #
568:           # This should be reported as a failure instead as it will guarantee to fail when
569:           # Docker tries to run with --gpus all
570:           #
571:           # So, the correct check here is to query one of the missing piece of info like
572:           # GPU name, so that the command can fail accordingly
573:           nvidia-smi --query-gpu=gpu_name --format=csv,noheader --id=0
574:           NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS=$?
575: 
576:           # These are acceptable return code from nvidia-smi as copied from setup-nvidia GitHub action
577:           if [ "$NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS" -ne 0 ] && [ "$NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS" -ne 14 ]; then

583:           # power of 2, i.e. 1, 2, 4, or 8. This is to avoid flaky test issue when one GPU fails

585:           GPU_COUNT=$(nvidia-smi --list-gpus | wc -l)
586:           NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS=$?
587: 
588:           # These are acceptable return code from nvidia-smi as copied from setup-nvidia GitHub action
589:           if [ "$NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS" -ne 0 ] && [ "$NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS" -ne 14 ]; then
590:             echo "NVIDIA driver installation has failed, shutting down the runner..."
591:             .github/scripts/stop_runner_service.sh
592:           fi
593: 
594:           # Check the GPU count to be a power of 2
595:           if [ "$GPU_COUNT" -le 8 ] && [ "$GPU_COUNT" -ne 1 ] && [ "$GPU_COUNT" -ne 2 ] && [ "$GPU_COUNT" -ne 4 ] && [ "$GPU_COUNT" -ne 8 ]; then
596:             echo "NVIDIA driver detects $GPU_COUNT GPUs. The runner has a broken GPU, shutting it down..."
597:             .github/scripts/stop_runner_service.sh
598:           fi

601:         if: always() && inputs.build-environment == 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
602:         shell: bash
603:         run: |
604:           # on s390x stop the container for clean worker stop
605:           docker stop -a || true
606:           docker kill -a || true

{"content":"1: name: mac-build
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_call:
5:     inputs:
6:       build-environment:
7:         required: true
8:         type: string
9:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
10:       runner-type:
11:         required: true
12:         type: string
13:         description: Name of the GitHub-managed runner type to use for the build.
14:       build-generates-artifacts:
15:         required: true
16:         type: boolean
17:         description: If set, upload generated build artifacts.
18:       xcode-version:
19:         required: false
20:         type: string
21:         default: ""
22:         description: What xcode version to build with.
23:       sync-tag:
24:         required: false
25:         type: string
26:         default: ""
27:         description: |
28:           If this is set, our linter will use this to make sure that every other
29:           job with the same `sync-tag` is identical.
30:       python-version:
31:         required: false
32:         type: string
33:         default: "3.12"
34:         description: |
35:           The python version to be used. Will be 3.9 by default
36:       test-matrix:
37:         required: false
38:         type: string
39:         description: |
40:           An option JSON description of what test configs to run later on. This
41:           is moved here from the Linux test workflow so that we can apply filter
42:           logic using test-config labels earlier and skip unnecessary builds
43:       sccache-use-gha:
44:         required: false
45:         type: boolean
46:         default: false
47:         description: If true, use the Github cache as the storage option for sccache instead of S3.
48: 
49:     outputs:
50:       test-matrix:
51:         value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.test-matrix }}
52:         description: An optional JSON description of what test configs to run later on.
53:       build-outcome:
54:         value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.build-outcome }}
55:         description: The outcome of the build step. This is used to influence test filtering logic later on.
56:       build-environment:
57:         value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.build-environment }}
58:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
59: 
60: jobs:
61:   build:
62:     # Don't run on forked repos.
63:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
64:     runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner-type }}
65:     env:
66:       BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
67:       SCCACHE_USE_GHA: ${{ inputs.sccache-use-gha }}  # this is placed here instead of the sccache step to appease actionlint
68:     outputs:
69:       build-outcome: ${{ steps.build.outcome }}
70:       test-matrix: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.test-matrix }}
71:       build-environment: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
72:     steps:
73:       - name: Clean up disk space before running MacOS workflow
74:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/check-disk-space@main
75: 
76:       # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
77:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
78:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
79: 
80:       - name: Set xcode version
81:         env:
82:           XCODE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.xcode-version }}
83:         run: |
84:           if [ -n "${XCODE_VERSION}" ]; then
85:             echo "DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode_${XCODE_VERSION}.app/Contents/Developer" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
86:           fi
87: 
88:       - name: Setup Python
89:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-python@main
90:         with:
91:           python-version: ${{ inputs.python-version }}
92:           pip-requirements-file: .ci/docker/requirements-ci.txt
93: 
94:       - name: Install sccache (only for non-forked PRs, and pushes to trunk)
95:         uses: nick-fields/retry@7152eba30c6575329ac0576536151aca5a72780e # v3.0.0
96:         if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository }}
97:         with:
98:           timeout_minutes: 5
99:           max_attempts: 3
100:           retry_wait_seconds: 90
101:           command: |
102:             set -ex
103: 
104:             DOWNLOAD_SCCACHE=0
105:             SCCACHE_VERSION="0.4.1"
106:             LOCAL_PATH="/usr/local/bin"
107: 
108:             if [ ! -f "${LOCAL_PATH}/sccache" ]; then
109:               DOWNLOAD_SCCACHE=1
110:             else
111:               LOCAL_VERSION=$("${LOCAL_PATH}/sccache" --version | cut -d" " -f2)
112: 
113:               if [ "${LOCAL_VERSION}" != "${SCCACHE_VERSION}" ]; then
114:                 DOWNLOAD_SCCACHE=1
115:               fi
116:             fi
117: 
118:             if [ "${DOWNLOAD_SCCACHE}" == "1" ]; then
119:               sudo curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors "https://s3.amazonaws.com/ossci-macos/sccache/sccache-v0.4.1-${RUNNER_ARCH}" --output "${LOCAL_PATH}/sccache"
120:               sudo chmod +x "${LOCAL_PATH}/sccache"
121:             fi
122: 
123:             if [[ "${SCCACHE_USE_GHA}" == "true" ]]; then
124:               echo "ACTIONS_CACHE_URL=${ACTIONS_CACHE_URL}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
125:               echo "ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN=${ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
126:               echo "SCCACHE_GHA_ENABLED=on" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
127:             else
128:               # The runner has access to the S3 bucket via IAM profile without the need
129:               # for any credential
130:               echo "SCCACHE_BUCKET=ossci-compiler-cache-circleci-v2" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
131:               echo "SCCACHE_S3_KEY_PREFIX=${GITHUB_WORKFLOW}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
132:             fi
133: 
134:             # This is needed so that later build script could find sccache (which sccache)
135:             echo "${LOCAL_PATH}" >> $GITHUB_PATH
136: 
137:       - name: Get workflow job id
138:         id: get-job-id
139:         uses: ./.github/actions/get-workflow-job-id
140:         if: always()
141:         with:
142:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
143: 
144:       # Apply the filter logic to the build step too if the test-config label is already there
145:       - name: Select all requested test configurations (if the test matrix is available)
146:         id: filter
147:         uses: ./.github/actions/filter-test-configs
148:         with:
149:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
150:           test-matrix: ${{ inputs.test-matrix }}
151:           job-name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
152: 
153:       - name: Build
154:         if: steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' || inputs.test-matrix == ''
155:         id: build
156:         env:
157:           OUR_GITHUB_JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
158:         run: |
159:           # TODO: Remove me later, and properly activate venv
160:           PATH="$VENV_PATH/bin:$PATH"
161:           export PATH
162: 
163:           # NB: Same trick as Linux, there is no need to initialize sccache with the risk of getting
164:           # it hangs or timeout at initialization. The cache will be started automatically
165:           export SKIP_SCCACHE_INITIALIZATION=1
166:           .ci/pytorch/macos-build.sh
167: 
168:       - name: Archive artifacts into zip
169:         if: inputs.build-generates-artifacts && steps.build.outcome != 'skipped'
170:         run: |
171:           zip -1 -r artifacts.zip dist/ build/.ninja_log build/compile_commands.json .additional_ci_files

        if m:

arguments.content:
name: linux-binary-test

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      build_name:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: The build's name
      build_environment:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: The build environment
      ALPINE_IMAGE:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "308535385114.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/tool/alpine"
      PYTORCH_ROOT:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: Root directory for the pytorch/pytorch repository
      PACKAGE_TYPE:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: Package type
      DESIRED_CUDA:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: Desired Cuda version
      GPU_ARCH_VERSION:
        required: false
        type: string
        description: GPU Arch version
      GPU_ARCH_TYPE:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: GPU Arch type
      DOCKER_IMAGE:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: Docker image to use
      DOCKER_IMAGE_TAG_PREFIX:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: Docker image tag to use
      LIBTORCH_CONFIG:
        required: false
        type: string
        description: Desired libtorch config (for libtorch builds only)
      LIBTORCH_VARIANT:
        required: false
        type: string
        description: Desired libtorch variant (for libtorch builds only)
      DESIRED_PYTHON:
        required: false
        type: string
        description: Desired python version
      runner_prefix:
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
        description: prefix for runner label
      runs_on:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: Hardware to run this job on. Valid values are linux.4xlarge, linux.4xlarge.nvidia.gpu, linux.arm64.2xlarge, and linux.rocm.gpu
    secrets:
      github-token:
        required: true
        description: Github Token

permissions:
  id-token: write

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner_prefix}}${{ inputs.runs_on }}
    timeout-minutes: 240
    env:
      PYTORCH_ROOT: ${{ inputs.PYTORCH_ROOT }}
      PACKAGE_TYPE: ${{ inputs.PACKAGE_TYPE }}
      # TODO: This is a legacy variable that we eventually want to get rid of in
      #       favor of GPU_ARCH_VERSION
      DESIRED_CUDA: ${{ inputs.DESIRED_CUDA }}
      GPU_ARCH_VERSION: ${{ inputs.GPU_ARCH_VERSION }}
      GPU_ARCH_TYPE: ${{ inputs.GPU_ARCH_TYPE }}
      DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.DOCKER_IMAGE }}
      SKIP_ALL_TESTS: 1
      LIBTORCH_CONFIG: ${{ inputs.LIBTORCH_CONFIG }}
      LIBTORCH_VARIANT: ${{ inputs.LIBTORCH_VARIANT }}
      DESIRED_PYTHON: ${{ inputs.DESIRED_PYTHON }}
      ALPINE_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.ALPINE_IMAGE }}
      AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1
      BINARY_ENV_FILE: /tmp/env
      BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build_environment }}
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
      PYTORCH_FINAL_PACKAGE_DIR: /artifacts
      SHA1: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Make the env permanent during this workflow (but not the secrets)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          {
            echo "PYTORCH_ROOT=${{ env.PYTORCH_ROOT }}"
            echo "PACKAGE_TYPE=${{ env.PACKAGE_TYPE }}"

            echo "DESIRED_CUDA=${{ env.DESIRED_CUDA }}"
            echo "GPU_ARCH_VERSION=${{ env.GPU_ARCH_VERSION }}"
            echo "GPU_ARCH_TYPE=${{ env.GPU_ARCH_TYPE }}"
            echo "DOCKER_IMAGE=${{ env.DOCKER_IMAGE }}"
            echo "SKIP_ALL_TESTS=${{ env.SKIP_ALL_TESTS }}"
            echo "LIBTORCH_CONFIG=${{ env.LIBTORCH_CONFIG }}"
            echo "LIBTORCH_VARIANT=${{ env.LIBTORCH_VARIANT }}"
            echo "DESIRED_PYTHON=${{ env.DESIRED_PYTHON }}"

            echo "ALPINE_IMAGE=${{ env.ALPINE_IMAGE }}"
            echo "AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=${{ env.AWS_DEFAULT_REGION }}"
            echo "BINARY_ENV_FILE=${{ env.BINARY_ENV_FILE }}"
            echo "BUILD_ENVIRONMENT=${{ env.BUILD_ENVIRONMENT }}"
            echo "PR_NUMBER=${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}"
            echo "PYTORCH_FINAL_PACKAGE_DIR=${{ env.PYTORCH_FINAL_PACKAGE_DIR }}"
            echo "SHA1=${{ env.SHA1 }}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_ENV} }}"

      - name: "[FB EMPLOYEES] Enable SSH (Click me for login details)"
        if: inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-ssh@main
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          github-secret: ${{ secrets.github-token }}

        # Setup the environment
      - name: Checkout PyTorch
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
        with:
          no-sudo: ${{ inputs.build_environment == 'linux-aarch64-binary-manywheel' || inputs.build_environment == 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel' }}

      - name: Setup Linux
        if: inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-linux

      - name: Chown workspace
        if: inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
        uses: ./.github/actions/chown-workspace
        with:
          ALPINE_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.ALPINE_IMAGE }}

      - name: Clean workspace
        shell: bash
        run: |
          rm -rf "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}"
          mkdir "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}"

      - name: Checkout PyTorch to pytorch dir
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          submodules: recursive
          show-progress: false
          path: pytorch

      - name: Clean PyTorch checkout
        run: |
          # Remove any artifacts from the previous checkouts
          git clean -fxd
        working-directory: pytorch

      - name: Check if the job is disabled
        id: filter
        uses: ./pytorch/.github/actions/filter-test-configs
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          # NB: Use a mock test matrix with a default value here. After filtering, if the
          # returned matrix is empty, it means that the job is disabled
          test-matrix: |
            { include: [
              { config: "default" },
            ]}

      - name: Download Build Artifacts
        if: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' }}
        uses: actions/download-artifact@65a9edc5881444af0b9093a5e628f2fe47ea3b2e # v4.1.7
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.build_name }}
          path: "${{ runner.temp }}/artifacts/"

      - name: Install nvidia driver, nvidia-docker runtime, set GPU_FLAG
        id: install-nvidia-driver
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-nvidia@main
        if: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' }}

      - name: configure aws credentials
        id: aws_creds
        if: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' && inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel' && startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/ciflow/') }}
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::308535385114:role/gha_workflow_s3_and_ecr_read_only
          aws-region: us-east-1
          role-duration-seconds: 18000

      - name: Calculate docker image
        id: calculate-docker-image
        if: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' && inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel' }}
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/calculate-docker-image@main
        with:
          docker-registry: ${{ startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/ciflow/') && '308535385114.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com' || 'docker.io' }}
          docker-image-name: ${{ inputs.DOCKER_IMAGE }}
          custom-tag-prefix: ${{ inputs.DOCKER_IMAGE_TAG_PREFIX }}
          docker-build-dir: .ci/docker
          working-directory: pytorch

      - name: Pull Docker image
        if: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' && inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel' }}
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/pull-docker-image@main
        with:
          docker-image: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}

      - name: Test Pytorch binary
        if: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' }}
        uses: ./pytorch/.github/actions/test-pytorch-binary
        env:
          DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image || format('{0}:{1}', inputs.DOCKER_IMAGE, inputs.DOCKER_IMAGE_TAG_PREFIX) }}

      - name: Teardown Linux
        if: always() && inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/teardown-linux@main

      - name: Chown workspace
        if: always() && inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
        uses: ./pytorch/.github/actions/chown-workspace
        with:
          ALPINE_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.ALPINE_IMAGE }}

    inputs:
      build_name:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: The build's name
      build_environment:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: The build environment
      ALPINE_IMAGE:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "308535385114.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/tool/alpine"
      PYTORCH_ROOT:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: Root directory for the pytorch/pytorch repository
      PACKAGE_TYPE:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: Package type
      DESIRED_CUDA:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: Desired Cuda version
      GPU_ARCH_VERSION:
        required: false
        type: string
        description: GPU Arch version
      GPU_ARCH_TYPE:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: GPU Arch type
      DOCKER_IMAGE:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: Docker image to use
      DOCKER_IMAGE_TAG_PREFIX:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: Docker image tag to use
      LIBTORCH_CONFIG:
        required: false
        type: string
        description: Desired libtorch config (for libtorch builds only)
      LIBTORCH_VARIANT:
        required: false
        type: string
        description: Desired libtorch variant (for libtorch builds only)
      DESIRED_PYTHON:
        required: false
        type: string
        description: Desired python version
      runner_prefix:
        required: false
        default: ""
        type: string
        description: prefix for runner label
      runs_on:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: Hardware to run this job on. Valid values are linux.4xlarge, linux.4xlarge.nvidia.gpu, linux.arm64.2xlarge, and linux.rocm.gpu
    secrets:
      github-token:
        required: true
        description: Github Token

permissions:
  id-token: write

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner_prefix}}${{ inputs.runs_on }}
    timeout-minutes: 240
    env:
      PYTORCH_ROOT: ${{ inputs.PYTORCH_ROOT }}
      PACKAGE_TYPE: ${{ inputs.PACKAGE_TYPE }}
      # TODO: This is a legacy variable that we eventually want to get rid of in
      #       favor of GPU_ARCH_VERSION
      DESIRED_CUDA: ${{ inputs.DESIRED_CUDA }}
      GPU_ARCH_VERSION: ${{ inputs.GPU_ARCH_VERSION }}
      GPU_ARCH_TYPE: ${{ inputs.GPU_ARCH_TYPE }}
      DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.DOCKER_IMAGE }}
      SKIP_ALL_TESTS: 1
      LIBTORCH_CONFIG: ${{ inputs.LIBTORCH_CONFIG }}
      LIBTORCH_VARIANT: ${{ inputs.LIBTORCH_VARIANT }}
      DESIRED_PYTHON: ${{ inputs.DESIRED_PYTHON }}
      ALPINE_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.ALPINE_IMAGE }}
      AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1
      BINARY_ENV_FILE: /tmp/env
      BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build_environment }}
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
      PYTORCH_FINAL_PACKAGE_DIR: /artifacts
      SHA1: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Make the env permanent during this workflow (but not the secrets)
        shell: bash
        run: |
          {
            echo "PYTORCH_ROOT=${{ env.PYTORCH_ROOT }}"
            echo "PACKAGE_TYPE=${{ env.PACKAGE_TYPE }}"

            echo "DESIRED_CUDA=${{ env.DESIRED_CUDA }}"
            echo "GPU_ARCH_VERSION=${{ env.GPU_ARCH_VERSION }}"
            echo "GPU_ARCH_TYPE=${{ env.GPU_ARCH_TYPE }}"
            echo "DOCKER_IMAGE=${{ env.DOCKER_IMAGE }}"
            echo "SKIP_ALL_TESTS=${{ env.SKIP_ALL_TESTS }}"
            echo "LIBTORCH_CONFIG=${{ env.LIBTORCH_CONFIG }}"
            echo "LIBTORCH_VARIANT=${{ env.LIBTORCH_VARIANT }}"
            echo "DESIRED_PYTHON=${{ env.DESIRED_PYTHON }}"

            echo "ALPINE_IMAGE=${{ env.ALPINE_IMAGE }}"
            echo "AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=${{ env.AWS_DEFAULT_REGION }}"
            echo "BINARY_ENV_FILE=${{ env.BINARY_ENV_FILE }}"
            echo "BUILD_ENVIRONMENT=${{ env.BUILD_ENVIRONMENT }}"
            echo "PR_NUMBER=${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}"
            echo "PYTORCH_FINAL_PACKAGE_DIR=${{ env.PYTORCH_FINAL_PACKAGE_DIR }}"
            echo "SHA1=${{ env.SHA1 }}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_ENV} }}"

      - name: "[FB EMPLOYEES] Enable SSH (Click me for login details)"
        if: inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-ssh@main
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          github-secret: ${{ secrets.github-token }}

        # Setup the environment
      - name: Checkout PyTorch
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
        with:
          no-sudo: ${{ inputs.build_environment == 'linux-aarch64-binary-manywheel' || inputs.build_environment == 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel' }}

      - name: Setup Linux
        if: inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-linux

      - name: Chown workspace
        if: inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
        uses: ./.github/actions/chown-workspace
        with:
          ALPINE_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.ALPINE_IMAGE }}

      - name: Clean workspace
        shell: bash
        run: |
          rm -rf "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}"
          mkdir "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}"

      - name: Checkout PyTorch to pytorch dir
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          submodules: recursive
          show-progress: false
          path: pytorch

      - name: Clean PyTorch checkout
        run: |
          # Remove any artifacts from the previous checkouts
          git clean -fxd
        working-directory: pytorch

      - name: Check if the job is disabled
        id: filter
        uses: ./pytorch/.github/actions/filter-test-configs
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          # NB: Use a mock test matrix with a default value here. After filtering, if the
          # returned matrix is empty, it means that the job is disabled
          test-matrix: |
            { include: [
              { config: "default" },
            ]}

      - name: Download Build Artifacts
        if: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' }}
        uses: actions/download-artifact@65a9edc5881444af0b9093a5e628f2fe47ea3b2e # v4.1.7
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.build_name }}
          path: "${{ runner.temp }}/artifacts/"

      - name: Install nvidia driver, nvidia-docker runtime, set GPU_FLAG
        id: install-nvidia-driver
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-nvidia@main
        if: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' }}

      - name: configure aws credentials
        id: aws_creds
        if: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' && inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel' && startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/ciflow/') }}
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::308535385114:role/gha_workflow_s3_and_ecr_read_only
          aws-region: us-east-1
          role-duration-seconds: 18000

      - name: Calculate docker image
        id: calculate-docker-image
        if: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' && inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel' }}
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/calculate-docker-image@main
        with:
          docker-registry: ${{ startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/ciflow/') && '308535385114.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com' || 'docker.io' }}
          docker-image-name: ${{ inputs.DOCKER_IMAGE }}
          custom-tag-prefix: ${{ inputs.DOCKER_IMAGE_TAG_PREFIX }}
          docker-build-dir: .ci/docker
          working-directory: pytorch

      - name: Pull Docker image
        if: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' && inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel' }}
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/pull-docker-image@main
        with:
          docker-image: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}

      - name: Test Pytorch binary
        if: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' }}
        uses: ./pytorch/.github/actions/test-pytorch-binary
        env:
          DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image || format('{0}:{1}', inputs.DOCKER_IMAGE, inputs.DOCKER_IMAGE_TAG_PREFIX) }}

      - name: Teardown Linux
        if: always() && inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/teardown-linux@main

      - name: Chown workspace
        if: always() && inputs.build_environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
        uses: ./pytorch/.github/actions/chown-workspace
        with:
          ALPINE_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.ALPINE_IMAGE }}

on:

    inputs:
      build_name:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: The build's name
      use_s3:
        type: boolean
        default: true

      PYTORCH_ROOT:
        required: false
        type: string
        description: Root directory for the pytorch/pytorch repository. Not actually needed, but currently passing it in since we pass in the same inputs to the reusable workflows of all binary builds
      PACKAGE_TYPE:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: Package type
      DESIRED_CUDA:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: Desired CUDA version
      GPU_ARCH_VERSION:
        required: false
        type: string
        description: GPU Arch version
      GPU_ARCH_TYPE:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: GPU Arch type
      DOCKER_IMAGE:
        required: false
        type: string
        description: Docker image to use
      DOCKER_IMAGE_TAG_PREFIX:
        required: false
        type: string
        description: Docker image tag to use
      LIBTORCH_CONFIG:
        required: false
        type: string
        description: Desired libtorch config (for libtorch builds only)
      LIBTORCH_VARIANT:
        required: false
        type: string
        description: Desired libtorch variant (for libtorch builds only)
      DESIRED_PYTHON:
        required: false
        type: string
        description: Desired python version
    secrets:
      github-token:
        required: true
        description: Github Token

jobs:
  upload:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    container:
      image: continuumio/miniconda3:4.12.0
    env:
      PYTORCH_ROOT: /pytorch
      PACKAGE_TYPE: ${{ inputs.PACKAGE_TYPE }}
      # TODO: This is a legacy variable that we eventually want to get rid of in
      #       favor of GPU_ARCH_VERSION
      DESIRED_CUDA: ${{ inputs.DESIRED_CUDA }}
      GPU_ARCH_VERSION: ${{ inputs.GPU_ARCH_VERSION }}
      GPU_ARCH_TYPE: ${{ inputs.GPU_ARCH_TYPE }}
      DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.DOCKER_IMAGE }}
      SKIP_ALL_TESTS: 1
      LIBTORCH_CONFIG: ${{ inputs.LIBTORCH_CONFIG }}
      LIBTORCH_VARIANT: ${{ inputs.LIBTORCH_VARIANT }}
      DESIRED_PYTHON: ${{ inputs.DESIRED_PYTHON }}
      BINARY_ENV_FILE: /tmp/env
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.github-token }}
      PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
      PYTORCH_FINAL_PACKAGE_DIR: /artifacts
      SHA1: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PyTorch
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
        with:
          no-sudo: true

      - name: Configure AWS credentials(PyTorch account) for nightly
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.event.ref == 'refs/heads/nightly' }}
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::749337293305:role/gha_workflow_nightly_build_wheels
          aws-region: us-east-1

      - name: Configure AWS credentials(PyTorch account) for RC builds
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' &&  (startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/') && !startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/ciflow/')) }}
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0
        with:
          role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::749337293305:role/gha_workflow_test_build_wheels
          aws-region: us-east-1

      - name: Download Build Artifacts
        id: download-artifacts
        # NB: When the previous build job is skipped, there won't be any artifacts and
        # this step will fail. Binary build jobs can only be skipped on CI, not nightly
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: actions/download-artifact@65a9edc5881444af0b9093a5e628f2fe47ea3b2e # v4.1.7
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.build_name }}
          path: "${{ runner.temp }}/artifacts/"

      - name: Set DRY_RUN (only for tagged pushes)
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && (github.event.ref == 'refs/heads/nightly' || (startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/') && !startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/ciflow/'))) }}
        run: |
          echo "DRY_RUN=disabled" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Set UPLOAD_CHANNEL (only for tagged pushes)
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/') && !startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/ciflow/') }}
        shell: bash -e -l {0}
        run: |
          # reference ends with an RC suffix
          if [[ "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" = *-rc[0-9]* ]]; then
            echo "UPLOAD_CHANNEL=test" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fi

      - name: Upload binaries
        if: steps.download-artifacts.outcome && steps.download-artifacts.outcome == 'success'
        shell: bash
        env:
          PKG_DIR: "${{ runner.temp }}/artifacts"
          UPLOAD_SUBFOLDER: "${{ env.DESIRED_CUDA }}"
          BUILD_NAME: ${{ inputs.build_name }}
        run: |
            set -ex
            bash .circleci/scripts/binary_upload.sh

name: Get Changed Files

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      all_files:
        description: "Whether to return all files instead of just changed files"
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
    outputs:
      changed-files:
        description: "List of changed files (space-separated) or '*' if not in a PR"
        value: ${{ jobs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files }}

jobs:
  get-changed-files:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      changed-files: ${{ steps.get-files.outputs.changed-files }}

    steps:
      - name: Get changed files
        id: get-files
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          # Check if we're in a pull request context
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "pull_request" ] || [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "pull_request_target" ]; then
            echo "Running in PR context"

            # Get the PR number from the github context
            PR_NUMBER="${{ github.event.number }}"

            # Check if all_files is requested
            if [ "${{ inputs.all_files }}" = "true" ]; then
              echo "all_files input is true, returning all files"
              echo "changed-files=*" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            else
              # Use gh CLI to get changed files in the PR with explicit repo
              CHANGED_FILES=$(gh api repos/${{ github.repository }}/pulls/$PR_NUMBER/files --paginate --jq '.[] | select(.status != "removed") | .filename' | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/ $//')

              # See https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/134215#issuecomment-2332128790
              PYI_FILES_TO_ADD=""
              for file in ${CHANGED_FILES}; do
                if [[ "${file}" == *".pyi.in" ]]; then
                  PYI_FILES_TO_ADD="${PYI_FILES_TO_ADD} ${file//.in/}"
                fi
              done
              CHANGED_FILES="${CHANGED_FILES}${PYI_FILES_TO_ADD}"

              if [ -z "$CHANGED_FILES" ]; then
                echo "No changed files found, setting to '*'"
                CHANGED_FILES="*"
              fi

              echo "Changed files: $CHANGED_FILES"
              echo "changed-files=$CHANGED_FILES" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            fi

          else
            echo "Not in PR context, setting changed files to '*'"
            echo "changed-files=*" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

arguments.content:
name: build docs

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      build-environment:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
      docker-image:
        required: true
        type: string
        description: Docker image to run in.
      push:
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
        description: If set, push the docs to the docs website.
      run-doxygen:
        required: false
        type: boolean
        default: false
        description: If set, will enable C++ API doc generation using doxygen / breathe / exhale.
      sync-tag:
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""
        description: |
          If this is set, our linter will use this to make sure that every other
          job with the same `sync-tag` is identical.
      s3-bucket:
        description: S3 bucket to download artifact
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "gha-artifacts"
      aws-role-to-assume:
        description: role to assume for downloading artifacts
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""
      upload-aws-role-to-assume:
        description: role to assume for downloading artifacts
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ""
      runner_prefix:
        description: prefix for runner label
        type: string
        default: ""
    secrets:
      GH_PYTORCHBOT_TOKEN:
        required: false
        description: Permissions for pushing to the docs site.

jobs:
  build-docs:
    # Don't run on forked repos.
    if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    environment: ${{ (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) && 'pytorchbot-env' || '' }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - docs_type: cpp
            # We recently seeing lots of exit code 137 running this in Docker indicating
            # an OOM issue when running the job, so this upgrades the runner from 4xlarge
            # to the next available tier of 12xlarge. So much memory just to generate cpp
            # doc
            runner: ${{ inputs.runner_prefix }}linux.12xlarge.memory
            # TODO: Nightly cpp docs take longer and longer to finish (more than 3h now)
            # Let's try to figure out how this can be improved
            timeout-minutes: 360
          - docs_type: python
            runner: ${{ inputs.runner_prefix }}linux.c7i.2xlarge
            # It takes less than 30m to finish python docs unless there are issues
            timeout-minutes: 30
    # Set a fixed name for this job instead of using the current matrix-generated name, i.e. build-docs (cpp, linux.12xlarge, 180)
    # The current name requires updating the database last docs push query from test-infra every time the matrix is updated
    name: build-docs-${{ matrix.docs_type }}-${{ inputs.push }}
    steps:
      - name: Setup SSH (Click me for login details)
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-ssh@main
        with:
          github-secret: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          instructions: |
            All builds are done inside the container, to start an interactive session run:
              docker exec -it $(docker container ps --format '{{.ID}}') bash
            To start Python docs build type:
              cd docs && make html && make coverage

      # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
      - name: Checkout PyTorch
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main

      - name: Setup Linux
        uses: ./.github/actions/setup-linux

      - name: configure aws credentials
        if : ${{ inputs.aws-role-to-assume != '' }}
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ inputs.aws-role-to-assume }}
          role-session-name: gha-linux-test
          aws-region: us-east-1

      - name: Calculate docker image
        id: calculate-docker-image
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/calculate-docker-image@main
        with:
          docker-image-name: ${{ inputs.docker-image }}

      - name: Pull docker image
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/pull-docker-image@main
        with:
          docker-image: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}

      - name: Download build artifacts
        uses: ./.github/actions/download-build-artifacts
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
          s3-bucket: ${{ inputs.s3-bucket }}

      - name: Generate netrc (only for docs-push)
        if: inputs.push
        env:
          GITHUB_PYTORCHBOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GH_PYTORCHBOT_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          # sometimes .netrc exists as a directory even though this is the temp folder
          rm -rf "${RUNNER_TEMP}/.netrc"
          # set credentials for https pushing
          echo "machine github.com" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/.netrc"
          echo "login pytorchbot" >> "${RUNNER_TEMP}/.netrc"
          echo "password ${GITHUB_PYTORCHBOT_TOKEN}" >> "${RUNNER_TEMP}/.netrc"

      - name: Build ${{ matrix.docs_type }} docs
        timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.timeout-minutes }}
        id: build-docs
        env:
          # After https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/88373, pull workflow can now be run periodically,
          # so using a schedule event to determine if the docs should be pushed or not doesn't hold true
          # anymore
          WITH_PUSH: ${{ inputs.push }}
          DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.docker-image }}
          DOCS_TYPE: ${{ matrix.docs_type }}
          RUN_DOXYGEN: ${{ inputs.run-doxygen }}
          BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
        run: |
          set -ex
          # Convert refs/tags/v1.12.0rc3 into 1.12
          if [[ "${GITHUB_REF}" =~ ^refs/tags/v([0-9]+\.[0-9]+)\..* ]]; then
            target="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
          else
            target="main"
          fi
          # detached container should get cleaned up by teardown_ec2_linux
          container_name=$(docker run \
            -e BUILD_ENVIRONMENT \
            -e MAX_JOBS="$(nproc --ignore=2)" \
            -e SHA1="$GITHUB_SHA" \
            -e DOCS_VERSION="${target}" \
            -e DOCS_TYPE \
            -e RUN_DOXYGEN \
            -e WITH_PUSH \
            --env-file="/tmp/github_env_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" \
            --security-opt seccomp=unconfined \
            --cap-add=SYS_PTRACE \
            --tty \
            --detach \
            --user jenkins \
            -v "${RUNNER_TEMP}/.netrc":/var/lib/jenkins/.netrc \
            -v "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}:/var/lib/jenkins/workspace" \
            -w /var/lib/jenkins/workspace \
            "${DOCKER_IMAGE}"
          )
          docker exec -t "${container_name}" bash -c "sudo chown -R jenkins . && pip install $(echo dist/*.whl)[opt-einsum] && ./.ci/pytorch/${DOCS_TYPE}_doc_push_script.sh"

      - name: Chown workspace
        uses: ./.github/actions/chown-workspace
        if: always()

      - name: configure aws credentials
        if : ${{ inputs.upload-aws-role-to-assume != '' }}
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ inputs.upload-aws-role-to-assume }}
          role-session-name: gha-linux-test
          aws-region: us-east-1

      - name: Upload Python Docs Preview
        uses: seemethere/upload-artifact-s3@baba72d0712b404f646cebe0730933554ebce96a # v5.1.0
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && matrix.docs_type == 'python' && steps.build-docs.outcome == 'success' }}
        with:
          retention-days: 14
          s3-bucket: doc-previews
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: pytorch_docs/main/
          s3-prefix: pytorch/pytorch/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}

      - name: Upload C++ Docs Preview
        uses: seemethere/upload-artifact-s3@baba72d0712b404f646cebe0730933554ebce96a # v5.1.0
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && matrix.docs_type == 'cpp' && steps.build-docs.outcome == 'success' }}
        with:
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error
          s3-bucket: doc-previews
          path: cppdocs/
          s3-prefix: pytorch/pytorch/${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}/cppdocs

      - name: Teardown Linux
        uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/teardown-linux@main
        if: always()

{"content":"1: name: windows-build
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_call:
5:     inputs:
6:       build-environment:
7:         required: true
8:         type: string
9:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
10:       cuda-version:
11:         required: true
12:         type: string
13:         description: What CUDA version to build with, "cpu" for none.
14:       use-xpu:
15:         required: false
16:         type: boolean
17:         default: false
18:         description: If set, build with XPU support.
19:       xpu-version:
20:         required: false
21:         type: string
22:         description: The version of XPU support package.
23:       vc-year:
24:         required: false
25:         type: string
26:         default: "2022"
27:         description: The Visual Studio year to use for building.
28:       build-with-debug:
29:         required: false
30:         type: boolean
31:         default: false
32:         description: If set, build in debug mode.
33:       sync-tag:
34:         required: false
35:         type: string
36:         default: ""
37:         description: |
38:           If this is set, our linter will use this to make sure that every other
39:           job with the same `sync-tag` is identical.
40:       test-matrix:
41:         required: false
42:         type: string
43:         description: |
44:           An option JSON description of what test configs to run later on. This
45:           is moved here from the Linux test workflow so that we can apply filter
46:           logic using test-config labels earlier and skip unnecessary builds
47:       runner:
48:         required: false
49:         type: string
50:         default: "windows.4xlarge.nonephemeral"
51:         description: |
52:           Label of the runner this job should run on.
53: 
54:     outputs:
55:       test-matrix:
56:         value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.test-matrix }}
57:         description: An optional JSON description of what test configs to run later on.
58:       build-environment:
59:         value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.build-environment }}
60:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
61: 
62: env:
63:   GIT_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
64: 
65: jobs:
66:   build:
67:     # Don't run on forked repos.
68:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
69:     runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner }}
70:     timeout-minutes: 240
71:     outputs:
72:       test-matrix: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.test-matrix }}
73:       build-environment: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
74:     defaults:
75:       run:
76:         shell: bash
77:     steps:
78:       # Duplicated in win-test because this MUST go before a checkout
79:       - name: Enable git long paths and symlinks on Windows and disable fsmonitor daemon
80:         shell: bash
81:         run: |
82:           git config --global core.longpaths true
83:           git config --global core.symlinks true
84:           git config --global core.ignorecase false
85: 
86:           # https://git-scm.com/docs/git-fsmonitor--daemon.  The daemon could lock
87:           # the directory on Windows and prevent GHA from checking out as reported
88:           # in https://github.com/actions/checkout/issues/1018
89:           git config --global core.fsmonitor false
90: 
91:       - name: Setup SSH (Click me for login details)
92:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-ssh@main
93:         with:
94:           github-secret: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
95:           instructions: |
96:             To forward remote desktop on your local machine ssh as follows:
97:               ssh -L 3389:localhost:3389 %%username%%@%%hostname%%
98:             And then change password using `passwd` command.
99: 
100:             To start build locally, change working folder to \actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch,
101:             Activate miniconda and Visual Studio environment, by running:
102:               call C:\Jenkins\Miniconda3\Scripts\activate.bat C:\Jenkins\Miniconda3
103:               call "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x64
104: 
105:       # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
106:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
107:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
108:         with:
109:           no-sudo: true
110: 
111:       - name: Setup Windows
112:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-win
113:         with:
114:           cuda-version: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
115: 
116:       - name: Parse ref
117:         id: parse-ref
118:         shell: bash
119:         run: python3 .github/scripts/parse_ref.py
120: 
121:       - name: Get workflow job id
122:         id: get-job-id
123:         uses: ./.github/actions/get-workflow-job-id
124:         if: always()
125:         with:
126:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
127: 
128:       # Apply the filter logic to the build step too if the test-config label is already there
129:       - name: Select all requested test configurations (if the test matrix is available)
130:         id: filter
131:         uses: ./.github/actions/filter-test-configs
132:         with:
133:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
134:           test-matrix: ${{ inputs.test-matrix }}
135:           job-name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
136: 
137:       - name: Download pytest cache
138:         uses: ./.github/actions/pytest-cache-download
139:         continue-on-error: true
140:         with:
141:           cache_dir: .pytest_cache
142:           job_identifier: ${{ github.workflow }}_${{ inputs.build-environment }}
143: 
144:       - name: Build
145:         if: steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' || inputs.test-matrix == ''
146:         id: build
147:         shell: bash
148:         env:
149:           PYTORCH_FINAL_PACKAGE_DIR: /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results/
150:           BRANCH: ${{ steps.parse-ref.outputs.branch }}
151:           BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
152:           BUILD_WHEEL: 1
153:           MAX_JOBS: 8
154:           CUDA_VERSION: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
155:           PYTHON_VERSION: "3.10"
156:           SCCACHE_BUCKET: "ossci-compiler-cache"
157:           SCCACHE_S3_KEY_PREFIX: ${{ github.workflow }}
158:           SCCACHE_REGION: us-east-1
159:           VC_PRODUCT: "BuildTools"
160:           VC_VERSION: ""
161:           VC_YEAR: "${{ inputs.vc-year }}"
162:           ALPINE_IMAGE: "308535385114.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/tool/alpine"
163:           AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1
164:           PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
165:           SHA1: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
166:           DEBUG: ${{ inputs.build-with-debug && '1' || '0' }}
167:           TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "8.6"
168:           USE_CUDA: ${{ inputs.cuda-version != 'cpu' && '1' || '0' }}
169:           USE_XPU: ${{ inputs.use-xpu == true && '1' || '0' }}
170:           XPU_VERSION: "${{ inputs.xpu-version }}"
171:           OUR_GITHUB_JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
172:         run: |
173:           .ci/pytorch/win-build.sh
174: 
175:       # Collect Windows torch libs and CUDA libs for cross-compilation
176:       - name: Collect Windows CUDA libs for cross-compilation
177:         if: steps.build.outcome != 'skipped' && inputs.cuda-version != 'cpu'
178:         shell: bash
179:         run: |
180:           set -ex
181: 
182:           # Create directory structure if does not exist
183:           mkdir -p /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results
184: 
185:           # Copy CUDA libs
186:           CUDA_PATH="/c/Program Files/NVIDIA GPU Computing Toolkit/CUDA/v${{ inputs.cuda-version }}"
187: 
188:           if [ -f "${CUDA_PATH}/lib/x64/cuda.lib" ]; then
189:             cp "${CUDA_PATH}/lib/x64/cuda.lib" /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results/
190:           fi
191: 
192:           if [ -f "${CUDA_PATH}/lib/x64/cudart.lib" ]; then
193:             cp "${CUDA_PATH}/lib/x64/cudart.lib" /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results/
194:           fi
195: 
196:           # List collected files
197:           echo "Collected CUDA libs:"
198:           ls -lah /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results/*.lib
199: 
200:       # Upload to github so that people can click and download artifacts
201:       - name: Upload artifacts to s3
202:         if: steps.build.outcome != 'skipped'
203:         uses: seemethere/upload-artifact-s3@baba72d0712b404f646cebe0730933554ebce96a # v5.1.0
204:         with:
205:           retention-days: 14
206:           if-no-files-found: error
207:           name: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
208:           path: C:\${{ github.run_id }}\build-results
209: 
210:       - name: Upload sccache stats
211:         if: steps.build.outcome != 'skipped'
212:         uses: ./.github/actions/upload-sccache-stats
213:         with:
214:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
215: 
216:       - name: Teardown Windows
217:         uses: ./.github/actions/teardown-win
218:         if: always()
219:         timeout-minutes: 120
220:         with:
221:           extra-delete-dir: /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results/

{"content":"1: name: win-test
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_call:
5:     inputs:
6:       build-environment:
7:         required: true
8:         type: string
9:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
10:       cuda-version:
11:         required: true
12:         type: string
13:         description: What CUDA version to build with, "cpu" for none.
14:       test-matrix:
15:         required: true
16:         type: string
17:         description: JSON description of what test configs to run.
18:       sync-tag:
19:         required: false
20:         type: string
21:         default: ""
22:         description: |
23:           If this is set, our linter will use this to make sure that every other
24:           job with the same `sync-tag` is identical.
25:       timeout-minutes:
26:         required: false
27:         type: number
28:         default: 240
29:         description: |
30:           Set the maximum (in minutes) how long the workflow should take to finish
31:       disable-monitor:
32:         description: |
33:           [Experimental] Disable utilization monitoring for tests.
34:           Currently, by default we disable the monitor job and only look for specific tests,
35:           since we are investigating the behaviour of the monitor script with different tests.
36:         required: false
37:         type: boolean
38:         default: true
39:       monitor-log-interval:
40:         description: |
41:           Set the interval for the monitor script to log utilization.
42:         required: false
43:         type: number
44:         default: 5
45:       monitor-data-collect-interval:
46:         description: |
47:           Set the interval for the monitor script to collect data.
48:         required: false
49:         type: number
50:         default: 1
51: env:
52:   GIT_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
53: 
54: jobs:
55:   test:
56:     # Don't run on forked repos or empty test matrix
57:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch' && toJSON(fromJSON(inputs.test-matrix).include) != '[]'
58:     strategy:
59:       matrix: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.test-matrix) }}
60:       fail-fast: false
61:     runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
62:     timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check == 'mem_leak_check' && 600 || inputs.timeout-minutes }}
63:     defaults:
64:       run:
65:         shell: bash
66:     steps:
67:       # Duplicated in win-build because this MUST go before a checkout
68:       - name: Enable git long paths and symlinks on Windows and disable fsmonitor daemon
69:         shell: bash
70:         run: |
71:           git config --global core.longpaths true
72:           git config --global core.symlinks true
73:           git config --global core.ignorecase false
74: 
75:           # https://git-scm.com/docs/git-fsmonitor--daemon.  The daemon could lock
76:           # the directory on Windows and prevent GHA from checking out as reported
77:           # in https://github.com/actions/checkout/issues/1018
78:           git config --global core.fsmonitor false
79: 
80:       - name: Setup SSH (Click me for login details)
81:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-ssh@main
82:         with:
83:           github-secret: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
84:           instructions: |
85:             To forward remote desktop on your local machine ssh as follows:
86:               ssh -L 3389:localhost:3389 %%username%%@%%hostname%%
87:             And then change password using `passwd` command.
88: 
89:             To start tests locally, change working folder to \actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\test,
90:             Activate miniconda and Visual Studio environment and set PYTHON_PATH, by running:
91:               call C:\Jenkins\Miniconda3\Scripts\activate.bat C:\Jenkins\Miniconda3
92:               call "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x64
93:               set PYTHONPATH=C:\actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\build\win_tmp\build
94: 
95:       # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
96:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
97:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
98:         with:
99:           no-sudo: true
100: 
101:       - name: Setup Windows
102:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-win
103:         with:
104:           cuda-version: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
105: 
106:       - name: Get workflow job id
107:         id: get-job-id
108:         uses: ./.github/actions/get-workflow-job-id
109:         if: always()
110:         with:
111:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
112: 
113:       - name: Start monitoring script
114:         id: monitor-script
115:         env:
116:           JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
117:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
118:           WORKFLOW_NAME: ${{ github.workflow }}
119:           WORKFLOW_RUN_ID: ${{github.run_id}}
120:           MONITOR_LOG_INTERVAL: ${{ inputs.monitor-log-interval }}
121:           MONITOR_DATA_COLLECT_INTERVAL: ${{ inputs.monitor-data-collect-interval }}
122:         shell: bash
123:         if: ${{ !inputs.disable-monitor }}
124:         continue-on-error: true
125:         run: |
126:           # Windows conda doesn't have python3 binary, only python, but it's python3
127:           ${CONDA_RUN} python -m pip install psutil==5.9.8 dataclasses_json==0.6.7 nvidia-ml-py==11.525.84
128:           ${CONDA_RUN} python -m tools.stats.monitor --log-interval "$MONITOR_LOG_INTERVAL" --data-collect-interval "$MONITOR_DATA_COLLECT_INTERVAL" > usage_log.txt 2>&1 &
129:           echo "monitor-script-pid=${!}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
130: 
131:       - name: Download PyTorch Build Artifacts
132:         uses: seemethere/download-artifact-s3@1da556a7aa0a088e3153970611f6c432d58e80e6 # v4.2.0
133:         with:
134:           name: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
135:           path: C:\${{ github.run_id }}\build-results
136: 
137:       - name: Check build-results folder
138:         shell: powershell
139:         run: |
140:           tree /F C:\$Env:GITHUB_RUN_ID\build-results
141: 
142:       - name: Download TD artifacts
143:         continue-on-error: true
144:         uses: ./.github/actions/download-td-artifacts
145: 
146:       - name: Check for keep-going label and re-enabled test issues
147:         # This uses the filter-test-configs action because it conveniently
148:         # checks for labels and re-enabled test issues.  It does not actually do
149:         # any filtering.  All filtering is done in the build step.
150:         id: keep-going
151:         uses: ./.github/actions/filter-test-configs
152:         with:
153:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
154:           test-matrix: ${{ inputs.test-matrix }}
155:           job-name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
156: 
157:       - name: Set Test step time
158:         id: test-timeout
159:         shell: bash
160:         env:
161:           JOB_TIMEOUT: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check == 'mem_leak_check' && 600 || inputs.timeout-minutes }}
162:         run: |
163:           echo "timeout=$((JOB_TIMEOUT-30))" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
164: 
165:       - name: Test
166:         id: test
167:         shell: bash
168:         timeout-minutes: ${{ fromJson(steps.test-timeout.outputs.timeout) }}
169:         env:
170:           USE_CUDA: ${{ inputs.cuda-version != 'cpu' && '1' || '0' }}
171:           INSTALL_WINDOWS_SDK: 1
172:           PYTHON_VERSION: "3.10"

{"content":"1: # TODO: this looks sort of similar to _linux-test, but there are like a dozen
