5: name: xpu-test
6: 
7: on:
8:   workflow_call:
9:     inputs:
10:       build-environment:
11:         required: true
12:         type: string
13:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
14:       test-matrix:
15:         required: true
16:         type: string
17:         description: JSON description of what test configs to run.
18:       docker-image:
19:         required: true
20:         type: string
21:         description: Docker image to run in.
22:       sync-tag:
23:         required: false
24:         type: string
25:         default: ""
26:         description: |
27:           If this is set, our linter will use this to make sure that every other
28:           job with the same `sync-tag` is identical.
29:       timeout-minutes:
30:         required: false
31:         type: number
32:         default: 390
33:         description: |
34:           Set the maximum (in minutes) how long the workflow should take to finish
35:       tests-to-include:
36:         required: false
37:         type: string
38:         default: ""
39:         description: |
40:           List of tests to include (empty string implies default list)
41:       dashboard-tag:
42:         required: false
43:         type: string
44:         default: ""
45:       disable-monitor:
46:         description: |
47:           [Experimental] Disable utilization monitoring for tests.
48:           Currently, by default we disable the monitor job and only look for specific tests,
49:           since we are investigating the behaviour of the monitor script with different tests.
50:         required: false
51:         type: boolean
52:         default: true
53:       monitor-log-interval:
54:         description: |
55:           Set the interval for the monitor script to log utilization.
56:         required: false
57:         type: number
58:         default: 5
59:       monitor-data-collect-interval:
60:         description: |
61:           Set the interval for the monitor script to collect data.
62:         required: false
63:         type: number
64:         default: 1
65:     secrets:
66:       HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN:
67:         required: false
68:         description: |
69:           HF Auth token to avoid rate limits when downloading models or datasets from hub
70: permissions:
71:   id-token: write
72:   contents: read
73: 
74: env:
75:   GIT_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
76: 
77: jobs:
78:   test:
79:     # Don't run on forked repos or empty test matrix
80:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch' && toJSON(fromJSON(inputs.test-matrix).include) != '[]'
81:     strategy:
82:       matrix: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.test-matrix) }}

84:     timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check == 'mem_leak_check' && 600 || inputs.timeout-minutes }}
85:     runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
86:     steps:
87:       # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
88:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
89:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
90: 
91:       - name: Setup XPU
92:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-xpu
93: 
94:       - name: configure aws credentials
95:         id: aws_creds
96:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0
97:         with:
98:           role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::308535385114:role/gha_workflow_s3_and_ecr_read_only
99:           aws-region: us-east-1
100: 
101:       - name: Login to Amazon ECR
102:         id: login-ecr
103:         uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@062b18b96a7aff071d4dc91bc00c4c1a7945b076 # v2.0.1
104: 
105:       - name: Calculate docker image
106:         id: calculate-docker-image
107:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/calculate-docker-image@main
108:         with:
109:           docker-image-name: ${{ inputs.docker-image }}
110: 
111:       - name: Use following to pull public copy of the image
112:         id: print-ghcr-mirror
113:         env:
114:           ECR_DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
115:         shell: bash
116:         run: |
117:           tag=${ECR_DOCKER_IMAGE##*:}
118:           echo "docker pull ghcr.io/pytorch/ci-image:${tag/:/-}"
119:

121:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/pull-docker-image@main
122:         with:
123:           docker-image: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
124: 
125:       - name: Get workflow job id
126:         id: get-job-id
127:         uses: ./.github/actions/get-workflow-job-id
128:         if: always()
129:         with:
130:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
131: 
132:       - name: Start monitoring script
133:         id: monitor-script
134:         if: ${{ !inputs.disable-monitor }}
135:         shell: bash
136:         continue-on-error: true
137:         env:
138:           JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
139:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
140:           WORKFLOW_NAME: ${{ github.workflow }}
141:           WORKFLOW_RUN_ID: ${{github.run_id}}
142:           MONITOR_LOG_INTERVAL: ${{ inputs.monitor-log-interval }}
143:           MONITOR_DATA_COLLECT_INTERVAL: ${{ inputs.monitor-data-collect-interval }}
144:         run: |
145:           python3 -m pip install psutil==5.9.8 dataclasses_json==0.6.7 nvidia-ml-py==11.525.84
146:           python3 -m tools.stats.monitor --log-interval "$MONITOR_LOG_INTERVAL" --data-collect-interval "$MONITOR_DATA_COLLECT_INTERVAL" > usage_log.txt 2>&1 &
147:           echo "monitor-script-pid=${!}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
148: 
149:       - name: Download build artifacts

151:         with:
152:           name: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
153: 
154:       - name: Parse ref
155:         id: parse-ref
156:         run: .github/scripts/parse_ref.py
157: 
158:       - name: Check for keep-going label and re-enabled test issues
159:         # This uses the filter-test-configs action because it conveniently
160:         # checks for labels and re-enabled test issues.  It does not actually do
161:         # any filtering.  All filtering is done in the build step.
162:         id: keep-going
163:         uses: ./.github/actions/filter-test-configs
164:         with:
165:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
166:           test-matrix: ${{ inputs.test-matrix }}
167:           job-name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
168: 
169:       - name: Set Test step time
170:         id: test-timeout
171:         shell: bash
172:         env:
173:           JOB_TIMEOUT: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check == 'mem_leak_check' && 600 || inputs.timeout-minutes }}
174:         run: |
175:           echo "timeout=$((JOB_TIMEOUT-30))" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
176: 
177:       - name: Test
178:         id: test
179:         env:
180:           BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
181:           PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
182:           GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
183:           GITHUB_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}
184:           GITHUB_JOB: ${{ github.job }}
185:           GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
186:           GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
187:           GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
188:           JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
189:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
190:           BRANCH: ${{ steps.parse-ref.outputs.branch }}
191:           SHA1: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
192:           PYTORCH_RETRY_TEST_CASES: 1
193:           PYTORCH_OVERRIDE_FLAKY_SIGNAL: 1
194:           CONTINUE_THROUGH_ERROR: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.keep-going }}
195:           TEST_SHOWLOCALS: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-test-showlocals }}
196:           VERBOSE_TEST_LOGS: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-verbose-test-logs }}
197:           NO_TEST_TIMEOUT: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-no-test-timeout }}
198:           NO_TD: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-no-td }}
199:           TEST_CONFIG: ${{ matrix.config }}

202:           REENABLED_ISSUES: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.reenabled-issues }}
203:           DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.docker-image }}

205:           PYTORCH_TEST_CUDA_MEM_LEAK_CHECK: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check && '1' || '0' }}
206:           PYTORCH_TEST_RERUN_DISABLED_TESTS: ${{ matrix.rerun_disabled_tests && '1' || '0' }}

208:           DASHBOARD_TAG: ${{ inputs.dashboard-tag }}
209:           HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN }}
210:         timeout-minutes: ${{ fromJson(steps.test-timeout.outputs.timeout) }}
211:         run: |
212:           # Fetch aws credential from IMDs
213:           eval "$(python3 .github/scripts/get_aws_session_tokens.py)"

14:   DOCKER_BUILDKIT: 1
15:   WITH_PUSH: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/release') || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) }}
16: 
17: concurrency:
18:   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
19:   cancel-in-progress: true
20: 
21: jobs:
22:   build-docker-cpu-s390x:
23:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
24:     environment: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/release') || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) && 'docker-build') || '' }}
25:     runs-on: linux.s390x
26:     steps:
27:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
28:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
29:         with:
30:           submodules: false
31:           no-sudo: true
32: 
33:       - name: Build Docker Image
34:         run: |
35:           .ci/docker/manywheel/build.sh manylinuxs390x-builder:cpu-s390x -t manylinuxs390x-builder:cpu-s390x
36: 
37:       - name: Tag and (if WITH_PUSH) push docker image to docker.io
38:         env:
39:           DOCKER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_TOKEN }}
40:           DOCKER_ID: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_ID }}
41:           CREATED_FULL_DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME: manylinuxs390x-builder:cpu-s390x
42:         shell: bash
43:         run: |
44:           set -euox pipefail
45:           GITHUB_REF="${GITHUB_REF:-$(git symbolic-ref -q HEAD || git describe --tags --exact-match)}"
46:           GIT_BRANCH_NAME="${GITHUB_REF##*/}"
47:           GIT_COMMIT_SHA="${GITHUB_SHA:-$(git rev-parse HEAD)}"
48:           CI_FOLDER_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD:.ci/docker)"
49: 
50:           DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX="docker.io/pytorch/${CREATED_FULL_DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME}"
51: 
52:           docker tag "${CREATED_FULL_DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME}" "${DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX}-${GIT_BRANCH_NAME}"
53:           docker tag "${CREATED_FULL_DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME}" "${DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX}-${GIT_COMMIT_SHA}"
54:           docker tag "${CREATED_FULL_DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME}" "${DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX}-${CI_FOLDER_SHA}"
55: 
56:           # Pretty sure Github will mask tokens and I'm not sure if it will even be
57:           # printed due to pipe, but just in case
58:           set +x
59:           if [[ "${WITH_PUSH:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
60:             echo "${DOCKER_TOKEN}" | docker login -u "${DOCKER_ID}" --password-stdin
61:             docker push "${DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX}-${GIT_BRANCH_NAME}"
62:             docker push "${DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX}-${GIT_COMMIT_SHA}"
63:             docker push "${DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX}-${CI_FOLDER_SHA}"
64:           fi
65: 
66:       - name: Cleanup docker
67:         if: cancelled()
68:         shell: bash
69:         run: |
70:           # If podman build command is interrupted,
71:           # it can leave a couple of processes still running.
72:           # Order them to stop for clean shutdown.
73:           # It looks like sometimes some processes remain
74:           # after first cleanup.
75:           # Wait a bit and do cleanup again. It looks like it helps.
76:           docker system prune --build -f || true
77:           sleep 60
78:           docker system prune --build -f || true

{"content":"1: name: Build Triton wheels
2: 
3: on:
4:   push:
5:     branches:
6:       - main
7:     tags:
8:       # NOTE: Binary build pipelines should only get triggered on release candidate builds
9:       # Release candidate tags look like: v1.11.0-rc1
10:       - v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+-rc[0-9]+
11:       - 'ciflow/triton_binaries/*'
12:     paths:
13:       - .github/workflows/build-triton-wheel.yml
14:       - .github/scripts/build_triton_wheel.py
15:       - .github/ci_commit_pins/triton.txt
16:       - .github/scripts/windows/install_vs2022.ps1
17:       - .github/scripts/windows/build_triton.bat
18:       - .ci/docker/ci_commit_pins/triton.txt
19:       - .ci/docker/ci_commit_pins/triton-xpu.txt
20:   workflow_dispatch:
21:   pull_request:
22:     paths:
23:       - .github/workflows/build-triton-wheel.yml
24:       - .github/scripts/build_triton_wheel.py
25:       - .github/ci_commit_pins/triton.txt
26:       - .github/scripts/windows/install_vs2022.ps1
27:       - .github/scripts/windows/build_triton.bat
28:       - .ci/docker/ci_commit_pins/triton.txt
29:       - .ci/docker/ci_commit_pins/triton-xpu.txt
30: 
31: concurrency:
32:   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
33:   cancel-in-progress: true
34: 
35: jobs:
36:   get-label-type:
37:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
38:     name: get-label-type
39:     uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/workflows/_runner-determinator.yml@main
40:     with:
41:       triggering_actor: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
42:       issue_owner: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login || github.event.issue.user.login }}
43:       curr_branch: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
44:       curr_ref_type: ${{ github.ref_type }}
45: 
46:   build-wheel:
47:     name: "Build Triton Wheel"
48:     needs: get-label-type
49:     runs-on: ${{ matrix.runs_on }}
50:     strategy:
51:       fail-fast: false
52:       matrix:
53:         py_vers: [ "3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13", "3.13t", "3.14", "3.14t" ]
54:         device: ["cuda", "rocm", "xpu", "aarch64"]
55:         docker-image: ["pytorch/manylinux2_28-builder:cpu"]
56:         include:
57:           - device: "rocm"
58:             rocm_version: "7.1"
59:             runs_on: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.4xlarge"
60:           - device: "cuda"
61:             rocm_version: ""
62:             runs_on: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.4xlarge"
63:           - device: "xpu"
64:             rocm_version: ""
65:             runs_on: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.4xlarge"
66:           - device: "aarch64"
67:             rocm_version: ""
68:             runs_on: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.arm64.2xlarge"
69:     timeout-minutes: 40
70:     env:
71:       DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ matrix.device == 'rocm' && format('pytorch/manylinux2_28-builder:rocm{0}', matrix.rocm_version) || matrix.device == 'aarch64' && 'pytorch/manylinux2_28_aarch64-builder:cpu-aarch64' || matrix.docker-image }}
72:       PY_VERS: ${{ matrix.py_vers }}
73:       BUILD_DEVICE: ${{ matrix.device }}
74:       PLATFORM: 'manylinux_2_28_x86_64'
75:     steps:
76:       - name: Setup SSH (Click me for login details)
77:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-ssh@main
78:         with:
79:           github-secret: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
80: 
81:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
82:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
83:         with:
84:           submodules: false
85: 
86:       - name: Setup Linux
87:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-linux
88: 
89:       - name: Pull Docker image
90:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/pull-docker-image@main
91:         with:
92:           docker-image: ${{ env.DOCKER_IMAGE }}
93: 
94:       - name: Build Triton wheel
95:         env:
96:           IS_RELEASE_TAG: ${{ startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/v') }}
97:         run: |
98:           set -x
99:           mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/artifacts/"
100:           container_name=$(docker run \
101:             --tty \
102:             --detach \
103:             -v "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}:/pytorch" \
104:             -v "${RUNNER_TEMP}/artifacts:/artifacts" \
105:             -w /artifacts/ \
106:             "${DOCKER_IMAGE}"      \
107:           )
108:

{"content":"1: name: Check Labels
2: 
3: on:

5:   # Only allow pull_request_target when merging to main, not some historical branch.
6:   #
7:   # Make sure to don't introduce explicit checking out and installing/running
8:   # untrusted user code into this workflow!
9:   pull_request_target:
10:     types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]
11:     branches: [main]
12: 
13:   # To check labels on ghstack PRs.
14:   # Note: as pull_request doesn't trigger on PRs targeting main,
15:   # to test changes to the workflow itself one needs to create
16:   # a PR that targets a gh/**/base branch.
17:   pull_request:
18:     types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]
19:     branches: [gh/**/base]
20: 
21:   workflow_dispatch:
22:     inputs:
23:       pr_number:
24:         description: 'PR number to check labels for'
25:         required: true
26: 
27: concurrency:
28:   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}

{"content":"1: name: Create Release
2: 
3: on:
4:   push:
5:     branches:
6:       - main
7:       - release/*
8:     tags:
9:       # Final Release tags look like: v1.11.0
10:       - v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+
11:       # Release candidate tags look like: v1.11.0-rc1
12:       - v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+-rc[0-9]+
13:   release:
14:     types: [published]
15:   pull_request:
16:     paths: [.github/workflows/create_release.yml]
17: 
18: jobs:
19:   get-label-type:
20:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
21:     name: get-label-type
22:     uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/workflows/_runner-determinator.yml@main
23:     with:
24:       triggering_actor: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
25:       issue_owner: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login || github.event.issue.user.login }}
26:       curr_branch: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
27:       curr_ref_type: ${{ github.ref_type }}
28: 
29:   release:
30:     if: ${{ github.repository == 'pytorch/pytorch' }}
31:     name: Create Release
32:     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
33:     # https://github.com/softprops/action-gh-release?tab=readme-ov-file#permissions
34:     permissions:
35:       contents: write
36:     outputs:
37:       pt_release_name: ${{ steps.release_name.outputs.pt_release_name }}
38:       pt_pep517_release_name: ${{ steps.release_name.outputs.pt_pep517_release_name }}
39:     steps:
40:       - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
41:         with:
42:           show-progress: false
43:           submodules: 'recursive'
44:           ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
45:       - name: Fake name for PRs
46:         if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
47:         run: echo "PT_GITHUB_REF=refs/tags/pr-tag" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
48:       - name: Real name for non-PRs
49:         if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
50:         run: echo "PT_GITHUB_REF=$GITHUB_REF" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
51:       - name: Set filenames
52:         run: |
53:           tag_or_branch="${PT_GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}"
54:           tag_or_branch="${tag_or_branch#refs/heads/}"
55:           # replace directory separators with _ in branch name
56:           tag_or_branch="${tag_or_branch//\//_}"
57:           torch_version="$(python -c 'from tools.generate_torch_version import get_torch_version; print(get_torch_version())')"
58:           {
59:             echo "PT_RELEASE_NAME=pytorch-$tag_or_branch";
60:             echo "PT_RELEASE_FILE=pytorch-$tag_or_branch.tar.gz";
61:             echo "PT_PEP517_RELEASE_FILE=torch-${torch_version}.tar.gz";
62:           } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
63:       - name: Checkout optional submodules
64:         run: python3 tools/optional_submodules.py
65:       - name: Copy docs requirements for inclusion
66:         run: |
67:           # Replace symlink with actual file
68:           rm docs/requirements.txt || true
69:           cp .ci/docker/requirements-docs.txt docs/requirements.txt
70:       - name: Create source distribution
71:         run: |
72:           # Create new folder with specified name so extracting the archive yields that
73:           rm -rf "/tmp/$PT_RELEASE_NAME"
74:           cp -r "$PWD" "/tmp/$PT_RELEASE_NAME"
75:           mv "/tmp/$PT_RELEASE_NAME" .
76:           # Cleanup
77:           rm -rf "$PT_RELEASE_NAME"/{.circleci,.ci}
78:           find "$PT_RELEASE_NAME" -name '.git*' -exec rm -rv {} \; || true
79:           # Create archive
80:           tar -czf "$PT_RELEASE_FILE" "$PT_RELEASE_NAME"
81:           echo "Created source archive $PT_RELEASE_FILE with content: $(ls -a "$PT_RELEASE_NAME")"
82:       - name: Create PEP 517 compatible source distribution
83:         run: |
84:           pip install build==1.2.2.post1 || exit 1
85:           python -m build --sdist || exit 1
86:           cd dist || exit 1
87:       - name: Upload source distribution for release
88:         if: ${{ github.event_name == 'release' }}
89:         uses: softprops/action-gh-release@da05d552573ad5aba039eaac05058a918a7bf631 # v2.2.2
90:         with:
91:           files: |
92:             ${{ env.PT_RELEASE_FILE }}
93:             ${{ env.PT_PEP517_RELEASE_FILE }}
94:       - name: Upload source distribution to GHA artifacts  # for release tags
95:         if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') && contains(github.ref, 'rc') }}
96:         uses: actions/upload-artifact@50769540e7f4bd5e21e526ee35c689e35e0d6874 # v4.4.0
97:         with:
98:           name: ${{ env.PT_RELEASE_FILE }}
99:           path: ${{ env.PT_RELEASE_FILE }}
100:       - name: Upload PEP 517 source distribution to GHA artifacts  # for release tags
101:         if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') && contains(github.ref, 'rc') }}
102:         uses: actions/upload-artifact@50769540e7f4bd5e21e526ee35c689e35e0d6874 # v4.4.0
103:         with:
104:           name: ${{ env.PT_PEP517_RELEASE_FILE }}
105:           path: dist/${{ env.PT_PEP517_RELEASE_FILE }}
106:       - name: Set output
107:         id: release_name
108:         run: |
109:           {
110:             echo "pt_release_name=${{ env.PT_RELEASE_FILE }}";
111:             echo "pt_pep517_release_name=${{ env.PT_PEP517_RELEASE_FILE }}";
112:           } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
113: 
114:   upload_source_code_to_s3:
115:     if: ${{ github.repository == 'pytorch/pytorch' && github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') && contains(github.ref, 'rc') }}
116:     runs-on: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
117:     environment: sourcecode-upload
118:     name: Upload source code to S3 for release tags
119:     permissions:
120:       id-token: write
121:     needs:
122:       - get-label-type
123:       - release
124:     steps:
125:       - uses: actions/download-artifact@65a9edc5881444af0b9093a5e628f2fe47ea3b2e # v4.1.7
126:         with:
127:           name: ${{ needs.release.outputs.pt_release_name }}
128:       - uses: actions/download-artifact@65a9edc5881444af0b9093a5e628f2fe47ea3b2e # v4.1.7
129:         with:
130:           name: ${{ needs.release.outputs.pt_pep517_release_name }}
131:       - name: Configure AWS credentials(PyTorch account)
132:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0
133:         with:
134:           role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::749337293305:role/gha_pytorch_source_code_upload_role
135:           aws-region: us-east-1
136:       - uses: seemethere/upload-artifact-s3@baba72d0712b404f646cebe0730933554ebce96a # v5.1.0
137:         with:
138:           s3-bucket: pytorch
139:           s3-prefix: source_code/test
140:           if-no-files-found: warn
141:           path: |
142:             ${{ needs.release.outputs.pt_release_name }}
143:             ${{ needs.release.outputs.pt_pep517_release_name }}
144: 
145: concurrency:
146:   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}-${{ github.event_name }}
147:   cancel-in-progress: true

17:       - .github/workflows/docker-builds.yml
18:       - .lintrunner.toml
19:   schedule:
20:     - cron: 1 3 * * 3
21: 
22: concurrency:
23:   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
24:   cancel-in-progress: true

26: env:

32: jobs:

36:     uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/workflows/_runner-determinator.yml@main
37:     with:

45:     needs: get-label-type

47:     strategy:

64:           pytorch-linux-noble-rocm-n-py3,
65:           pytorch-linux-jammy-rocm-n-py3-benchmarks,
66:           pytorch-linux-jammy-cuda12.8-cudnn9-py3.10-clang12,
67:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3.10-gcc11,
68:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3-gcc11-inductor-benchmarks,
69:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3.12-halide,
70:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3.12-pallas,
71:           pytorch-linux-jammy-cuda12.8-py3.12-pallas,
72:           pytorch-linux-jammy-xpu-n-1-py3,
73:           pytorch-linux-noble-xpu-n-py3,
74:           pytorch-linux-noble-xpu-n-py3-inductor-benchmarks,
75:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3-clang18-asan,
76:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3-clang12-onnx,
77:           pytorch-linux-jammy-linter,
78:           pytorch-linux-jammy-cuda12.8-cudnn9-py3.10-linter,
79:           # TODO: Re-enable me when docker pin update happens
80:           # pytorch-linux-jammy-py3-clang12-executorch,
81:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3.12-triton-cpu,

84:         include:

88:             runner: linux.arm64.m7g.4xlarge
89:           - docker-image-name: pytorch-linux-jammy-aarch64-py3.10-gcc13-inductor-benchmarks
90:             runner: linux.arm64.m7g.4xlarge
91:             timeout-minutes: 600

93:     # runs-on: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}${{ matrix.runner }}"
94:     runs-on: "${{ matrix.runner }}"
95:     steps:
96:       - name: Clean workspace

99:           echo "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}"
100:           sudo rm -rf "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}"
101:           mkdir "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}"
102: 
103:       # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
104:       # deep clone (fetch-depth 0) required for git merge-base
105:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
106:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
107: 
108:       - name: Setup Linux
109:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-linux
110: 
111:       - name: Build docker image
112:         id: build-docker-image
113:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/calculate-docker-image@main
114:         with:
115:           docker-image-name: ci-image:${{ matrix.docker-image-name }}
116:           always-rebuild: true
117:           push: true

120:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/pull-docker-image@main
121:         with:
122:           docker-image: ${{ steps.build-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
123: 
124:       - name: Generate output
125:         if: contains(matrix.docker-image-name, 'rocm')
126:         id: generate_output
127:         run: |
128:           docker_image_name="${{ matrix.docker-image-name }}"
129:           docker_image_tag="${{ steps.build-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}"
130:           echo "${docker_image_name}=${docker_image_tag}" >> docker-builds-output-${docker_image_name}.txt
131: 
132:       - name: Upload artifacts
133:         uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4.4.0

135:         with:

140:       - uses: nick-fields/retry@7152eba30c6575329ac0576536151aca5a72780e # v3.0.0
141:         name: Push to https://ghcr.io/
142:         id: push-to-ghcr-io

147:         with:

150:           max_attempts: 5
151:           retry_wait_seconds: 90
152:           command: |
153:             ghcr_image="ghcr.io/pytorch/ci-image"
154:             tag=${ECR_DOCKER_IMAGE##*:}
155:             # Push docker image to the ghcr.io
156:             echo $GHCR_PAT | docker login ghcr.io -u pytorch --password-stdin
157:             docker tag "${ECR_DOCKER_IMAGE}" "${ghcr_image}:${tag}"
158:             docker push "${ghcr_image}:${tag}"

161:         uses: ./.github/actions/chown-workspace
162:         with:
163:           ALPINE_IMAGE: 308535385114.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/${{ contains(matrix.runner, 'arm64') && 'arm64v8' || 'tool' }}/alpine
164:         if: always()
165: 
166:       - name: Teardown Linux
167:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/teardown-linux@main
168:         if: always()

{"content":"1: name: docker-cache-rocm
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_run:
5:     workflows: [docker-builds]
6:     branches: [main, release]
7:     types:
8:       - completed
9:   workflow_dispatch:
10:     inputs:
11:       branch:
12:         type: string
13:         description: Branch corresponding to the docker images being cached
14:         required: true
15:       run_id:
16:         type: string
17:         description: Workflow run id to pull artifacts from
18:         required: true
19: 
20: concurrency:
21:   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch || github.event.inputs.branch }}
22:   cancel-in-progress: true
23: 
24: permissions:
25:   id-token: write
26:   contents: read
27:   actions: read
28: 
29: jobs:
30:   download-docker-builds-artifacts:
31:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
32:     name: download-docker-builds-artifacts
33:     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
34:     outputs:
35:       pytorch-linux-jammy-rocm-n-py3: ${{ steps.process-artifacts.outputs.pytorch-linux-jammy-rocm-n-py3 }}
36:       pytorch-linux-noble-rocm-n-py3: ${{ steps.process-artifacts.outputs.pytorch-linux-noble-rocm-n-py3 }}
37:       pytorch-linux-jammy-rocm-n-py3-benchmarks: ${{ steps.process-artifacts.outputs.pytorch-linux-jammy-rocm-n-py3-benchmarks }}
38:     steps:
39:       - name: Download artifacts
40:         uses: actions/download-artifact@65a9edc5881444af0b9093a5e628f2fe47ea3b2e #4.1.7
41:         with:
42:           run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id || github.event.inputs.run_id }}
43:           path: ./docker-builds-artifacts
44:           merge-multiple: true
45:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
46: 
47:       - name: Process artifacts
48:         id: process-artifacts
49:         run: |
50:           ls -R ./docker-builds-artifacts
51:           cat ./docker-builds-artifacts/*txt >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
52:           cat "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
53: 
54:   docker-cache:
55:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
56:     needs: download-docker-builds-artifacts
57:     strategy:
58:       fail-fast: false
59:       matrix:
60:         runner: [linux.rocm.gfx942.docker-cache, linux.rocm.mi250.docker-cache]
61:         docker-image: [
62:           "${{ needs.download-docker-builds-artifacts.outputs.pytorch-linux-jammy-rocm-n-py3 }}",
63:           "${{ needs.download-docker-builds-artifacts.outputs.pytorch-linux-noble-rocm-n-py3 }}"
64:           #"${{ needs.download-docker-builds-artifacts.outputs.pytorch-linux-jammy-rocm-n-py3-benchmarks }}"
65:         ]
66:     runs-on: "${{ matrix.runner }}"
67:     steps:
68:       - name: debug
69:         run: |
70:           JSON_STRINGIFIED="${{ toJSON(needs.download-docker-builds-artifacts.outputs) }}"
71:           echo "Outputs of download-docker-builds-artifacts job: ${JSON_STRINGIFIED}"
72: 
73:       - name: configure aws credentials
74:         id: aws_creds
75:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0
76:         with:
77:           role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::308535385114:role/gha_workflow_s3_and_ecr_read_only
78:           aws-region: us-east-1
79:           role-duration-seconds: 18000
80: 
81:       - name: Login to Amazon ECR
82:         id: login-ecr
83:         continue-on-error: false
84:         uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@062b18b96a7aff071d4dc91bc00c4c1a7945b076 # v2.0.1
85: 
86:       - name: Generate ghrc.io tag
87:         id: ghcr-io-tag
88:         run: |
89:             ecr_image="${{ matrix.docker-image }}"
90:             ghcr_image="ghcr.io/pytorch/ci-image:${ecr_image##*:}"

arguments.content:
name: Build almalinux docker images

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - release/*
    tags:
      # NOTE: Binary build pipelines should only get triggered on release candidate or nightly builds
      # Release candidate tags look like: v1.11.0-rc1
      - v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+-rc[0-9]+
    paths:
      - .ci/docker/**
      - .github/workflows/build-almalinux-images.yml
      - .github/actions/binary-docker-build/**
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .ci/docker/**
      - .github/workflows/build-almalinux-images.yml
      - .github/actions/binary-docker-build/**

env:
  DOCKER_REGISTRY: "docker.io"
  DOCKER_BUILDKIT: 1
  WITH_PUSH: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/release') || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) }}

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build-docker:
    if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
    environment: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/release') || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) && 'docker-build') || '' }}
    runs-on: linux.9xlarge.ephemeral
    strategy:
      matrix:
        tag: ["cuda12.6", "cuda12.8", "cuda12.9", "cuda13.0", "rocm7.0", "rocm7.1", "cpu"]
    steps:
      - name: Build docker image
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/binary-docker-build@main
        with:
          docker-image-name: almalinux-builder
          custom-tag-prefix: ${{matrix.tag}}
          docker-build-dir: almalinux
          DOCKER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_TOKEN }}
          DOCKER_ID: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_ID }}

{"content":"1: # The point of this workflow is to test that a FA3 wheel that was built based off the
2: # stable ABI as of torch nightly 20250830 can still run on the newer torch.
3: #
4: # This workflow is very similar to the _linux-test.yml workflow, with the following
5: # differences:
6: #   1. It is simpler (there is no test matrix)
7: #   2. It pulls flash-attention as a secondary repository in order to access the tests.
8: #      Note that it does not BUILD anything from flash-attention, as we have a prebuilt
9: #      wheel. We pull flash-attention only to run a few tests.
10: #   3. It runs only FA3 tests. No PyTorch tests are run.
11: name: linux-test-stable-fa3
12: 
13: on:
14:   workflow_call:
15:     inputs:
16:       build-environment:
17:         required: true
18:         type: string
19:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
20:       docker-image:
21:         required: true
22:         type: string
23:         description: Docker image to run in.
24:       timeout-minutes:
25:         required: false
26:         type: number
27:         default: 30
28:         description: |
29:           Set the maximum (in minutes) how long the workflow should take to finish
30:       s3-bucket:
31:         description: S3 bucket to download artifact
32:         required: false
33:         type: string
34:         default: "gha-artifacts"
35:     secrets:
36:       HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN:
37:         required: false
38:         description: |
39:           HF Auth token to avoid rate limits when downloading models or datasets from hub
40:       VLLM_TEST_HUGGING_FACE_TOKEN:
41:         required: false
42:         description: |
43:           HF Auth token to test vllm
44:       SCRIBE_GRAPHQL_ACCESS_TOKEN:
45:         required: false
46:         description: |
47:           FB app token to write to scribe endpoint
48: 
49: env:
50:   GIT_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
51: 
52: jobs:
53:   test:
54:     # Don't run on forked repos
55:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
56:     runs-on: linux.aws.h100
57:     timeout-minutes: ${{ inputs.timeout-minutes || 30 }}
58:     permissions:
59:       id-token: write
60:       contents: read
61:     steps:
62:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
63:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
64:         with:
65:           no-sudo: true
66: 
67:       - name: Checkout flash-attention as a secondary repository
68:         uses: actions/checkout@v4
69:         with:
70:           repository: Dao-AILab/flash-attention
71:           path: flash-attention
72: 
73:       - name: Setup Linux
74:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-linux
75: 
76:       - name: Calculate docker image
77:         id: calculate-docker-image
78:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/calculate-docker-image@main
79:         with:
80:           docker-image-name: ${{ inputs.docker-image }}
81: 
82:       - name: Use following to pull public copy of the image
83:         id: print-ghcr-mirror
84:         env:
85:           ECR_DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
86:         shell: bash
87:         run: |
88:           tag=${ECR_DOCKER_IMAGE##*:}
89:           echo "docker pull ghcr.io/pytorch/ci-image:${tag/:/-}"
90: 
91:       - name: Pull docker image
92:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/pull-docker-image@main
93:         with:
94:           docker-image: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
95: 
96:       - name: Check if in a container runner
97:         shell: bash
98:         id: check_container_runner
99:         run: echo "IN_CONTAINER_RUNNER=$(if [ -f /.inarc ] || [ -f /.incontainer ]; then echo true ; else echo false; fi)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
100: 
101:       - name: Setup GPU_FLAG for docker run
102:         id: setup-gpu-flag
103:         run: echo "GPU_FLAG=--gpus all -e NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=all" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
104: 
105:       - name: Setup SCCACHE_SERVER_PORT environment for docker run when on container
106:         id: setup-sscache-port-flag
107:         run: echo "SCCACHE_SERVER_PORT_DOCKER_FLAG=-e SCCACHE_SERVER_PORT=$((RUNNER_UID + 4226))" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
108:         if: ${{ steps.check_container_runner.outputs.IN_CONTAINER_RUNNER == 'true' }}
109: 
110:       - name: Get workflow job id
111:         id: get-job-id
112:         uses: ./.github/actions/get-workflow-job-id
113:         if: always()
114:         with:
115:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

121:           s3-bucket: ${{ inputs.s3-bucket }}
122: 
123:       - name: Parse ref

125:         run: .github/scripts/parse_ref.py
126: 
127:       - name: Set Test step time
128:         id: test-timeout
129:         shell: bash
130:         env:
131:           JOB_TIMEOUT: ${{ inputs.timeout-minutes }}
132:         run: |
133:           echo "timeout=$((JOB_TIMEOUT-30))" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
134: 
135:       - name: Preserve github env variables for use in docker

137:         run: |
138:           env | grep '^GITHUB' >> "/tmp/github_env_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"

140: 
141:       - name: Test
142:         id: test
143:         timeout-minutes: ${{ fromJson(steps.test-timeout.outputs.timeout) }}
144:         env:
145:           BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
146:           PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
147:           GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
148:           GITHUB_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}
149:           GITHUB_JOB: ${{ github.job }}
150:           GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
151:           GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
152:           GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
153:           JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
154:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
155:           BRANCH: ${{ steps.parse-ref.outputs.branch }}
156:           SHA1: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
157:           BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.sha }}
158:           SHM_SIZE: '2g'
159:           DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.docker-image }}
160:           VLLM_TEST_HUGGING_FACE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VLLM_TEST_HUGGING_FACE_TOKEN }}
161:           HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN }}
162:           SCRIBE_GRAPHQL_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SCRIBE_GRAPHQL_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
163:           ARTIFACTS_FILE_SUFFIX: ${{ github.job }}-${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
164:         run: |
165:           set -x
166: 
167:           TEST_COMMAND=.ci/pytorch/test_fa3_abi_stable.sh
168: 
169:           # Leaving 1GB for the runner and other things
170:           TOTAL_AVAILABLE_MEMORY_IN_GB=$(awk '/MemTotal/ { printf "%.3f \n", $2/1024/1024 - 1 }' /proc/meminfo)
171:           # https://docs.docker.com/engine/containers/resource_constraints/#--memory-swap-details, the 3GB swap
172:           # comes from https://github.com/pytorch/test-infra/pull/6058
173:           TOTAL_MEMORY_WITH_SWAP=$(("${TOTAL_AVAILABLE_MEMORY_IN_GB%.*}" + 3))
174: 
175: 
176:           SHM_OPTS="--shm-size=${SHM_SIZE}"
177:           JENKINS_USER="--user jenkins"
178:           DOCKER_SHELL_CMD=
179: 
180:           # detached container should get cleaned up by teardown_ec2_linux
181:           # TODO: Stop building test binaries as part of the build phase
182:           # Used for GPU_FLAG, SHM_OPTS, JENKINS_USER and DOCKER_SHELL_CMD since that doesn't play nice
183:           # shellcheck disable=SC2086,SC2090
184:           container_name=$(docker run \
185:             ${GPU_FLAG:-} \
186:             ${SCCACHE_SERVER_PORT_DOCKER_FLAG:-} \
187:             -e BUILD_ENVIRONMENT \
188:             -e PR_NUMBER \
189:             -e GITHUB_ACTIONS \
190:             -e GITHUB_REPOSITORY \
191:             -e GITHUB_WORKFLOW \
192:             -e GITHUB_JOB \
193:             -e GITHUB_RUN_ID \
194:             -e GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER \
195:             -e GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT \
196:             -e JOB_ID \
197:             -e JOB_NAME \
198:             -e BASE_SHA \
199:             -e BRANCH \
200:             -e SHA1 \
201:             -e MAX_JOBS="$(nproc --ignore=2)" \
202:             -e HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN \
203:             -e VLLM_TEST_HUGGING_FACE_TOKEN \
204:             -e SCRIBE_GRAPHQL_ACCESS_TOKEN \
205:             -e ARTIFACTS_FILE_SUFFIX \
206:             --memory="${TOTAL_AVAILABLE_MEMORY_IN_GB%.*}g" \
207:             --memory-swap="${TOTAL_MEMORY_WITH_SWAP}g" \
208:             --env-file="/tmp/github_env_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" \
209:             --security-opt seccomp=unconfined \
210:             --cap-add=SYS_PTRACE \
211:             --ipc=host \
212:             ${SHM_OPTS} \
213:             --tty \
214:             --detach \
215:             --name="${container_name}" \
216:             ${JENKINS_USER} \
217:             -v "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}:/var/lib/jenkins/workspace" \
218:             -w /var/lib/jenkins/workspace \
219:             "${DOCKER_IMAGE}" \
220:             ${DOCKER_SHELL_CMD}
221:           )
222: 
223:           echo "DOCKER_CONTAINER_ID=${container_name}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
224: 
225:           docker exec -t "${container_name}" sh -c "python3 -m pip install $(echo dist/*.whl)[opt-einsum] && ${TEST_COMMAND}"
226: 
227:       - name: Collect backtraces from coredumps (if any)

229:         run: |
230:           # shellcheck disable=SC2156
231:           find . -iname "core.[1-9]*" -exec docker exec "${DOCKER_CONTAINER_ID}" sh -c "gdb python {} -ex 'bt' -ex 'q'" \;
232:

236:         with:
237:           name: coredumps-fa3-stable-abi-smoke-tests
238:           retention-days: 14
239:           if-no-files-found: ignore
240:           path: ./**/core.[1-9]*
241: 
242:       - name: Upload utilization stats
243:         if: ${{ always() && steps.test.conclusion && steps.test.conclusion != 'skipped' }}

250:           workflow_run_id: ${{github.run_id}}
251:           workflow_attempt: ${{github.run_attempt}}
252: 
253:       - name: Teardown Linux
254:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/teardown-linux@main
255:         if: always() && steps.check_container_runner.outputs.IN_CONTAINER_RUNNER == 'false'

55:       TRIGGERING_ACTOR: ${{ inputs.triggering_actor }}
56:       ISSUE_OWNER: ${{ inputs.issue_owner }}
57:       CHECK_EXPERIMENTS: ${{ inputs.check_experiments }}
58:       OPT_OUT_EXPERIMENTS: ${{ inputs.opt_out_experiments }}
59:       PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
60:     steps:
61:       # - name: Checkout PyTorch
62:       #   uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
63:       #   with:
64:       #     fetch-depth: 1

67:       # TODO: Remove the hardcoded step below

70:       - name: Hardcode runner-determinator script
71:         id: hardcode-script
72:         run: |
73:           cat <<EOF > runner_determinator.py
74:           # flake8: noqa: G004
75: 
76:           # Note: Copies of this script in runner_determinator.py and _runner-determinator.yml
77:           #       must be kept in sync. You can do it easily by running the following command:
78:           #           python .github/scripts/update_runner_determinator.py
79: 
80:           """
81:           This runner determinator is used to determine which set of runners to run a
82:           GitHub job on. It uses the first comment of a GitHub issue (by default
83:           https://github.com/pytorch/test-infra/issues/5132) to define the configuration
84:           of which runners should be used to run which job.
85: 
86:           The configuration has two parts, the settings and a list of opted-in users,
87:           separated by a line containing "---".  If the line is not present, the
88:           settings are considered to be empty with only the second part, the user
89:           list, defined.
90: 
91:           The first part is a YAML block that defines the rollout settings. This can be
92:           used to define any settings that are needed to determine which runners to use.
93:           It's fields are defined by the RolloutSettings class below.
94: 
95:           The second part is a list of users who are explicitly opted in to the LF fleet.
96:           The user list is also a comma separated list of additional features or
97:           experiments which the user could be opted in to.
98: 
99:           The user list has the following rules:
100: 
101:           - Users are GitHub usernames, which must start with the @ prefix
102:           - Each user is also a comma-separated list of features/experiments to enable
103:           - A "#" prefix opts the user out of all experiments
104: 
105:           Example config:
106:               # A list of experiments that can be opted into.
107:               # This defines the behavior they'll induce when opted into.
108:               # Expected syntax is:
109:               #   [experiment_name]: # Name of the experiment. Also used for the label prefix.
110:               #      rollout_perc: [int] # % of workflows to run with this experiment when users are not opted in.
111: 
112:               experiments:
113:                 lf:
114:                   rollout_percent: 25
115:                   all_branches: false
116:                   default: true
117:               ---
118: 
119:               # Opt-ins:
120:               # Users can opt into the LF fleet by adding their GitHub username to this list
121:               # and specifying experiments to enable in a comma-separated list.
122:               # To always opt out of an experiment, prefix it with a "-".
123:               # Experiments should be from the above list.
124: 
125:               @User1,-lf,split_build
126:               @User2,lf
127:               @User3,split_build
128:           """
129: 
130:           import json
131:           import logging
132:           import os
133:           import random
134:           import re
135:           import sys
136:           from argparse import ArgumentParser
137:           from collections.abc import Iterable
138:           from functools import cache
139:           from logging import LogRecord
140:           from typing import Any, NamedTuple
141:           from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
142: 
143:           import yaml
144:           from github import Auth, Github
145:           from github.Issue import Issue
146: 
147: 
148:           DEFAULT_LABEL_PREFIX = ""  # use meta runners
149:           WORKFLOW_LABEL_LF = "lf."  # use runners from the linux foundation
150:           WORKFLOW_LABEL_LF_CANARY = "lf.c."  # use canary runners from the linux foundation
151: 
152:           GITHUB_OUTPUT = os.getenv("GITHUB_OUTPUT", "")
153:           GH_OUTPUT_KEY_AMI = "runner-ami"
154:           GH_OUTPUT_KEY_LABEL_TYPE = "label-type"
155:           OPT_OUT_LABEL = "no-runner-experiments"
156: 
157:           SETTING_EXPERIMENTS = "experiments"
158: 
159:           LF_FLEET_EXPERIMENT = "lf"
160:           CANARY_FLEET_SUFFIX = ".c"
161: 
162: 
163:           class Experiment(NamedTuple):
164:               rollout_perc: float = (
165:                   0  # Percentage of workflows to experiment on when user is not opted-in.
166:               )
167:               all_branches: bool = (
168:                   False  # If True, the experiment is also enabled on the exception branches
169:               )
170:               default: bool = (
171:                   True  # If True, the experiment is enabled by default for all queries
172:               )
173: 
174:               # Add more fields as needed
175: 
176: 
177:           class Settings(NamedTuple):
178:               """
179:               Settings for the experiments that can be opted into.
180:               """
181: 
182:               experiments: dict[str, Experiment] = {}
183: 
184: 
185:           class ColorFormatter(logging.Formatter):
186:               """Color codes the log messages based on the log level"""
187: 
188:               COLORS = {
189:                   "WARNING": "\033[33m",  # Yellow
190:                   "ERROR": "\033[31m",  # Red
191:                   "CRITICAL": "\033[31m",  # Red
192:                   "INFO": "\033[0m",  # Reset
193:                   "DEBUG": "\033[0m",  # Reset
194:               }
195: 
196:               def format(self, record: LogRecord) -> str:

350:           def extract_settings_user_opt_in_from_text(rollout_state: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
351:               """
352:               Extracts the text with settings, if any, and the opted in users from the rollout state.
353: 
354:               If the issue body contains "---" then the text above that is the settings
355:               and the text below is the list of opted in users.
356: 
357:               If it doesn't contain "---" then the settings are empty and the rest is the users.
358:               """
359:               rollout_state_parts = rollout_state.split("---")

366:           class UserOptins(dict[str, list[str]]):

372:           def parse_user_opt_in_from_text(user_optin_text: str) -> UserOptins:
373:               """
374:               Parse the user opt-in text into a key value pair of username and the list of features they have opted into
375: 
376:               Users are GitHub usernames with the @ prefix. Each user is also a comma-separated list of features/experiments to enable.
377:                   - Example line: "@User1,lf,split_build"
378:                   - A "#" prefix indicates the user is opted out of all experiments
379: 
380: 
381:               """
382:               optins = UserOptins()
383:               for user in user_optin_text.split("\n"):
384:                   user = user.strip("\r\n\t -")
385:                   if not user or not user.startswith("@"):
386:                       # Not a valid user. Skip
387:                       continue
388: 
389:                   if user:
390:                       usr_name = user.split(",")[0].strip("@")
391:                       optins[usr_name] = [exp.strip(" ") for exp in user.split(",")[1:]]
392: 
393:               return optins

396:           def is_valid_experiment_name(experiment_name: str) -> bool:
397:               """
398:               Check if the experiment name is valid.
399:               A valid name:
400:                   - Contains only alphanumeric characters and the special characters "_" & "-"
401:                   - The special characters "_" & "-" shouldn't be the first or last characters
402:                   - Cannot contain spaces
403:               """
404: 
405:               valid_char_regex = r"^[a-zA-Z0-9]([\w-]*[a-zA-Z0-9])?$"
406:               valid = bool(re.match(valid_char_regex, experiment_name))
407: 
408:               if valid:
409:                   return True
410: 
411:               log.error(
412:                   f"Invalid experiment name: {experiment_name}. Experiment names should only contain alphanumeric characters, '_', and '-'. They cannot contain spaces, and the special characters '_' and '-' cannot be the first or last characters."
413:               )
414:               return False

417:           def parse_settings_from_text(settings_text: str) -> Settings:
418:               """
419:               Parse the experiments from the issue body into a list of ExperimentSettings
420:               """
421:               try:
422:                   if settings_text:
423:                       # Escape the backtick as well so that we can have the settings in a code block on the GH issue
424:                       # for easy reading
425:                       # Note: Using ascii for the backtick so that the cat step in _runner-determinator.yml doesn't choke on
426:                       #       the backtick character in shell commands.
427:                       backtick = chr(96)  # backtick character
428:                       settings_text = settings_text.strip(f"\r\n\t{backtick} ")
429:                       settings = load_yaml(settings_text)
430: 
431:                       # For now we just load experiments. We can expand this if/when we add more settings
432:                       experiments = {}
433: 
434:                       for exp_name, exp_settings in settings.get(SETTING_EXPERIMENTS).items():
435:                           if not is_valid_experiment_name(exp_name):
436:                               # Exclude invalid experiments from the list. We log an error, but don't raise an exception so that other experiments can still be processed.
437:                               continue
438: 
439:                           valid_settings = {}
440:                           for setting in exp_settings:
441:                               if setting not in Experiment._fields:
442:                                   log.warning(
443:                                       f"Unexpected setting in experiment: {setting} = {exp_settings[setting]}"
444:                                   )
445:                               else:
446:                                   valid_settings[setting] = exp_settings[setting]
447: 
448:                           experiments[exp_name] = Experiment(**valid_settings)
449:                       return Settings(experiments)
450: 
451:               except Exception:
452:                   log.exception("Failed to parse settings")
453: 
454:               return Settings()

486:           def is_user_opted_out(user: str, user_optins: UserOptins, experiment_name: str) -> bool:
487:               """
488:               Check if a user explicitly opted out of an experiment
489:               """
490:               # if the experiment is prefixed with a "-", then it's an opt-out
491:               experiment_optout = "-" + experiment_name
492:               if experiment_optout not in user_optins.get(user, []):
493:                   return False
494: 
495:               if is_user_opted_in(user, user_optins, experiment_name):
496:                   log.warning(
497:                       f"User {user} is opted into experiment {experiment_name}, but also opted out of it. Defaulting to opting out"
498:                   )
499: 
500:               return True

503:           def get_runner_prefix(
504:               rollout_state: str,
505:               workflow_requestors: Iterable[str],
506:               branch: str,
507:               eligible_experiments: frozenset[str] = frozenset(),
508:               opt_out_experiments: frozenset[str] = frozenset(),
509:               is_canary: bool = False,
510:           ) -> str:
511:               settings = parse_settings(rollout_state)
512:               user_optins = parse_users(rollout_state)
513: 
514:               fleet_prefix = ""
515:               prefixes = []
516:               for experiment_name, experiment_settings in settings.experiments.items():
517:                   if not experiment_settings.all_branches and is_exception_branch(branch):
518:                       log.info(
519:                           f"Branch {branch} is an exception branch. Not enabling experiment {experiment_name}."
520:                       )
521:                       continue
522: 
523:                   if opt_out_experiments:
524:                       if experiment_name in opt_out_experiments:
525:                           opt_out_exp_list = ", ".join(opt_out_experiments)
526:                           log.info(
527:                               f"Skipping experiment '{experiment_name}', as this workflow has opted-out (opted out experiments are: {opt_out_exp_list})"
528:                           )
529:                           continue
530: 
531:                   if eligible_experiments:
532:                       if experiment_name not in eligible_experiments:
533:                           exp_list = ", ".join(eligible_experiments)
534:                           log.info(
535:                               f"Skipping experiment '{experiment_name}', as it is not in the eligible_experiments list: {exp_list}"
536:                           )
537:                           continue
538:                   elif not experiment_settings.default:
539:                       log.info(
540:                           f"Skipping experiment '{experiment_name}', as it is not a default experiment"
541:                       )
542:                       continue
543: 
544:                   # Is any workflow_requestor opted out to this experiment?
545:                   opted_out_users = [
546:                       requestor
547:                       for requestor in workflow_requestors
548:                       if is_user_opted_out(requestor, user_optins, experiment_name)
549:                   ]
550: 
551:                   if opted_out_users:
552:                       log.info(
553:                           f"{', '.join(opted_out_users)} have opted out of experiment {experiment_name}."
554:                       )
555:                       continue
556: 
557:                   # Is any workflow_requestor opted in to this experiment?
558:                   opted_in_users = [
559:                       requestor
560:                       for requestor in workflow_requestors
561:                       if is_user_opted_in(requestor, user_optins, experiment_name)
562:                   ]
563: 
564:                   enabled = False
565:                   if opted_in_users:
566:                       log.info(
567:                           f"{', '.join(opted_in_users)} have opted into experiment {experiment_name}."
568:                       )
569:                       enabled = True
570: 
571:                   elif experiment_settings.rollout_perc:
572:                       # If no user is opted in, then we randomly enable the experiment based on the rollout percentage
573:                       if random.uniform(0, 100) <= experiment_settings.rollout_perc:
574:                           log.info(
575:                               f"Based on rollout percentage of {experiment_settings.rollout_perc}%, enabling experiment {experiment_name}."
576:                           )
577:                           enabled = True
578: 
579:                   if enabled:
580:                       label = experiment_name
581:                       if experiment_name == LF_FLEET_EXPERIMENT:
582:                           # We give some special treatment to the "lf" experiment since determines the fleet we use
583:                           #  - If it's enabled, then we always list it's prefix first
584:                           #  - If we're in the canary branch, then we append ".c" to the lf prefix
585:                           if is_canary:
586:                               label += CANARY_FLEET_SUFFIX
587:                           fleet_prefix = label
588:                       else:
589:                           prefixes.append(label)
590: 
591:               if len(prefixes) > 1:
592:                   log.error(
593:                       f"Only a fleet and one other experiment can be enabled for a job at any time. Enabling {prefixes[0]} and ignoring the rest, which are {', '.join(prefixes[1:])}"
594:                   )
595:                   prefixes = prefixes[:1]
596: 
597:               # Fleet always comes first
598:               if fleet_prefix:
599:                   prefixes.insert(0, fleet_prefix)
600: 
601:               return ".".join(prefixes) + "." if prefixes else ""

{"content":"1: name: win-test
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_call:
5:     inputs:
6:       build-environment:
7:         required: true
8:         type: string
9:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
10:       cuda-version:
11:         required: true
12:         type: string
13:         description: What CUDA version to build with, "cpu" for none.
14:       test-matrix:
15:         required: true
16:         type: string
17:         description: JSON description of what test configs to run.
18:       sync-tag:
19:         required: false
20:         type: string
21:         default: ""
22:         description: |
23:           If this is set, our linter will use this to make sure that every other
24:           job with the same `sync-tag` is identical.
25:       timeout-minutes:
26:         required: false
27:         type: number
28:         default: 240
29:         description: |
30:           Set the maximum (in minutes) how long the workflow should take to finish
31:       disable-monitor:
32:         description: |
33:           [Experimental] Disable utilization monitoring for tests.
34:           Currently, by default we disable the monitor job and only look for specific tests,
35:           since we are investigating the behaviour of the monitor script with different tests.
36:         required: false
37:         type: boolean
38:         default: true
39:       monitor-log-interval:
40:         description: |
41:           Set the interval for the monitor script to log utilization.
42:         required: false
43:         type: number
44:         default: 5
45:       monitor-data-collect-interval:
46:         description: |
47:           Set the interval for the monitor script to collect data.
48:         required: false
49:         type: number
50:         default: 1
51: env:
52:   GIT_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
53: 
54: jobs:
55:   test:
56:     # Don't run on forked repos or empty test matrix
57:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch' && toJSON(fromJSON(inputs.test-matrix).include) != '[]'
58:     strategy:
59:       matrix: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.test-matrix) }}
60:       fail-fast: false
61:     runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
62:     timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check == 'mem_leak_check' && 600 || inputs.timeout-minutes }}
63:     defaults:
64:       run:
65:         shell: bash
66:     steps:
67:       # Duplicated in win-build because this MUST go before a checkout
68:       - name: Enable git long paths and symlinks on Windows and disable fsmonitor daemon
69:         shell: bash
70:         run: |
71:           git config --global core.longpaths true
72:           git config --global core.symlinks true
73:           git config --global core.ignorecase false
74: 
75:           # https://git-scm.com/docs/git-fsmonitor--daemon.  The daemon could lock
76:           # the directory on Windows and prevent GHA from checking out as reported
77:           # in https://github.com/actions/checkout/issues/1018
78:           git config --global core.fsmonitor false
79: 
80:       - name: Setup SSH (Click me for login details)
81:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-ssh@main
82:         with:
83:           github-secret: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
84:           instructions: |
85:             To forward remote desktop on your local machine ssh as follows:
86:               ssh -L 3389:localhost:3389 %%username%%@%%hostname%%
87:             And then change password using `passwd` command.
88: 
89:             To start tests locally, change working folder to \actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\test,
90:             Activate miniconda and Visual Studio environment and set PYTHON_PATH, by running:
91:               call C:\Jenkins\Miniconda3\Scripts\activate.bat C:\Jenkins\Miniconda3
92:               call "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x64
93:               set PYTHONPATH=C:\actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\build\win_tmp\build
94: 
95:       # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
96:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
97:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
98:         with:
99:           no-sudo: true
100: 
101:       - name: Setup Windows
102:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-win
103:         with:
104:           cuda-version: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
105: 
106:       - name: Get workflow job id
107:         id: get-job-id
108:         uses: ./.github/actions/get-workflow-job-id
109:         if: always()
110:         with:
111:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
112: 
113:       - name: Start monitoring script
114:         id: monitor-script
115:         env:
116:           JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
117:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
118:           WORKFLOW_NAME: ${{ github.workflow }}
119:           WORKFLOW_RUN_ID: ${{github.run_id}}
120:           MONITOR_LOG_INTERVAL: ${{ inputs.monitor-log-interval }}
121:           MONITOR_DATA_COLLECT_INTERVAL: ${{ inputs.monitor-data-collect-interval }}
122:         shell: bash
123:         if: ${{ !inputs.disable-monitor }}
124:         continue-on-error: true
125:         run: |
126:           # Windows conda doesn't have python3 binary, only python, but it's python3
127:           ${CONDA_RUN} python -m pip install psutil==5.9.8 dataclasses_json==0.6.7 nvidia-ml-py==11.525.84
128:           ${CONDA_RUN} python -m tools.stats.monitor --log-interval "$MONITOR_LOG_INTERVAL" --data-collect-interval "$MONITOR_DATA_COLLECT_INTERVAL" > usage_log.txt 2>&1 &
129:           echo "monitor-script-pid=${!}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
130: 
131:       - name: Download PyTorch Build Artifacts
132:         uses: seemethere/download-artifact-s3@1da556a7aa0a088e3153970611f6c432d58e80e6 # v4.2.0
133:         with:
134:           name: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
135:           path: C:\${{ github.run_id }}\build-results
136: 
137:       - name: Check build-results folder
138:         shell: powershell
139:         run: |
140:           tree /F C:\$Env:GITHUB_RUN_ID\build-results
141: 
142:       - name: Download TD artifacts
143:         continue-on-error: true
144:         uses: ./.github/actions/download-td-artifacts
145: 
146:       - name: Check for keep-going label and re-enabled test issues
147:         # This uses the filter-test-configs action because it conveniently
148:         # checks for labels and re-enabled test issues.  It does not actually do
149:         # any filtering.  All filtering is done in the build step.
150:         id: keep-going
151:         uses: ./.github/actions/filter-test-configs
152:         with:
153:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
154:           test-matrix: ${{ inputs.test-matrix }}
155:           job-name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
156: 
157:       - name: Set Test step time
158:         id: test-timeout
159:         shell: bash
160:         env:
161:           JOB_TIMEOUT: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check == 'mem_leak_check' && 600 || inputs.timeout-minutes }}
162:         run: |
163:           echo "timeout=$((JOB_TIMEOUT-30))" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
164: 
165:       - name: Test
166:         id: test
167:         shell: bash
168:         timeout-minutes: ${{ fromJson(steps.test-timeout.outputs.timeout) }}
169:         env:
170:           USE_CUDA: ${{ inputs.cuda-version != 'cpu' && '1' || '0' }}
171:           INSTALL_WINDOWS_SDK: 1
172:           PYTHON_VERSION: "3.10"
173:           CONTINUE_THROUGH_ERROR: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.keep-going }}
174:           VERBOSE_TEST_LOGS: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-verbose-test-logs }}
175:           TEST_SHOWLOCALS: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-test-showlocals }}
176:           NO_TEST_TIMEOUT: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-no-test-timeout }}
177:           NO_TD: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-no-td }}
178:           VC_PRODUCT: "BuildTools"
179:           VC_VERSION: ""
180:           VS_VERSION: "17.4.1"
181:           VC_YEAR: "2022"
182:           AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1
183:           PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
184:           GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
185:           GITHUB_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}
186:           GITHUB_JOB: ${{ github.job }}
187:           GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
188:           GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
189:           GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
190:           JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
191:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
192:           SHA1: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
193:           CUDA_VERSION: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
194:           PYTORCH_FINAL_PACKAGE_DIR: /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results/
195:           BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
196:           ALPINE_IMAGE: "308535385114.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/tool/alpine"
197:           SHARD_NUMBER: ${{ matrix.shard }}
198:           NUM_TEST_SHARDS: ${{ matrix.num_shards }}
199:           TEST_CONFIG: ${{ matrix.config }}
200:           REENABLED_ISSUES: ${{ github.event.pull_request.reenabled-issues }}
201:           TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "8.6"
202:           PYTORCH_TEST_CUDA_MEM_LEAK_CHECK: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check && '1' || '0' }}
203:           PYTORCH_TEST_RERUN_DISABLED_TESTS: ${{ matrix.rerun_disabled_tests && '1' || '0' }}
204:         run: |
205:           pushd "${PYTORCH_FINAL_PACKAGE_DIR}"
206:           # shellcheck disable=SC2046,SC2102
207:           python3 -mpip install $(echo *.whl)[opt-einsum,optree] optree==0.13.0
208:           popd
209: 
210:           .ci/pytorch/win-test.sh
211: 
212:       - name: Upload pytest cache if tests failed
213:         uses: ./.github/actions/pytest-cache-upload
214:         continue-on-error: true
215:         if: failure() && steps.test.conclusion && steps.test.conclusion == 'failure'
216:         with:
217:           cache_dir: .pytest_cache
218:           shard: ${{ matrix.shard }}
219:           sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
220:           test_config: ${{ matrix.config }}
221:           job_identifier: ${{ github.workflow }}_${{ inputs.build-environment }}
222: 
223:       - name: Print remaining test logs
224:         shell: bash
225:         if: always() && steps.test.conclusion
226:         run: |
227:           cat test/**/*_toprint.log || true
228: 
229:       - name: Stop monitoring script
230:         if: ${{ always() && steps.monitor-script.outputs.monitor-script-pid }}
231:         shell: bash
232:         continue-on-error: true
233:         env:
234:           MONITOR_SCRIPT_PID: ${{ steps.monitor-script.outputs.monitor-script-pid }}
235:         run: |
236:           kill "$MONITOR_SCRIPT_PID"
237: 
238:       - name: Upload test artifacts
239:         uses: ./.github/actions/upload-test-artifacts
240:         if: always() && steps.test.conclusion && steps.test.conclusion != 'skipped'
241:         with:
242:           file-suffix: ${{ github.job }}-${{ matrix.config }}-${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ matrix.num_shards }}-${{ matrix.runner }}_${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
243: 
244:       - name: Upload utilization stats
245:         if: ${{ always() && steps.test.conclusion && steps.test.conclusion != 'skipped' && !inputs.disable-monitor }}
246:         continue-on-error: true
247:         uses: ./.github/actions/upload-utilization-stats
248:         with:
249:           job_id: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
250:           job_name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
251:           workflow_name: ${{ github.workflow }}
252:           workflow_run_id: ${{github.run_id}}
253:           workflow_attempt: ${{github.run_attempt}}
254: 
255:       - name: Parse ref
256:         id: parse-ref
257:         shell: bash
258:         run: python3 .github/scripts/parse_ref.py
259: 
260:       - name: Teardown Windows
261:         uses: ./.github/actions/teardown-win
262:         if: always()
263:         timeout-minutes: 120

{"content":"1: name: Build manywheel docker images for s390x
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_dispatch:

6:     tags:

8:     paths:

11: 
12: env:
13:   DOCKER_REGISTRY: "docker.io"
14:   DOCKER_BUILDKIT: 1
15:   WITH_PUSH: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/release') || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) }}
16: 
17: concurrency:
18:   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
19:   cancel-in-progress: true
20: 
21: jobs:
22:   build-docker-cpu-s390x:
23:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
24:     environment: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/release') || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) && 'docker-build') || '' }}
25:     runs-on: linux.s390x
26:     steps:
27:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
28:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
29:         with:
30:           submodules: false
31:           no-sudo: true
32: 
33:       - name: Build Docker Image
34:         run: |
35:           .ci/docker/manywheel/build.sh manylinuxs390x-builder:cpu-s390x -t manylinuxs390x-builder:cpu-s390x
36: 
37:       - name: Tag and (if WITH_PUSH) push docker image to docker.io
38:         env:
39:           DOCKER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_TOKEN }}
40:           DOCKER_ID: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_ID }}
41:           CREATED_FULL_DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME: manylinuxs390x-builder:cpu-s390x
42:         shell: bash
43:         run: |
44:           set -euox pipefail
45:           GITHUB_REF="${GITHUB_REF:-$(git symbolic-ref -q HEAD || git describe --tags --exact-match)}"
46:           GIT_BRANCH_NAME="${GITHUB_REF##*/}"
47:           GIT_COMMIT_SHA="${GITHUB_SHA:-$(git rev-parse HEAD)}"
48:           CI_FOLDER_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD:.ci/docker)"
49: 
50:           DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX="docker.io/pytorch/${CREATED_FULL_DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME}"
51: 
52:           docker tag "${CREATED_FULL_DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME}" "${DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX}-${GIT_BRANCH_NAME}"
53:           docker tag "${CREATED_FULL_DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME}" "${DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX}-${GIT_COMMIT_SHA}"
54:           docker tag "${CREATED_FULL_DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME}" "${DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX}-${CI_FOLDER_SHA}"
55: 
56:           # Pretty sure Github will mask tokens and I'm not sure if it will even be
57:           # printed due to pipe, but just in case
58:           set +x
59:           if [[ "${WITH_PUSH:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
60:             echo "${DOCKER_TOKEN}" | docker login -u "${DOCKER_ID}" --password-stdin
61:             docker push "${DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX}-${GIT_BRANCH_NAME}"
62:             docker push "${DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX}-${GIT_COMMIT_SHA}"
63:             docker push "${DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX}-${CI_FOLDER_SHA}"
64:           fi
65: 
66:       - name: Cleanup docker
67:         if: cancelled()
68:         shell: bash
69:         run: |
70:           # If podman build command is interrupted,
71:           # it can leave a couple of processes still running.
72:           # Order them to stop for clean shutdown.
73:           # It looks like sometimes some processes remain
74:           # after first cleanup.
75:           # Wait a bit and do cleanup again. It looks like it helps.
76:           docker system prune --build -f || true
77:           sleep 60
78:           docker system prune --build -f || true
79: ","url":"https://sourcegraph.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/pytorch--863edc78@76b8fdafad537579cd97b5ec2502c6ac3bc473e0/-/blob/.github/workflows/build-manywheel-images-s390x.yml"}

21:       - .github/actions/binary-docker-build/**

23: env:
