{"content":"1: name: Build Triton wheels
2: 
3: on:
4:   push:
5:     branches:
6:       - main
7:     tags:
8:       # NOTE: Binary build pipelines should only get triggered on release candidate builds
9:       # Release candidate tags look like: v1.11.0-rc1
10:       - v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+-rc[0-9]+
11:       - 'ciflow/triton_binaries/*'
12:     paths:
13:       - .github/workflows/build-triton-wheel.yml
14:       - .github/scripts/build_triton_wheel.py
15:       - .github/ci_commit_pins/triton.txt
16:       - .github/scripts/windows/install_vs2022.ps1
17:       - .github/scripts/windows/build_triton.bat
18:       - .ci/docker/ci_commit_pins/triton.txt
19:       - .ci/docker/ci_commit_pins/triton-xpu.txt
20:   workflow_dispatch:
21:   pull_request:
22:     paths:
23:       - .github/workflows/build-triton-wheel.yml
24:       - .github/scripts/build_triton_wheel.py
25:       - .github/ci_commit_pins/triton.txt
26:       - .github/scripts/windows/install_vs2022.ps1
27:       - .github/scripts/windows/build_triton.bat
28:       - .ci/docker/ci_commit_pins/triton.txt
29:       - .ci/docker/ci_commit_pins/triton-xpu.txt
30: 
31: concurrency:
32:   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
33:   cancel-in-progress: true
34: 
35: jobs:
36:   get-label-type:
37:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
38:     name: get-label-type
39:     uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/workflows/_runner-determinator.yml@main
40:     with:
41:       triggering_actor: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
42:       issue_owner: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login || github.event.issue.user.login }}
43:       curr_branch: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
44:       curr_ref_type: ${{ github.ref_type }}
45: 
46:   build-wheel:
47:     name: "Build Triton Wheel"
48:     needs: get-label-type
49:     runs-on: ${{ matrix.runs_on }}
50:     strategy:
51:       fail-fast: false
52:       matrix:
53:         py_vers: [ "3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13", "3.13t", "3.14", "3.14t" ]
54:         device: ["cuda", "rocm", "xpu", "aarch64"]
55:         docker-image: ["pytorch/manylinux2_28-builder:cpu"]
56:         include:
57:           - device: "rocm"
58:             rocm_version: "7.1"
59:             runs_on: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.4xlarge"
60:           - device: "cuda"
61:             rocm_version: ""
62:             runs_on: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.4xlarge"
63:           - device: "xpu"
64:             rocm_version: ""
65:             runs_on: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.4xlarge"
66:           - device: "aarch64"
67:             rocm_version: ""
68:             runs_on: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.arm64.2xlarge"
69:     timeout-minutes: 40
70:     env:
71:       DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ matrix.device == 'rocm' && format('pytorch/manylinux2_28-builder:rocm{0}', matrix.rocm_version) || matrix.device == 'aarch64' && 'pytorch/manylinux2_28_aarch64-builder:cpu-aarch64' || matrix.docker-image }}
72:       PY_VERS: ${{ matrix.py_vers }}
73:       BUILD_DEVICE: ${{ matrix.device }}
74:       PLATFORM: 'manylinux_2_28_x86_64'
75:     steps:
76:       - name: Setup SSH (Click me for login details)
77:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-ssh@main
78:         with:
79:           github-secret: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
80: 
81:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
82:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
83:         with:
84:           submodules: false
85: 
86:       - name: Setup Linux
87:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-linux
88: 
89:       - name: Pull Docker image
90:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/pull-docker-image@main
91:         with:
92:           docker-image: ${{ env.DOCKER_IMAGE }}
93: 
94:       - name: Build Triton wheel
95:         env:
96:           IS_RELEASE_TAG: ${{ startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/v') }}
97:         run: |
98:           set -x
99:           mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/artifacts/"
100:           container_name=$(docker run \
101:             --tty \
102:             --detach \
103:             -v "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}:/pytorch" \
104:             -v "${RUNNER_TEMP}/artifacts:/artifacts" \
105:             -w /artifacts/ \
106:             "${DOCKER_IMAGE}"      \
107:           )
108: 
109:           # Determine python executable for given version
110:           case $PY_VERS in
111:           3.10)
112:             PYTHON_EXECUTABLE=/opt/python/cp310-cp310/bin/python
113:             ;;
114:           3.11)
115:             PYTHON_EXECUTABLE=/opt/python/cp311-cp311/bin/python
116:             ;;
117:           3.12)
118:             PYTHON_EXECUTABLE=/opt/python/cp312-cp312/bin/python
119:             ;;
120:           3.13)
121:             PYTHON_EXECUTABLE=/opt/python/cp313-cp313/bin/python
122:             ;;
123:           3.13t)
124:             PYTHON_EXECUTABLE=/opt/python/cp313-cp313t/bin/python
125:             ;;
126:           3.14)
127:             PYTHON_EXECUTABLE=/opt/python/cp314-cp314/bin/python
128:             ;;
129:           3.14t)
130:             PYTHON_EXECUTABLE=/opt/python/cp314-cp314t/bin/python
131:             ;;
132:           *)
133:             echo "Unsupported python version ${PY_VERS}"
134:             exit 1
135:             ;;
136:           esac
137: 
138:           RELEASE=""
139:           WITH_CLANG_LDD=""
140:           if [[ "${IS_RELEASE_TAG}" == true ]]; then
141:             RELEASE="--release"
142:           fi
143: 
144:           docker exec -t "${container_name}" yum install -y zlib-devel zip
145:           docker exec -t "${container_name}" "${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE}"  -m pip install -U setuptools==78.1.0 pybind11==3.0.1 auditwheel wheel
146:           set +e
147:           docker exec -t "${container_name}" command -v pip
148:           has_pip=$?
149:           set -e
150:           if [ $has_pip -eq 0 ] ; then
151:               docker exec -t "${container_name}" pip install -U cmake --force-reinstall
152:           else
153:               docker exec -t "${container_name}" "${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE}"  -m pip install -U cmake --force-reinstall
154:           fi
155: 
156:           if [[ ("${{ matrix.device }}" == "cuda" || "${{ matrix.device }}" == "rocm" || "${{ matrix.device }}" == "aarch64" ) ]]; then
157:             # With this install, it gets clang 16.0.6.
158:             docker exec -t "${container_name}" dnf install clang lld -y
159:             WITH_CLANG_LDD="--with-clang-ldd"
160:           fi
161: 
162:           docker exec -t "${container_name}" bash -c "${PYTHON_EXECUTABLE} /pytorch/.github/scripts/build_triton_wheel.py --device=$BUILD_DEVICE $RELEASE $WITH_CLANG_LDD"
163: 
164:           if [[ ("${{ matrix.device }}" == "cuda" || "${{ matrix.device }}" == "xpu") ]]; then
165:             docker exec -t "${container_name}"  bash -c "auditwheel repair --plat ${PLATFORM} //artifacts/*.whl"
166:           else
167:             docker exec -t "${container_name}"  bash -c "mkdir //artifacts/wheelhouse"
168:             docker exec -t "${container_name}"  bash -c "mv //artifacts/*.whl //artifacts/wheelhouse/"
169:           fi
170:           docker exec -t "${container_name}" chown -R 1000.1000 /artifacts/wheelhouse
171: 
172:       - uses: actions/upload-artifact@50769540e7f4bd5e21e526ee35c689e35e0d6874 # v4.4.0
173:         with:
174:           name: triton-wheel-${{ matrix.py_vers }}-${{ matrix.device }}-${{ env.PLATFORM }}
175:           if-no-files-found: error
176:           path: ${{ runner.temp }}/artifacts/wheelhouse/*
177: 
178:       - name: Teardown Linux
179:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/teardown-linux@main
180:         if: always()

182:   build-wheel-win:
183:     name: "Build Triton Windows Wheel"

186:     strategy:

196:     steps:

198:         shell: bash

200:           set -euo pipefail
201:           function get_ec2_metadata() {
202:             # Pulled from instance metadata endpoint for EC2
203:             # see https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/instancedata-data-retrieval.html
204:             category=$1
205:             curl -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $(curl -s -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 30")" -fsSL "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/${category}"
206:           }
207:           echo "ami-id: $(get_ec2_metadata ami-id)"
208:           echo "instance-id: $(get_ec2_metadata instance-id)"
209:           echo "instance-type: $(get_ec2_metadata instance-type)"
210:           echo "system info $(uname -a)"
211:       - name: "[FB EMPLOYEES] Enable SSH (Click me for login details)"
212:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-ssh@main
213:         continue-on-error: true
214:         with:
215:           github-secret: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
216:       - name: Enable git long paths and symlinks on Windows and disable fsmonitor daemon
217:         shell: bash
218:         run: |
219:           git config --global core.longpaths true
220:           git config --global core.symlinks true
221:           # https://git-scm.com/docs/git-fsmonitor--daemon.  The daemon could lock
222:           # the directory on Windows and prevent GHA from checking out as reported
223:           # in https://github.com/actions/checkout/issues/1018
224:           git config --global core.fsmonitor false
225:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
226:         uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
227:         with:
228:           ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
229:           submodules: false
230:           path: pytorch
231:           show-progress: false
232:       - name: Clean PyTorch checkout
233:         run: |
234:           # Remove any artifacts from the previous checkouts
235:           git clean -fxd
236:         working-directory: pytorch
237:       - name: Enable long paths on Windows and install VS2022 17.13.2
238:         env:
239:           VC_YEAR: 2022
240:           VC_VERSION: 17.13.2
241:         shell: bash
242:         working-directory: pytorch
243:         run: |
244:           powershell .github/scripts/windows/install_vs2022.ps1
245:       - name: Build Triton wheel
246:         env:
247:           IS_RELEASE_TAG: ${{ startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/v') }}
248:         working-directory: pytorch
249:         shell: bash
250:         run: |
251:           set -x
252:           export RELEASE=""
253:           if [[ "${IS_RELEASE_TAG}" == true ]]; then
254:             export RELEASE="--release"
255:           fi
256:           .github/scripts/windows/build_triton.bat
257:           mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/artifacts/"
258:           mv ./*.whl "${RUNNER_TEMP}/artifacts/"
259:       - uses: actions/upload-artifact@50769540e7f4bd5e21e526ee35c689e35e0d6874 # v4.4.0
260:         with:
261:           name: triton-wheel-${{ matrix.py_vers }}-${{ matrix.device }}
262:           if-no-files-found: error
263:           path: ${{ runner.temp }}/artifacts/*

{"content":"1: name: Build vLLM wheels
2: 
3: on:
4:   push:

7:     paths:
8:       - .github/workflows/build-vllm-wheel.yml

11:   pull_request:
12:     paths:
13:       - .github/workflows/build-vllm-wheel.yml
14:       - .github/ci_commit_pins/vllm.txt
15:   schedule:
16:     # every morning at 01:30PM UTC, 9:30AM EST, 6:30AM PST
17:     - cron: 30 13 * * *
18: 
19: concurrency:
20:   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
21:   cancel-in-progress: true
22: 
23: jobs:
24:   build-wheel:
25:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
26:     strategy:
27:       fail-fast: false
28:       matrix:
29:         python-version: [ '3.12' ]
30:         platform: [ 'manylinux_2_28_x86_64', 'manylinux_2_28_aarch64' ]
31:         device: [ 'cu128', 'cu129', 'cu130' ]
32:         include:
33:           - platform: manylinux_2_28_x86_64
34:             device: cu128
35:             manylinux-image: 'pytorch/manylinux2_28-builder:cuda12.8'
36:             runner: linux.12xlarge.memory
37:           - platform: manylinux_2_28_x86_64
38:             device: cu129
39:             manylinux-image: 'pytorch/manylinux2_28-builder:cuda12.9'
40:             runner: linux.12xlarge.memory
41:           - platform: manylinux_2_28_x86_64
42:             device: cu130
43:             manylinux-image: 'pytorch/manylinux2_28-builder:cuda13.0'
44:             runner: linux.12xlarge.memory
45:           - platform: manylinux_2_28_aarch64
46:             device: cu128
47:             manylinux-image: 'pytorch/manylinuxaarch64-builder:cuda12.8'
48:             runner: linux.arm64.r7g.12xlarge.memory
49:           - platform: manylinux_2_28_aarch64
50:             device: cu129
51:             manylinux-image: 'pytorch/manylinuxaarch64-builder:cuda12.9'
52:             runner: linux.arm64.r7g.12xlarge.memory
53:         exclude:
54:           # TODO (huydhn): Add cu130 aarch64 once PyTorch is on 2.9+ and
55:           # xformers is update to support 13.0
56:           - platform: manylinux_2_28_aarch64
57:             device: cu130
58:     name: "Build ${{ matrix.device }} vLLM wheel on ${{ matrix.platform }}"
59:     runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
60:     timeout-minutes: 480
61:     env:
62:       PY_VERS: ${{ matrix.python-version }}
63:       MANYLINUX_IMAGE: ${{ matrix.manylinux-image }}
64:       PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}
65:       BUILD_DEVICE: ${{ matrix.device }}
66:     steps:
67:       - name: Setup SSH (Click me for login details)
68:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-ssh@main
69:         with:
70:           github-secret: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
71: 
72:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
73:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
74:         with:
75:           submodules: false
76: 
77:       - name: Setup Linux
78:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-linux
79: 
80:       - name: Get latest PyTorch nightly
81:         shell: bash
82:         run: |
83:           set -eux
84: 
85:           # Determine python executable for given version (copied from build-triton-wheel)
86:           case $PY_VERS in
87:           3.10)
88:             PYTHON_EXECUTABLE=/opt/python/cp310-cp310/bin/python
89:             ;;
90:           3.11)
91:             PYTHON_EXECUTABLE=/opt/python/cp311-cp311/bin/python

3: on:
4:   # We need pull_request_target to be able to post comments on PRs from forks.
5:   # Only allow pull_request_target when merging to main, not some historical branch.
6:   #
7:   # Make sure to don't introduce explicit checking out and installing/running
8:   # untrusted user code into this workflow!
9:   pull_request_target:
10:     types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]
11:     branches: [main]
12: 
13:   # To check labels on ghstack PRs.
14:   # Note: as pull_request doesn't trigger on PRs targeting main,
15:   # to test changes to the workflow itself one needs to create
16:   # a PR that targets a gh/**/base branch.
17:   pull_request:
18:     types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]
19:     branches: [gh/**/base]

22:     inputs:
23:       pr_number:
24:         description: 'PR number to check labels for'

27: concurrency:
28:   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}

340:         run: |
341:           set -x
342: 
343:           if [[ $TEST_CONFIG == 'multigpu' ]]; then

525:       # NB: We are currently having an intermittent GPU-related issue on G5 runners with
526:       # A10G GPU. Once this happens, trying to reset the GPU as done in setup-nvidia does
527:       # not seem to help. Here are some symptoms:
528:       #   * Calling nvidia-smi timeouts after 60 second
529:       #   * Fail to run nvidia-smi with an unable to determine the device handle for GPU
530:       #     unknown error
531:       #   * Test fails with a missing CUDA GPU error when initializing CUDA in PyTorch
532:       #   * Run docker --gpus all fails with error response from daemon
533:       #
534:       # As both the root cause and recovery path are unclear, let's take the runner out of
535:       # service so that it doesn't get any more jobs
536:       - name: Check NVIDIA driver installation step
537:         if: failure() && steps.install-nvidia-driver.outputs.has-nvidia == 'true' && !contains(matrix.runner, 'b200')
538:         shell: bash
539:         run: |
540:           set +e
541:           set -x
542: 
543:           nvidia-smi
544:           # NB: Surprisingly, nvidia-smi command returns successfully with return code 0 even in
545:           # the case where the driver has already crashed as it still can get the driver version
546:           # and some basic information like the bus ID.  However, the rest of the information
547:           # would be missing (ERR!), for example:
548:           #
549:           # +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
550:           # | NVIDIA-SMI 525.89.02    Driver Version: 525.89.02    CUDA Version: 12.0     |
551:           # |-------------------------------+----------------------+----------------------+
552:           # | GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id        Disp.A | Volatile Uncorr. ECC |
553:           # | Fan  Temp  Perf  Pwr:Usage/Cap|         Memory-Usage | GPU-Util  Compute M. |
554:           # |                               |                      |               MIG M. |
555:           # |===============================+======================+======================|
556:           # |   0  ERR!                Off  | 00000000:00:1E.0 Off |                 ERR! |
557:           # |ERR!  ERR! ERR!    ERR! / ERR! |   4184MiB / 23028MiB |    ERR!      Default |
558:           # |                               |                      |                 ERR! |
559:           # +-------------------------------+----------------------+----------------------+
560:           #
561:           # +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
562:           # | Processes:                                                                  |
563:           # |  GPU   GI   CI        PID   Type   Process name                  GPU Memory |
564:           # |        ID   ID                                                   Usage      |
565:           # |=============================================================================|
566:           # +-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
567:           #
568:           # This should be reported as a failure instead as it will guarantee to fail when
569:           # Docker tries to run with --gpus all
570:           #
571:           # So, the correct check here is to query one of the missing piece of info like
572:           # GPU name, so that the command can fail accordingly
573:           nvidia-smi --query-gpu=gpu_name --format=csv,noheader --id=0
574:           NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS=$?
575: 
576:           # These are acceptable return code from nvidia-smi as copied from setup-nvidia GitHub action
577:           if [ "$NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS" -ne 0 ] && [ "$NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS" -ne 14 ]; then
578:             echo "NVIDIA driver installation has failed, shutting down the runner..."

583:           # power of 2, i.e. 1, 2, 4, or 8. This is to avoid flaky test issue when one GPU fails
584:           # https://github.com/pytorch/test-infra/issues/4000
585:           GPU_COUNT=$(nvidia-smi --list-gpus | wc -l)
586:           NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS=$?
587: 
588:           # These are acceptable return code from nvidia-smi as copied from setup-nvidia GitHub action
589:           if [ "$NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS" -ne 0 ] && [ "$NVIDIA_SMI_STATUS" -ne 14 ]; then
590:             echo "NVIDIA driver installation has failed, shutting down the runner..."
591:             .github/scripts/stop_runner_service.sh
592:           fi
593: 
594:           # Check the GPU count to be a power of 2
595:           if [ "$GPU_COUNT" -le 8 ] && [ "$GPU_COUNT" -ne 1 ] && [ "$GPU_COUNT" -ne 2 ] && [ "$GPU_COUNT" -ne 4 ] && [ "$GPU_COUNT" -ne 8 ]; then
596:             echo "NVIDIA driver detects $GPU_COUNT GPUs. The runner has a broken GPU, shutting it down..."
597:             .github/scripts/stop_runner_service.sh
598:           fi
599:

601:         if: always() && inputs.build-environment == 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
602:         shell: bash
603:         run: |
604:           # on s390x stop the container for clean worker stop
605:           docker stop -a || true
606:           docker kill -a || true

{"content":"1: name: mac-build
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_call:
5:     inputs:
6:       build-environment:
7:         required: true
8:         type: string
9:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
10:       runner-type:
11:         required: true
12:         type: string
13:         description: Name of the GitHub-managed runner type to use for the build.
14:       build-generates-artifacts:
15:         required: true
16:         type: boolean
17:         description: If set, upload generated build artifacts.
18:       xcode-version:
19:         required: false
20:         type: string
21:         default: ""
22:         description: What xcode version to build with.
23:       sync-tag:
24:         required: false
25:         type: string
26:         default: ""
27:         description: |
28:           If this is set, our linter will use this to make sure that every other
29:           job with the same `sync-tag` is identical.
30:       python-version:
31:         required: false
32:         type: string
33:         default: "3.12"
34:         description: |
35:           The python version to be used. Will be 3.9 by default
36:       test-matrix:
37:         required: false
38:         type: string
39:         description: |
40:           An option JSON description of what test configs to run later on. This
41:           is moved here from the Linux test workflow so that we can apply filter
42:           logic using test-config labels earlier and skip unnecessary builds
43:       sccache-use-gha:
44:         required: false
45:         type: boolean
46:         default: false
47:         description: If true, use the Github cache as the storage option for sccache instead of S3.
48: 
49:     outputs:
50:       test-matrix:
51:         value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.test-matrix }}
52:         description: An optional JSON description of what test configs to run later on.
53:       build-outcome:
54:         value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.build-outcome }}
55:         description: The outcome of the build step. This is used to influence test filtering logic later on.
56:       build-environment:
57:         value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.build-environment }}
58:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
59: 
60: jobs:
61:   build:
62:     # Don't run on forked repos.
63:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
64:     runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner-type }}
65:     env:
66:       BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
67:       SCCACHE_USE_GHA: ${{ inputs.sccache-use-gha }}  # this is placed here instead of the sccache step to appease actionlint
68:     outputs:
69:       build-outcome: ${{ steps.build.outcome }}
70:       test-matrix: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.test-matrix }}
71:       build-environment: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
72:     steps:
73:       - name: Clean up disk space before running MacOS workflow
74:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/check-disk-space@main
75: 
76:       # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
77:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
78:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
79: 
80:       - name: Set xcode version
81:         env:
82:           XCODE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.xcode-version }}
83:         run: |
84:           if [ -n "${XCODE_VERSION}" ]; then
85:             echo "DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode_${XCODE_VERSION}.app/Contents/Developer" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
86:           fi
87: 
88:       - name: Setup Python
89:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-python@main
90:         with:
91:           python-version: ${{ inputs.python-version }}
92:           pip-requirements-file: .ci/docker/requirements-ci.txt
93: 
94:       - name: Install sccache (only for non-forked PRs, and pushes to trunk)
95:         uses: nick-fields/retry@7152eba30c6575329ac0576536151aca5a72780e # v3.0.0
96:         if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository }}
97:         with:
98:           timeout_minutes: 5
99:           max_attempts: 3
100:           retry_wait_seconds: 90
101:           command: |
102:             set -ex
103: 
104:             DOWNLOAD_SCCACHE=0
105:             SCCACHE_VERSION="0.4.1"
106:             LOCAL_PATH="/usr/local/bin"
107: 
108:             if [ ! -f "${LOCAL_PATH}/sccache" ]; then
109:               DOWNLOAD_SCCACHE=1
110:             else
111:               LOCAL_VERSION=$("${LOCAL_PATH}/sccache" --version | cut -d" " -f2)
112: 
113:               if [ "${LOCAL_VERSION}" != "${SCCACHE_VERSION}" ]; then
114:                 DOWNLOAD_SCCACHE=1
115:               fi
116:             fi
117: 
118:             if [ "${DOWNLOAD_SCCACHE}" == "1" ]; then
119:               sudo curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors "https://s3.amazonaws.com/ossci-macos/sccache/sccache-v0.4.1-${RUNNER_ARCH}" --output "${LOCAL_PATH}/sccache"
120:               sudo chmod +x "${LOCAL_PATH}/sccache"
121:             fi
122: 
123:             if [[ "${SCCACHE_USE_GHA}" == "true" ]]; then
124:               echo "ACTIONS_CACHE_URL=${ACTIONS_CACHE_URL}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
125:               echo "ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN=${ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
126:               echo "SCCACHE_GHA_ENABLED=on" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
127:             else
128:               # The runner has access to the S3 bucket via IAM profile without the need
129:               # for any credential
130:               echo "SCCACHE_BUCKET=ossci-compiler-cache-circleci-v2" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
131:               echo "SCCACHE_S3_KEY_PREFIX=${GITHUB_WORKFLOW}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
132:             fi
133: 
134:             # This is needed so that later build script could find sccache (which sccache)
135:             echo "${LOCAL_PATH}" >> $GITHUB_PATH
136: 
137:       - name: Get workflow job id
138:         id: get-job-id
139:         uses: ./.github/actions/get-workflow-job-id
140:         if: always()
141:         with:
142:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
143: 
144:       # Apply the filter logic to the build step too if the test-config label is already there
145:       - name: Select all requested test configurations (if the test matrix is available)
146:         id: filter
147:         uses: ./.github/actions/filter-test-configs
148:         with:
149:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
150:           test-matrix: ${{ inputs.test-matrix }}
151:           job-name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
152: 
153:       - name: Build
154:         if: steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' || inputs.test-matrix == ''
155:         id: build
156:         env:
157:           OUR_GITHUB_JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
158:         run: |
159:           # TODO: Remove me later, and properly activate venv
160:           PATH="$VENV_PATH/bin:$PATH"
161:           export PATH
162: 
163:           # NB: Same trick as Linux, there is no need to initialize sccache with the risk of getting

96:             echo "REINSTALL_BREW_MINICONDA=1" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"

100:         continue-on-error: true

153:           use-gha: true

155:       - name: Parse ref

158: 
159:       - name: Check for keep-going label and re-enabled test issues

167:           test-matrix: ${{ inputs.test-matrix }}
168:           job-name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
169: 
170:       - name: Set Test step time
171:         id: test-timeout
172:         shell: bash
173:         env:
174:           JOB_TIMEOUT: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check == 'mem_leak_check' && 600 || inputs.timeout-minutes }}

176:           echo "timeout=$((JOB_TIMEOUT-30))" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

183:           PYTORCH_TEST_RERUN_DISABLED_TESTS: ${{ matrix.rerun_disabled_tests && '1' || '0' }}

188:           NO_TD: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-no-td }}
189:           PIP_REQUIREMENTS_FILE: .github/requirements/pip-requirements-${{ runner.os }}.txt
190:           GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
191:           GITHUB_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}
192:           GITHUB_JOB: ${{ github.job }}
193:           GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
194:           GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
195:           GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
196:           JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
197:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
198:           REENABLED_ISSUES: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.reenabled-issues }}
199:           HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN }}
200:         run: |
201:           # shellcheck disable=SC1090
202:           set -ex
203: 
204:           # TODO: Remove me later, and properly activate venv
205:           PATH="$VENV_PATH/bin:$PATH"
206:           export PATH
207: 
208:           # Print out some information about the test environment
209:           for tool in python3 python; do
210:             which $tool
211:             $tool --version
212:           done
213: 
214:           python3 -mpip install --no-index --no-deps dist/*.whl
215: 
216:           set +e
217:           pushd "${RUNNER_TEMP}"
218:           # Install pip dependencies if they are not found. This is to mitigate a peculiar
219:           # flaky missing dependencies on MacOS
220:           python3 -c "import torch"
221:           RC=$?
222:           popd
223: 
224:           if [ "${RC}" -ne 0 ]; then
225:             python3 -mpip install --ignore-installed -r "${PIP_REQUIREMENTS_FILE}"
226:           fi

{"content":"1: name: Create Release
2: 
3: on:
4:   push:
5:     branches:
6:       - main
7:       - release/*
8:     tags:
9:       # Final Release tags look like: v1.11.0
10:       - v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+
11:       # Release candidate tags look like: v1.11.0-rc1
12:       - v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+-rc[0-9]+
13:   release:
14:     types: [published]
15:   pull_request:
16:     paths: [.github/workflows/create_release.yml]
17: 
18: jobs:
19:   get-label-type:
20:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
21:     name: get-label-type
22:     uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/workflows/_runner-determinator.yml@main
23:     with:
24:       triggering_actor: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
25:       issue_owner: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login || github.event.issue.user.login }}
26:       curr_branch: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
27:       curr_ref_type: ${{ github.ref_type }}
28: 
29:   release:
30:     if: ${{ github.repository == 'pytorch/pytorch' }}
31:     name: Create Release
32:     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
33:     # https://github.com/softprops/action-gh-release?tab=readme-ov-file#permissions
34:     permissions:
35:       contents: write
36:     outputs:
37:       pt_release_name: ${{ steps.release_name.outputs.pt_release_name }}
38:       pt_pep517_release_name: ${{ steps.release_name.outputs.pt_pep517_release_name }}
39:     steps:
40:       - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
41:         with:
42:           show-progress: false
43:           submodules: 'recursive'
44:           ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
45:       - name: Fake name for PRs
46:         if: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
47:         run: echo "PT_GITHUB_REF=refs/tags/pr-tag" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
48:       - name: Real name for non-PRs
49:         if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' }}
50:         run: echo "PT_GITHUB_REF=$GITHUB_REF" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
51:       - name: Set filenames
52:         run: |
53:           tag_or_branch="${PT_GITHUB_REF#refs/tags/}"
54:           tag_or_branch="${tag_or_branch#refs/heads/}"
55:           # replace directory separators with _ in branch name
56:           tag_or_branch="${tag_or_branch//\//_}"
57:           torch_version="$(python -c 'from tools.generate_torch_version import get_torch_version; print(get_torch_version())')"
58:           {
59:             echo "PT_RELEASE_NAME=pytorch-$tag_or_branch";
60:             echo "PT_RELEASE_FILE=pytorch-$tag_or_branch.tar.gz";
61:             echo "PT_PEP517_RELEASE_FILE=torch-${torch_version}.tar.gz";
62:           } >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
63:       - name: Checkout optional submodules
64:         run: python3 tools/optional_submodules.py
65:       - name: Copy docs requirements for inclusion
66:         run: |
67:           # Replace symlink with actual file
68:           rm docs/requirements.txt || true
69:           cp .ci/docker/requirements-docs.txt docs/requirements.txt
70:       - name: Create source distribution
71:         run: |
72:           # Create new folder with specified name so extracting the archive yields that
73:           rm -rf "/tmp/$PT_RELEASE_NAME"
74:           cp -r "$PWD" "/tmp/$PT_RELEASE_NAME"
75:           mv "/tmp/$PT_RELEASE_NAME" .
76:           # Cleanup
77:           rm -rf "$PT_RELEASE_NAME"/{.circleci,.ci}
78:           find "$PT_RELEASE_NAME" -name '.git*' -exec rm -rv {} \; || true
79:           # Create archive
80:           tar -czf "$PT_RELEASE_FILE" "$PT_RELEASE_NAME"
81:           echo "Created source archive $PT_RELEASE_FILE with content: $(ls -a "$PT_RELEASE_NAME")"
82:       - name: Create PEP 517 compatible source distribution
83:         run: |
84:           pip install build==1.2.2.post1 || exit 1
85:           python -m build --sdist || exit 1
86:           cd dist || exit 1
87:       - name: Upload source distribution for release
88:         if: ${{ github.event_name == 'release' }}
89:         uses: softprops/action-gh-release@da05d552573ad5aba039eaac05058a918a7bf631 # v2.2.2
90:         with:
91:           files: |
92:             ${{ env.PT_RELEASE_FILE }}
93:             ${{ env.PT_PEP517_RELEASE_FILE }}
94:       - name: Upload source distribution to GHA artifacts  # for release tags
95:         if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') && contains(github.ref, 'rc') }}
96:         uses: actions/upload-artifact@50769540e7f4bd5e21e526ee35c689e35e0d6874 # v4.4.0
97:         with:
98:           name: ${{ env.PT_RELEASE_FILE }}
99:           path: ${{ env.PT_RELEASE_FILE }}
100:       - name: Upload PEP 517 source distribution to GHA artifacts  # for release tags
101:         if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') && contains(github.ref, 'rc') }}
102:         uses: actions/upload-artifact@50769540e7f4bd5e21e526ee35c689e35e0d6874 # v4.4.0
103:         with:
104:           name: ${{ env.PT_PEP517_RELEASE_FILE }}
105:           path: dist/${{ env.PT_PEP517_RELEASE_FILE }}
106:       - name: Set output
107:         id: release_name
108:         run: |
109:           {
110:             echo "pt_release_name=${{ env.PT_RELEASE_FILE }}";
111:             echo "pt_pep517_release_name=${{ env.PT_PEP517_RELEASE_FILE }}";
112:           } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
113: 
114:   upload_source_code_to_s3:
115:     if: ${{ github.repository == 'pytorch/pytorch' && github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') && contains(github.ref, 'rc') }}
116:     runs-on: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"

133:         with:

135:           aws-region: us-east-1

138:           s3-bucket: pytorch

{"content":"1: name: docker-builds
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_dispatch:
5:   pull_request:
6:     paths:
7:       - .ci/docker/**
8:       - .github/workflows/docker-builds.yml
9:       - .lintrunner.toml
10:   push:
11:     branches:
12:       - main
13:       - release/*
14:       - landchecks/*
15:     paths:
16:       - .ci/docker/**
17:       - .github/workflows/docker-builds.yml
18:       - .lintrunner.toml
19:   schedule:
20:     - cron: 1 3 * * 3
21: 
22: concurrency:
23:   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
24:   cancel-in-progress: true
25: 
26: env:
27:   ALPINE_IMAGE: 308535385114.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/tool/alpine

29: 
30: permissions: read-all
31: 
32: jobs:
33:   get-label-type:
34:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
35:     name: get-label-type
36:     uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/workflows/_runner-determinator.yml@main
37:     with:
38:       triggering_actor: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
39:       issue_owner: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login || github.event.issue.user.login }}
40:       curr_branch: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
41:       curr_ref_type: ${{ github.ref_type }}
42: 
43:   docker-build:
44:     environment: ${{ (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.event.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) && 'docker-build' || '' }}
45:     needs: get-label-type
46:     timeout-minutes: 240
47:     strategy:
48:       fail-fast: false
49:       matrix:
50:         runner: [linux.12xlarge]
51:         docker-image-name: [
52:           pytorch-linux-jammy-cuda12.8-cudnn9-py3-gcc11,
53:           pytorch-linux-jammy-cuda13.0-cudnn9-py3-gcc11,
54:           pytorch-linux-jammy-cuda12.8-cudnn9-py3.12-gcc11-vllm,
55:           pytorch-linux-jammy-cuda12.8-cudnn9-py3-gcc11-inductor-benchmarks,
56:           pytorch-linux-jammy-cuda13.0-cudnn9-py3-gcc11-inductor-benchmarks,
57:           pytorch-linux-jammy-cuda12.4-cudnn9-py3-gcc11,
58:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3.10-clang12,
59:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3.11-clang12,
60:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3.12-clang12,
61:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3.13-clang12,
62:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3.14-clang12,
63:           pytorch-linux-jammy-rocm-n-py3,
64:           pytorch-linux-noble-rocm-n-py3,
65:           pytorch-linux-jammy-rocm-n-py3-benchmarks,
66:           pytorch-linux-jammy-cuda12.8-cudnn9-py3.10-clang12,
67:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3.10-gcc11,
68:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3-gcc11-inductor-benchmarks,
69:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3.12-halide,
70:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3.12-pallas,
71:           pytorch-linux-jammy-cuda12.8-py3.12-pallas,
72:           pytorch-linux-jammy-xpu-n-1-py3,
73:           pytorch-linux-noble-xpu-n-py3,
74:           pytorch-linux-noble-xpu-n-py3-inductor-benchmarks,
75:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3-clang18-asan,
76:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3-clang12-onnx,
77:           pytorch-linux-jammy-linter,
78:           pytorch-linux-jammy-cuda12.8-cudnn9-py3.10-linter,
79:           # TODO: Re-enable me when docker pin update happens
80:           # pytorch-linux-jammy-py3-clang12-executorch,
81:           pytorch-linux-jammy-py3.12-triton-cpu,
82:           pytorch-linux-noble-riscv64-py3.12-gcc14
83:         ]
84:         include:
85:           - docker-image-name: pytorch-linux-jammy-aarch64-py3.10-gcc13
86:             runner: linux.arm64.m7g.4xlarge
87:           - docker-image-name: pytorch-linux-jammy-aarch64-py3.10-clang21
88:             runner: linux.arm64.m7g.4xlarge
89:           - docker-image-name: pytorch-linux-jammy-aarch64-py3.10-gcc13-inductor-benchmarks
90:             runner: linux.arm64.m7g.4xlarge
91:             timeout-minutes: 600
92:     # Docker uploads fail from LF runners, see https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/pull/137358
93:     # runs-on: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}${{ matrix.runner }}"
94:     runs-on: "${{ matrix.runner }}"
95:     steps:
96:       - name: Clean workspace
97:         shell: bash
98:         run: |
99:           echo "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}"
100:           sudo rm -rf "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}"
101:           mkdir "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}"
102: 
103:       # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
104:       # deep clone (fetch-depth 0) required for git merge-base
105:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
106:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
107: 
108:       - name: Setup Linux
109:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-linux
110: 
111:       - name: Build docker image
112:         id: build-docker-image
113:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/calculate-docker-image@main
114:         with:
115:           docker-image-name: ci-image:${{ matrix.docker-image-name }}
116:           always-rebuild: true
117:           push: true
118: 
119:       - name: Pull docker image
120:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/pull-docker-image@main
121:         with:
122:           docker-image: ${{ steps.build-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
123: 
124:       - name: Generate output
125:         if: contains(matrix.docker-image-name, 'rocm')
126:         id: generate_output
127:         run: |
128:           docker_image_name="${{ matrix.docker-image-name }}"
129:           docker_image_tag="${{ steps.build-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}"
130:           echo "${docker_image_name}=${docker_image_tag}" >> docker-builds-output-${docker_image_name}.txt
131: 
132:       - name: Upload artifacts
133:         uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4.4.0
134:         if: contains(matrix.docker-image-name, 'rocm')
135:         with:
136:           name: docker-builds-artifacts-${{ matrix.docker-image-name }}
137:           retention-days: 14
138:           path: ./docker-builds-output-${{ matrix.docker-image-name }}.txt
139: 
140:       - uses: nick-fields/retry@7152eba30c6575329ac0576536151aca5a72780e # v3.0.0
141:         name: Push to https://ghcr.io/
142:         id: push-to-ghcr-io
143:         if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' }}
144:         env:
145:           ECR_DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ steps.build-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
146:           GHCR_PAT: ${{ secrets.GHCR_PAT }}
147:         with:
148:           shell: bash
149:           timeout_minutes: 60
150:           max_attempts: 5
151:           retry_wait_seconds: 90
152:           command: |
153:             ghcr_image="ghcr.io/pytorch/ci-image"
154:             tag=${ECR_DOCKER_IMAGE##*:}
155:             # Push docker image to the ghcr.io
156:             echo $GHCR_PAT | docker login ghcr.io -u pytorch --password-stdin
157:             docker tag "${ECR_DOCKER_IMAGE}" "${ghcr_image}:${tag}"
158:             docker push "${ghcr_image}:${tag}"
159: 
160:       - name: Chown workspace
161:         uses: ./.github/actions/chown-workspace
162:         with:
163:           ALPINE_IMAGE: 308535385114.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/${{ contains(matrix.runner, 'arm64') && 'arm64v8' || 'tool' }}/alpine
164:         if: always()
165: 
166:       - name: Teardown Linux
167:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/teardown-linux@main
168:         if: always()

{"content":"1: name: docker-cache-rocm
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_run:
5:     workflows: [docker-builds]
6:     branches: [main, release]
7:     types:
8:       - completed
9:   workflow_dispatch:
10:     inputs:
11:       branch:
12:         type: string
13:         description: Branch corresponding to the docker images being cached
14:         required: true
15:       run_id:
16:         type: string
17:         description: Workflow run id to pull artifacts from
18:         required: true
19: 
20: concurrency:
21:   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch || github.event.inputs.branch }}
22:   cancel-in-progress: true
23: 
24: permissions:
25:   id-token: write
26:   contents: read
27:   actions: read
28: 
29: jobs:
30:   download-docker-builds-artifacts:
31:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
32:     name: download-docker-builds-artifacts
33:     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
34:     outputs:
35:       pytorch-linux-jammy-rocm-n-py3: ${{ steps.process-artifacts.outputs.pytorch-linux-jammy-rocm-n-py3 }}
36:       pytorch-linux-noble-rocm-n-py3: ${{ steps.process-artifacts.outputs.pytorch-linux-noble-rocm-n-py3 }}
37:       pytorch-linux-jammy-rocm-n-py3-benchmarks: ${{ steps.process-artifacts.outputs.pytorch-linux-jammy-rocm-n-py3-benchmarks }}
38:     steps:
39:       - name: Download artifacts
40:         uses: actions/download-artifact@65a9edc5881444af0b9093a5e628f2fe47ea3b2e #4.1.7
41:         with:
42:           run-id: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.id || github.event.inputs.run_id }}
43:           path: ./docker-builds-artifacts
44:           merge-multiple: true
45:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
46: 
47:       - name: Process artifacts
48:         id: process-artifacts
49:         run: |
50:           ls -R ./docker-builds-artifacts
51:           cat ./docker-builds-artifacts/*txt >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
52:           cat "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
53: 
54:   docker-cache:
55:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
56:     needs: download-docker-builds-artifacts
57:     strategy:
58:       fail-fast: false
59:       matrix:
60:         runner: [linux.rocm.gfx942.docker-cache, linux.rocm.mi250.docker-cache]
61:         docker-image: [
62:           "${{ needs.download-docker-builds-artifacts.outputs.pytorch-linux-jammy-rocm-n-py3 }}",
63:           "${{ needs.download-docker-builds-artifacts.outputs.pytorch-linux-noble-rocm-n-py3 }}"
64:           #"${{ needs.download-docker-builds-artifacts.outputs.pytorch-linux-jammy-rocm-n-py3-benchmarks }}"
65:         ]
66:     runs-on: "${{ matrix.runner }}"
67:     steps:
68:       - name: debug
69:         run: |
70:           JSON_STRINGIFIED="${{ toJSON(needs.download-docker-builds-artifacts.outputs) }}"
71:           echo "Outputs of download-docker-builds-artifacts job: ${JSON_STRINGIFIED}"
72: 
73:       - name: configure aws credentials
74:         id: aws_creds
75:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0
76:         with:
77:           role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::308535385114:role/gha_workflow_s3_and_ecr_read_only
78:           aws-region: us-east-1
79:           role-duration-seconds: 18000
80: 
81:       - name: Login to Amazon ECR
82:         id: login-ecr
83:         continue-on-error: false
84:         uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@062b18b96a7aff071d4dc91bc00c4c1a7945b076 # v2.0.1
85: 
86:       - name: Generate ghrc.io tag
87:         id: ghcr-io-tag
88:         run: |
89:             ecr_image="${{ matrix.docker-image }}"
90:             ghcr_image="ghcr.io/pytorch/ci-image:${ecr_image##*:}"
91:             echo "ghcr_image=${ghcr_image}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
92: 
93:       - name: Pull docker image
94:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/pull-docker-image@main
95:         with:
96:           docker-image: ${{ steps.ghcr-io-tag.outputs.ghcr_image }}
97: 
98:       - name: Save as tarball
99:         run: |
100:           docker_image_tag=${{ matrix.docker-image }}
101:           docker_image_tag="${docker_image_tag#*:}" # Remove everything before and including first ":"
102:           docker_image_tag="${docker_image_tag%-*}" # Remove everything after and including last "-"
103:           ref_name=${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_branch || github.event.inputs.branch }}
104:           if [[ $ref_name =~ "release/" ]]; then
105:             ref_suffix="release"
106:           elif [[ $ref_name == "main" ]]; then
107:             ref_suffix="main"
108:           else
109:             echo "Unexpected branch in ref_name: ${ref_name}" && exit 1
110:           fi
111:           docker tag ${{ steps.ghcr-io-tag.outputs.ghcr_image }} ${{ matrix.docker-image }}
112:           # mv is atomic operation, so we use intermediate tar.tmp file to prevent read-write contention
113:           docker save -o ~/pytorch-data/docker/${docker_image_tag}.tar.tmp ${{ matrix.docker-image }}
114:           mv ~/pytorch-data/docker/${docker_image_tag}.tar.tmp ~/pytorch-data/docker/${docker_image_tag}_${ref_suffix}.tar

{"content":"1: name: Build Official Docker Images
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_dispatch:
5:   pull_request:
6:     paths:
7:       - Dockerfile
8:       - docker.Makefile
9:       - .github/workflows/docker-release.yml
10:       - .github/scripts/generate_docker_release_matrix.py
11:       - .github/scripts/generate_binary_build_matrix.py

13:     branches:
14:       - nightly

16:       # Final Release tags look like: v1.11.0

18:       # Release candidate tags look like: v1.11.0-rc1
19:       - v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+-rc[0-9]+
20:       - ciflow/nightly/*
21: 
22: concurrency:

24:   cancel-in-progress: true
25: 
26: env:
27:   BUILD_PROGRESS: plain
28:   BUILD_TYPE: official
29:   DOCKER_ORG: pytorch
30:   DOCKER_REGISTRY: ghcr.io

"""Read raw Sourcegraph content from stdin and write to a file."""
import re, sys

def strip_ln(s):
    lines = s.split('\n')
    out = []
    for line in lines:
        m = re.match(r'^\d+: (.*)', line)
        if m:
            out.append(m.group(1))
        elif re.match(r'^\d+:$', line.rstrip('\r')):
            out.append('')
        else:

    while out and out[-1] == '':

name: Build manywheel docker images for s390x

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    tags:
      - ciflow/s390/*
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/build-manywheel-images-s390x.yml


env:
  DOCKER_REGISTRY: "docker.io"
  DOCKER_BUILDKIT: 1
  WITH_PUSH: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/release') || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) }}

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build-docker-cpu-s390x:
    if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
    environment: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/release') || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) && 'docker-build') || '' }}
    runs-on: linux.s390x
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PyTorch
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
        with:
          submodules: false
          no-sudo: true

      - name: Build Docker Image
        run: |
          .ci/docker/manywheel/build.sh manylinuxs390x-builder:cpu-s390x -t manylinuxs390x-builder:cpu-s390x

      - name: Tag and (if WITH_PUSH) push docker image to docker.io
        env:
          DOCKER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_TOKEN }}
          DOCKER_ID: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_ID }}
          CREATED_FULL_DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME: manylinuxs390x-builder:cpu-s390x
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euox pipefail
          GITHUB_REF="${GITHUB_REF:-$(git symbolic-ref -q HEAD || git describe --tags --exact-match)}"
          GIT_BRANCH_NAME="${GITHUB_REF##*/}"
          GIT_COMMIT_SHA="${GITHUB_SHA:-$(git rev-parse HEAD)}"
          CI_FOLDER_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD:.ci/docker)"

          DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX="docker.io/pytorch/${CREATED_FULL_DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME}"

          docker tag "${CREATED_FULL_DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME}" "${DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX}-${GIT_BRANCH_NAME}"
          docker tag "${CREATED_FULL_DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME}" "${DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX}-${GIT_COMMIT_SHA}"
          docker tag "${CREATED_FULL_DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME}" "${DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX}-${CI_FOLDER_SHA}"

          # Pretty sure Github will mask tokens and I'm not sure if it will even be
          # printed due to pipe, but just in case
          set +x
          if [[ "${WITH_PUSH:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "${DOCKER_TOKEN}" | docker login -u "${DOCKER_ID}" --password-stdin
            docker push "${DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX}-${GIT_BRANCH_NAME}"
            docker push "${DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX}-${GIT_COMMIT_SHA}"
            docker push "${DOCKER_IMAGE_NAME_PREFIX}-${CI_FOLDER_SHA}"
          fi

      - name: Cleanup docker
        if: cancelled()
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # If podman build command is interrupted,
          # it can leave a couple of processes still running.
          # Order them to stop for clean shutdown.
          # It looks like sometimes some processes remain
          # after first cleanup.
          # Wait a bit and do cleanup again. It looks like it helps.

name: Check Labels

on:
  # We need pull_request_target to be able to post comments on PRs from forks.
  # Only allow pull_request_target when merging to main, not some historical branch.
  #
  # Make sure to don't introduce explicit checking out and installing/running
  # untrusted user code into this workflow!
  pull_request_target:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]
    branches: [main]

  # To check labels on ghstack PRs.
  # Note: as pull_request doesn't trigger on PRs targeting main,
  # to test changes to the workflow itself one needs to create
  # a PR that targets a gh/**/base branch.
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]
    branches: [gh/**/base]

  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: 'PR number to check labels for'
        required: true

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  check-labels:
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write
    name: Check labels
    if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
    runs-on: linux.24_04.4x
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PyTorch
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
        with:
          submodules: false
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5.6.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
          architecture: x64
          check-latest: false
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: |
            **/.github/requirements-gha-cache.txt

      - name: Install requirements
        id: requirements
        run: |
          pip install -r .github/requirements-gha-cache.txt --user

      - name: Check labels
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUM: ${{ github.event.number || github.event.inputs.pr_number }}
        run: |
          set -ex
          python3 .github/scripts/check_labels.py --exit-non-zero "${PR_NUM}"

# runs unit tests for dynamo.
name: dynamo-unittest

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - ciflow/dynamo/*
  workflow_call:
  schedule:
    - cron: 29 8 * * * # about 1:29am PDT

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  id-token: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  get-label-type:
    name: get-label-type
    uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/workflows/_runner-determinator.yml@main
    if: ${{ (github.event_name != 'schedule' || github.repository == 'pytorch/pytorch') && github.repository_owner == 'pytorch' }}
    with:
      triggering_actor: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
      issue_owner: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login || github.event.issue.user.login }}
      curr_branch: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
      curr_ref_type: ${{ github.ref_type }}
      opt_out_experiments: lf

  dynamo-build:
    name: dynamo-build
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_linux-build.yml
    needs: get-label-type
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.11', '3.12', '3.13']
    with:
      runner_prefix: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}"
      build-environment: linux-jammy-py${{ matrix.python-version }}-clang12
      docker-image-name: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-py${{ matrix.python-version }}-clang12
      test-matrix: |
        { include: [
          { config: "dynamo_core", shard: 1, num_shards: 1, runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.c7i.2xlarge" },
          { config: "dynamo_wrapped", shard: 1, num_shards: 3, runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.c7i.2xlarge" },
          { config: "dynamo_wrapped", shard: 2, num_shards: 3, runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.c7i.2xlarge" },
          { config: "dynamo_wrapped", shard: 3, num_shards: 3, runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.c7i.2xlarge" },
        ]}
    secrets: inherit

  dynamo-test:
    name: dynamo-test
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_linux-test.yml
    needs: [get-label-type, dynamo-build]
    strategy:
      matrix:
        python-version: ['3.11', '3.12', '3.13']
    with:
      build-environment: linux-jammy-py${{ matrix.python-version }}-clang12
      docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-py${{ matrix.python-version }}-clang12
      test-matrix: |
        { include: [
          { config: "dynamo_core", shard: 1, num_shards: 1, runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.c7i.2xlarge" },

        ]}
    secrets: inherit

{"content":"1: name: Lint
2: # Workflow that runs lint checks and also unittests for tools, and scripts.

4: on:
5:   pull_request:
6:     branches-ignore:

9:     branches:

12:       - landchecks/*
13:     tags:
14:       - ciflow/pull/*
15:       - ciflow/trunk/*
16:   workflow_dispatch:
17: 
18: permissions: read-all
19: # The names of steps that actually test the code should be suffixed with `(nonretryable)`.
20: # When any other step fails, it's job will be retried once by retryBot.
21: jobs:
22:   get-label-type:
23:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
24:     name: get-label-type
25:     uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/workflows/_runner-determinator.yml@main
26:     with:
27:       triggering_actor: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
28:       issue_owner: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login || github.event.issue.user.login }}
29:       curr_branch: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
30: 
31:   get-changed-files:
32:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
33:     name: Get changed files
34:     uses: ./.github/workflows/_get-changed-files.yml
35:     with:
36:       all_files: ${{ contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'lint-all-files') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'Reverted') || github.event_name == 'push' }}
37: 
38:   lintrunner-clang:
39:     uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
40:     # Needed to prevent deduping on HUD
41:     name: lintrunner-clang-${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files == '*' && 'all' || 'partial' }}
42:     needs: [get-label-type, get-changed-files]
43:     # Only run if there are changed files relevant to clangtidy / clangformat
44:     if: |
45:       github.repository_owner == 'pytorch' && (
46:         needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files == '*' ||
47:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.h') ||
48:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cpp') ||
49:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cc') ||
50:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cxx') ||
51:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.hpp') ||
52:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.hxx') ||
53:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cu') ||
54:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cuh') ||
55:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.mm') ||
56:         contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.metal')
57:       )
58:     with:
59:       timeout: 120
60:       runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
61:       docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-cuda12.8-cudnn9-py3.10-linter
62:       # NB: A shallow checkout won't work here because calculate-docker-image requires a full checkout
63:       # to run git rev-parse HEAD~:.ci/docker when a new image is needed
64:       fetch-depth: 0
65:       submodules: true
66:       ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
67:       script: |
68:         CHANGED_FILES="${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files }}"
69:         if [ "$CHANGED_FILES" = "*" ]; then
70:           export ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--take CLANGTIDY,CLANGFORMAT --all-files"
71:         else
72:           export ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--take CLANGTIDY,CLANGFORMAT $CHANGED_FILES"
73:         fi
74:         export CLANG=1
75:         .github/scripts/lintrunner.sh
76: 
77:   # NOTE: mypy needs its own job because it depends on --all-files, without assessing all files it sometimes
78:   #       fails to find types when it should
79:   # NOTE: We should be able to disable this and consolidate with Pyrefly
80:   lintrunner-pyrefly:
81:     uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main

94:       docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-linter

96:       # to run git rev-parse HEAD~:.ci/docker when a new image is needed
97:       fetch-depth: 0
98:       submodules: true
99:       ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
100:       script: |
101:         CHANGED_FILES="${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files }}"
102:         echo "Running pyrefly"
103:         ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--take PYREFLY --all-files" .github/scripts/lintrunner.sh

106:     uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main

108:     needs: [get-label-type, get-changed-files]
109:     with:

115:       fetch-depth: 0
116:       submodules: true

118:       script: |

122:           ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--skip CLANGTIDY,CLANGTIDY_EXECUTORCH_COMPATIBILITY,CLANGFORMAT,PYREFLY --all-files" .github/scripts/lintrunner.sh
123:         else
124:           ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--skip CLANGTIDY,CLANGTIDY_EXECUTORCH_COMPATIBILITY,CLANGFORMAT,PYREFLY ${CHANGED_FILES}" .github/scripts/lintrunner.sh
125:         fi

127:   quick-checks:
128:     uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
129:     needs: get-label-type
130:     with:
131:       timeout: 120
132:       runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
133:       docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-linter
134:       fetch-depth: 0
135:       ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
136:       script: |
137:         # Ensure no non-breaking spaces
138:         # NB: We use 'printf' below rather than '\u000a' since bash pre-4.2
139:         # does not support the '\u000a' syntax (which is relevant for local linters)
140:         (! git --no-pager grep -In "$(printf '\xC2\xA0')" -- . || (echo "The above lines have non-breaking spaces (U+00A0); please convert them to spaces (U+0020)"; false))
141: 
142:         # Ensure cross-OS compatible file names
143:         (! git ls-files | grep -E '([<>:"|?*]|[ .]$)' || (echo "The above file names are not valid across all operating systems. Please ensure they don't contain the characters '<>:""|?*' and don't end with a white space or a '.' "; false))
144: 
145:         # Ensure no versionless Python shebangs
146:         (! git --no-pager grep -In '#!.*python$' -- . || (echo "The above lines have versionless Python shebangs; please specify either python2 or python3"; false))

{"content":"1: name: linux-build

46:         description: |
47:           An option JSON description of what test configs to run later on. This
48:           is moved here from the Linux test workflow so that we can apply filter
49:           logic using test-config labels earlier and skip unnecessary builds
50:       selected-test-configs:
51:         description: |

53:           The empty list means we are going to keep every configurations by defaults
54:         required: false
55:         type: string
56:         default: ""
57:       s3-bucket:
58:         description: S3 bucket to download artifact
59:         required: false
60:         type: string

77:         type: number

80:         description: |

82:         required: false

84:         default: 1

86:         description: |
87:           If set, the build try to pull an old wheel from s3 that was built on a
88:           commit with no cpp changes from this commit

91:         default: true

95:           wheels as artifacts

103:         required: false
104:         type: string
105:         default: ""

109:         required: false

123:         description: An optional JSON description of what test configs to run later on.

128: jobs:
129:   build:
130:     environment: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && 'scribe-protected' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/release/') && 'scribe-protected' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci-scribe') && 'scribe-pr' || '' }}
131:     # Don't run on forked repos
132:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
133:     runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner_prefix}}${{ inputs.runner }}
134:     timeout-minutes: 480
135:     outputs:
136:       docker-image: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
137:       test-matrix: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.test-matrix }}
138:       build-environment: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
139:     steps:
140:       - name: Setup SSH (Click me for login details)
141:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-ssh@main
142:         if: inputs.build-environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
143:         with:
144:           github-secret: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
145:           instructions: |
146:             Build is done inside the container, to start an interactive session run:
147:               docker exec -it $(docker container ps --format '{{.ID}}') bash
148: 
149:       # [pytorch repo ref]
150:       # Use a pytorch/pytorch reference instead of a reference to the local
151:       # checkout because when we run this action we don't *have* a local
152:       # checkout. In other cases you should prefer a local checkout.
153:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
154:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
155:         with:
156:           no-sudo: true
157: 
158:       - name: Setup Linux
159:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-linux
160:         if: inputs.build-environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
161: 
162:       - name: configure aws credentials
163:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0
164:         if: ${{ inputs.aws-role-to-assume != '' && inputs.build-environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel' }}
165:         with:
166:           role-to-assume: ${{ inputs.aws-role-to-assume }}
167:           role-session-name: gha-linux-build
168:           aws-region: us-east-1
169: 
170:       - name: Get workflow job id
171:         id: get-job-id
172:         uses: ./.github/actions/get-workflow-job-id
173:         if: always()
174:         with:
175:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
176: 
177:       - name: Check if can use old whl build
178:         id: use-old-whl
179:         uses: ./.github/actions/reuse-old-whl
180:         if: ${{ inputs.allow-reuse-old-whl }}
181:         with:
182:           build-environment: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
183:           run-id: ${{ github.run_id }}
184:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
185:           job-id: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
186:           job-name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
187: 
188:       - name: Calculate docker image
189:         id: calculate-docker-image
190:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/calculate-docker-image@main
191:         if: inputs.build-environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel'
192:         with:
193:           docker-image-name: ${{ inputs.docker-image-name }}
194: 
195:       - name: Use following to pull public copy of the image
196:         id: print-ghcr-mirror
197:         if: inputs.build-environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel' && steps.use-old-whl.outputs.reuse != 'true'
198:         env:
199:           ECR_DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
200:         shell: bash
201:         run: |
202:           tag=${ECR_DOCKER_IMAGE##*:}
203:           echo "docker pull ghcr.io/pytorch/ci-image:${tag/:/-}"
204: 
205:       - name: Pull docker image
206:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/pull-docker-image@main
207:         if: inputs.build-environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel' && steps.use-old-whl.outputs.reuse != 'true'
208:         with:
209:           docker-image: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
210: 
211:       - name: Parse ref
212:         id: parse-ref
213:         run: .github/scripts/parse_ref.py
214: 
215:       # Apply the filter logic to the build step too if the test-config label is already there
216:       - name: Select all requested test configurations (if the test matrix is available)
217:         id: filter
218:         uses: ./.github/actions/filter-test-configs
219:         with:
220:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
221:           test-matrix: ${{ inputs.test-matrix }}
222:           selected-test-configs: ${{ inputs.selected-test-configs }}
223:           job-name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
224: 
225:       - name: Start monitoring script
226:         id: monitor-script
227:         if: ${{ !inputs.disable-monitor }}
228:         shell: bash
229:         continue-on-error: true
230:         env:
231:           JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
232:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
233:           WORKFLOW_NAME: ${{ github.workflow }}
234:           WORKFLOW_RUN_ID: ${{github.run_id}}
235:           MONITOR_LOG_INTERVAL: ${{ inputs.monitor-log-interval }}
236:           MONITOR_DATA_COLLECT_INTERVAL: ${{ inputs.monitor-data-collect-interval }}
237:         run: |
238:           mkdir -p ../../usage_logs
239:           python3 -m pip install psutil==5.9.8 dataclasses_json==0.6.7
240:           python3 -m tools.stats.monitor \
241:           --log-interval "$MONITOR_LOG_INTERVAL" \
242:           --data-collect-interval "$MONITOR_DATA_COLLECT_INTERVAL" \
243:           > "../../usage_logs/usage_log_build_${JOB_ID}.txt" 2>&1 &
244:           echo "monitor-script-pid=${!}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
245: 
246:       - name: Download pytest cache
247:         uses: ./.github/actions/pytest-cache-download
248:         continue-on-error: true
249:         if: inputs.build-environment != 'linux-s390x-binary-manywheel' && steps.use-old-whl.outputs.reuse != 'true'
250:         with:
251:           cache_dir: .pytest_cache
252:           job_identifier: ${{ github.workflow }}_${{ inputs.build-environment }}
253:           s3_bucket: ${{ inputs.s3-bucket }}
254: 
255:       - name: Build
256:         if: (steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' || inputs.test-matrix == '') && steps.use-old-whl.outputs.reuse != 'true'
257:         id: build
258:         env:
259:           BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
260:           BRANCH: ${{ steps.parse-ref.outputs.branch }}
261:           PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
262:           SHA1: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
263:           # Do not set SCCACHE_S3_KEY_PREFIX to share the cache between all build jobs
264:           SCCACHE_BUCKET: ossci-compiler-cache-circleci-v2
265:           SCCACHE_REGION: us-east-1
266:           XLA_CLANG_CACHE_S3_BUCKET_NAME: ossci-compiler-clang-cache-circleci-xla
267:           PR_LABELS: ${{ toJson(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name) }}
268:           TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: ${{ inputs.cuda-arch-list }}
269:           DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
270:           DOCKER_IMAGE_S390X: ${{ inputs.docker-image-name }}
271:           XLA_CUDA: ${{ contains(inputs.build-environment, 'xla') && '0' || '' }}
272:           OUR_GITHUB_JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
273:           HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN }}
274:           SCRIBE_GRAPHQL_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SCRIBE_GRAPHQL_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
275:           BUILD_ADDITIONAL_PACKAGES: ${{ inputs.build-additional-packages }}
276:           RUNNER: ${{ inputs.runner }}
277:         run: |
278:           START_TIME=$(date +%s)
279:           if [[ ${BUILD_ENVIRONMENT} == *"s390x"* ]]; then
280:             JENKINS_USER=
281:             USED_IMAGE="${DOCKER_IMAGE_S390X}"
282:             # ensure that docker container cleanly exits in 12 hours
283:             # if for some reason cleanup action doesn't stop container
284:             # when job is cancelled
285:             DOCKER_SHELL_CMD="sleep 12h"
286: 
287:             # since some steps are skipped on s390x, if they are necessary, run them here
288:             env | grep '^GITHUB' >> "/tmp/github_env_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
289:             env | grep '^CI' >> "/tmp/github_env_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
290:           else
291:             JENKINS_USER="--user jenkins"
292:             USED_IMAGE="${DOCKER_IMAGE}"
293:             DOCKER_SHELL_CMD=
294:           fi
295: 
296:           # Leaving 1GB for the runner and other things
297:           TOTAL_AVAILABLE_MEMORY_IN_GB=$(awk '/MemTotal/ { printf "%.3f \n", $2/1024/1024 - 1 }' /proc/meminfo)
298:           # https://docs.docker.com/engine/containers/resource_constraints/#--memory-swap-details, the 3GB swap
299:           # comes from https://github.com/pytorch/test-infra/pull/6058
300:           TOTAL_MEMORY_WITH_SWAP=$(("${TOTAL_AVAILABLE_MEMORY_IN_GB%.*}" + 3))
301: 
302:           if [[ ${BUILD_ENVIRONMENT} == *"riscv64"* ]]; then
303:             # EC2 specific setup for RISC-V emulation
304:             # Ensure binfmt_misc is available
305:             echo "Mounting binfmt_misc filesystem"
306:             sudo mount binfmt_misc -t binfmt_misc /proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc 2>/dev/null || true
307: 
308:             echo "QEMU registration: multiarch/qemu-user-static"
309:             docker run --rm --privileged multiarch/qemu-user-static --reset -p yes || true
310: 
311:             # Final verification
312:             echo "Checking binfmt_misc status:"
313:             ls -la /proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc/ 2>/dev/null || echo "Cannot access binfmt_misc directory"
314: 
315:             if [ -f /proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc/qemu-riscv64 ]; then

import re
import sys
import json

def strip_ln(content):
    """Strip line number prefixes from Sourcegraph API content."""
    lines = content.split('\n')
    out = []
    for line in lines:
        m = re.match(r'^(\d+): (.*)', line)
        if m:
            out.append(m.group(2))
        elif re.match(r'^\d+:$', line.rstrip('\r')):
            out.append('')
        else:
            out.append(line)
    while out and out[-1] == '':
        out.pop()
    return '\n'.join(out) + '\n'

content = strip_ln(data['content'])

with open(output_path, 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)
print(f"Written {len(content.splitlines())} lines to {output_path}")
