arguments.content:
name: Lint
# Workflow that runs lint checks and also unittests for tools, and scripts.

on:
  pull_request:
    branches-ignore:
      - nightly
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - release/*
      - landchecks/*
    tags:
      - ciflow/pull/*
      - ciflow/trunk/*
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: read-all
# The names of steps that actually test the code should be suffixed with `(nonretryable)`.
# When any other step fails, it's job will be retried once by retryBot.
jobs:
  get-label-type:
    if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
    name: get-label-type
    uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/workflows/_runner-determinator.yml@main
    with:
      triggering_actor: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
      issue_owner: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login || github.event.issue.user.login }}
      curr_branch: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}

  get-changed-files:
    if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
    name: Get changed files
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_get-changed-files.yml
    with:
      all_files: ${{ contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'lint-all-files') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'Reverted') || github.event_name == 'push' }}

  lintrunner-clang:
    uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
    # Needed to prevent deduping on HUD
    name: lintrunner-clang-${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files == '*' && 'all' || 'partial' }}
    needs: [get-label-type, get-changed-files]
    # Only run if there are changed files relevant to clangtidy / clangformat
    if: |
      github.repository_owner == 'pytorch' && (
        needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files == '*' ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.h') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cpp') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cc') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cxx') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.hpp') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.hxx') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cu') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cuh') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.mm') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.metal')
      )
    with:
      timeout: 120
      runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
      docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-cuda12.8-cudnn9-py3.10-linter
      # NB: A shallow checkout won't work here because calculate-docker-image requires a full checkout
      # to run git rev-parse HEAD~:.ci/docker when a new image is needed
      fetch-depth: 0
      submodules: true
      ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      script: |
        CHANGED_FILES="${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files }}"
        if [ "$CHANGED_FILES" = "*" ]; then
          export ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--take CLANGTIDY,CLANGFORMAT --all-files"
        else
          export ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--take CLANGTIDY,CLANGFORMAT $CHANGED_FILES"
        fi
        export CLANG=1
        .github/scripts/lintrunner.sh

  # NOTE: mypy needs its own job because it depends on --all-files, without assessing all files it sometimes
  #       fails to find types when it should
  # NOTE: We should be able to disable this and consolidate with Pyrefly
  lintrunner-pyrefly:
    uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
    name: lintrunner-pyrefly-${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files == '*' && 'all' || 'partial' }}
    needs: [get-label-type, get-changed-files]
    # Only run if there are changed files relevant to pyrefly
    if: |
      github.repository_owner == 'pytorch' && (
        needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files == '*' ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.py') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.pyi')
      )
    with:
      timeout: 120
      runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
      docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-linter
      # NB: A shallow checkout won't work here because calculate-docker-image requires a full checkout
      # to run git rev-parse HEAD~:.ci/docker when a new image is needed
      fetch-depth: 0
      submodules: true
      ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      script: |
        CHANGED_FILES="${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files }}"
        echo "Running pyrefly"
        ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--take PYREFLY --all-files" .github/scripts/lintrunner.sh

  lintrunner-noclang:
    uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
    name: lintrunner-noclang-${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files == '*' && 'all' || 'partial' }}
    needs: [get-label-type, get-changed-files]
    with:
      timeout: 120
      runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
      docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-linter
      # NB: A shallow checkout won't work here because calculate-docker-image requires a full checkout
      # to run git rev-parse HEAD~:.ci/docker when a new image is needed
      fetch-depth: 0
      submodules: true
      ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      script: |
        CHANGED_FILES="${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files }}"
        echo "Running all other linters"
        if [ "$CHANGED_FILES" = '*' ]; then
          ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--skip CLANGTIDY,CLANGTIDY_EXECUTORCH_COMPATIBILITY,CLANGFORMAT,PYREFLY --all-files" .github/scripts/lintrunner.sh
        else
          ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--skip CLANGTIDY,CLANGTIDY_EXECUTORCH_COMPATIBILITY,CLANGFORMAT,PYREFLY ${CHANGED_FILES}" .github/scripts/lintrunner.sh
        fi

  quick-checks:
    uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
    needs: get-label-type
    with:
      timeout: 120
      runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
      docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-linter
      fetch-depth: 0
      ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      script: |
        # Ensure no non-breaking spaces
        # NB: We use 'printf' below rather than '\u000a' since bash pre-4.2
        # does not support the '\u000a' syntax (which is relevant for local linters)
        (! git --no-pager grep -In "$(printf '\xC2\xA0')" -- . || (echo "The above lines have non-breaking spaces (U+00A0); please convert them to spaces (U+0020)"; false))

        # Ensure cross-OS compatible file names
        (! git ls-files | grep -E '([<>:"|?*]|[ .]$)' || (echo "The above file names are not valid across all operating systems. Please ensure they don't contain the characters '<>\"|?*' and don't end with a white space or a '.' "; false))

        # Ensure no versionless Python shebangs
        (! git --no-pager grep -In '#!.*python$' -- . || (echo "The above lines have versionless Python shebangs; please specify either python2 or python3"; false))

        # Ensure ciflow tags mentioned in config
        python3 .github/scripts/collect_ciflow_labels.py --validate-tags

        # C++ docs check
        pushd docs/cpp/source
        ./check-doxygen.sh
        popd

        # CUDA kernel launch check
        set -eux
        python3 torch/testing/_internal/check_kernel_launches.py |& tee cuda_kernel_launch_checks.txt

  pr-sanity-checks:
    name: pr-sanity-checks
    needs: get-label-type
    runs-on: [self-hosted, "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.large"]
    # Only run this on pull requests. This check is simple enough to be done without a Docker image
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && !contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'skip-pr-sanity-checks')
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PyTorch
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
        with:
          submodules: false
          fetch-depth: -1

      - name: PR size check (nonretryable)
        env:
          BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          bash .github/scripts/pr-sanity-check.sh

  workflow-checks:
    uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
    needs: get-label-type
    with:
      timeout: 120
      runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
      docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-linter
      fetch-depth: -1
      submodules: true
      ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      script: |
        # Regenerate workflows
        .github/scripts/generate_ci_workflows.py

        RC=0
        # Assert that regenerating the workflows didn't change them
        if ! .github/scripts/report_git_status.sh .github/workflows; then
          echo
          echo 'As shown by the above diff, the committed .github/workflows'
          echo 'are not up to date according to .github/templates.'
          echo 'Please run this command, commit, and push again to your PR:'
          echo
          echo '    .github/scripts/generate_ci_workflows.py'
          echo
          echo 'If running that command does nothing, you may need to rebase'
          echo 'onto a more recent commit from the PyTorch main branch.'
          RC=1
        fi

        # Check that jobs will be cancelled
        .github/scripts/ensure_actions_will_cancel.py

        exit $RC

  toc:
    uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
    needs: get-label-type
    with:
      timeout: 120
      runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
      docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-linter
      fetch-depth: 0
      ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      script: |
        # Regenerate ToCs and check that they didn't change
        set -eu

        export PATH=~/.npm-global/bin:"$PATH"
        for FILE in $(git grep -Il '<!-- toc -->' -- '**.md'); do
          markdown-toc --bullets='-' -i "$FILE"
        done

        if ! .github/scripts/report_git_status.sh .; then
          echo
          echo 'As shown by the above diff, the table of contents in one or'
          echo 'more Markdown files is not up to date with the file contents.'
          echo 'You can either apply that Git diff directly to correct the'
          echo 'table of contents, or if you have npm installed, you can'
          echo 'install the npm package markdown-toc and run the following'
          # shellcheck disable=SC2016
          echo 'command (replacing $FILE with the filename for which you want'
          echo 'to regenerate the table of contents):'
          echo
          # shellcheck disable=SC2016
          echo "    markdown-toc --bullets='-' -i \"\$FILE\""
          false
        fi

  test-tools:
    name: Test tools
    if: ${{ github.repository == 'pytorch/pytorch' }}
    uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
    needs: get-label-type
    with:
      timeout: 120
      runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
      docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-linter
      fetch-depth: 0
      ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      script: |
        # Test tools
        PYTHONPATH=$(pwd) pytest tools/stats
        PYTHONPATH=$(pwd) pytest tools/test -o "python_files=test*.py"
        PYTHONPATH=$(pwd) pytest .github/scripts -o "python_files=test*.py"

  test_run_test:
    name: Test `run_test.py` is usable without boto3
    if: ${{ github.repository == 'pytorch/pytorch' }}
    runs-on: linux.24_04.4x
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PyTorch
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
        with:
          submodules: false
          fetch-depth: 1
      - name: Setup Python 3.10
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5.6.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.10'
          architecture: x64
          cache: pip
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pytest-rerunfailures==11.1.* pytest-flakefinder==1.1.* pytest-xdist==3.3.* expecttest==0.3.* fbscribelogger==0.1.* numpy==1.24.*
          pip install torch --pre --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cpu/
      - name: Run run_test.py (nonretryable)
        run: |
          # Run test_vulkan, which is a fast noop on Linux
          python3 test/run_test.py --include test_vulkan --verbose

  test_collect_env:
    if: ${{ github.repository == 'pytorch/pytorch' }}
    name: Test collect_env
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - test_type: with_torch
            runner: linux.24_04.4x
          - test_type: without_torch
            runner: linux.24_04.4x
          - test_type: older_python_version
            runner: linux.24_04.4x
    steps:
      # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
      # deep clone (fetch-depth 0) required, to allow us to use git log
      - name: Checkout PyTorch
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
        with:
          submodules: false
          fetch-depth: 1
      - name: Get min python version
        id: get-min-python-version
        if: matrix.test_type == 'older_python_version'
        run: |
          set -eou pipefail
          # Generate PyTorch version to use
          echo "MIN_PYTHON_VERSION=$(python3 .github/scripts/get_ci_variable.py --min-python-version)" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Setup Old Python version
        if: matrix.test_type == 'older_python_version'
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5.6.0
        with:
          python-version: 3.8
          architecture: x64
          check-latest: false
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: |
            **/requirements-build.txt
            **/requirements.txt
      - name: Setup Min Python version
        if: matrix.test_type != 'older_python_version'
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5.6.0
        with:
          python-version: ${{ steps.get-min-python-version.outputs.MIN_PYTHON_VERSION }}
          architecture: x64
          check-latest: false
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: |
            **/requirements-build.txt
            **/requirements.txt
      - name: Install torch
        if: matrix.test_type == 'with_torch'
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          # Doesn't really matter what torch version, we just need ANY torch installed
          pip install 'torch==2.*'
      - name: Run collect_env.py (nonretryable)
        run: |
          # All we need to see is that it passes
          python3 torch/utils/collect_env.py

  link-check:
    name: Link checks
    needs: get-label-type
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_link_check.yml
    with:
      runner: ${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}
      ref:    ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
    secrets: inherit

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

name: Lint
# Workflow that runs lint checks and also unittests for tools, and scripts.

on:
  pull_request:
    branches-ignore:
      - nightly
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - release/*
      - landchecks/*
    tags:
      - ciflow/pull/*
      - ciflow/trunk/*
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: read-all
# The names of steps that actually test the code should be suffixed with `(nonretryable)`.
# When any other step fails, it's job will be retried once by retryBot.
jobs:
  get-label-type:
    if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
    name: get-label-type
    uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/workflows/_runner-determinator.yml@main
    with:
      triggering_actor: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
      issue_owner: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login || github.event.issue.user.login }}
      curr_branch: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}

  get-changed-files:
    if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
    name: Get changed files
    uses: ./.github/workflows/_get-changed-files.yml
    with:
      all_files: ${{ contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'lint-all-files') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'Reverted') || github.event_name == 'push' }}

  lintrunner-clang:
    uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
    # Needed to prevent deduping on HUD
    name: lintrunner-clang-${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files == '*' && 'all' || 'partial' }}
    needs: [get-label-type, get-changed-files]
    # Only run if there are changed files relevant to clangtidy / clangformat
    if: |
      github.repository_owner == 'pytorch' && (
        needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files == '*' ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.h') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cpp') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cc') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cxx') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.hpp') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.hxx') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cu') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.cuh') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.mm') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.metal')
      )
    with:
      timeout: 120
      runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
      docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-cuda12.8-cudnn9-py3.10-linter
      # NB: A shallow checkout won't work here because calculate-docker-image requires a full checkout
      # to run git rev-parse HEAD~:.ci/docker when a new image is needed
      fetch-depth: 0
      submodules: true
      ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      script: |
        CHANGED_FILES="${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files }}"
        if [ "$CHANGED_FILES" = "*" ]; then
          export ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--take CLANGTIDY,CLANGFORMAT --all-files"
        else
          export ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--take CLANGTIDY,CLANGFORMAT $CHANGED_FILES"
        fi
        export CLANG=1
        .github/scripts/lintrunner.sh

  # NOTE: We should be able to disable this and consolidate with Pyrefly

    uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
    name: lintrunner-pyrefly-${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files == '*' && 'all' || 'partial' }}
    needs: [get-label-type, get-changed-files]
    # Only run if there are changed files relevant to pyrefly
    if: |
      github.repository_owner == 'pytorch' && (
        needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files == '*' ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.py') ||
        contains(needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files, '.pyi')

    with:
      timeout: 120
      runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
      docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-linter

      fetch-depth: 0
      submodules: true
      ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      script: |
        CHANGED_FILES="${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files }}"
        echo "Running pyrefly"
        ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--take PYREFLY --all-files" .github/scripts/lintrunner.sh

    uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
    name: lintrunner-noclang-${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files == '*' && 'all' || 'partial' }}
    needs: [get-label-type, get-changed-files]
    with:
      timeout: 120
      runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
      docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-linter
      # NB: A shallow checkout won't work here because calculate-docker-image requires a full checkout
      # to run git rev-parse HEAD~:.ci/docker when a new image is needed
      fetch-depth: 0
      submodules: true
      ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      script: |
        CHANGED_FILES="${{ needs.get-changed-files.outputs.changed-files }}"
        echo "Running all other linters"
        if [ "$CHANGED_FILES" = '*' ]; then
          ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--skip CLANGTIDY,CLANGTIDY_EXECUTORCH_COMPATIBILITY,CLANGFORMAT,PYREFLY --all-files" .github/scripts/lintrunner.sh
        else
          ADDITIONAL_LINTRUNNER_ARGS="--skip CLANGTIDY,CLANGTIDY_EXECUTORCH_COMPATIBILITY,CLANGFORMAT,PYREFLY ${CHANGED_FILES}" .github/scripts/lintrunner.sh
        fi

  quick-checks:
    uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
    needs: get-label-type

      timeout: 120

      docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-linter
      fetch-depth: 0
      ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      script: |
        # Ensure no non-breaking spaces
        # NB: We use 'printf' below rather than '\u000a' since bash pre-4.2
        # does not support the '\u000a' syntax (which is relevant for local linters)
        (! git --no-pager grep -In "$(printf '\xC2\xA0')" -- . || (echo "The above lines have non-breaking spaces (U+00A0); please convert them to spaces (U+0020)"; false))

        # Ensure cross-OS compatible file names
        (! git ls-files | grep -E '([<>:"|?*]|[ .]$)' || (echo "The above file names are not valid across all operating systems. Please ensure they don't contain the characters '<>\"|?*' and don't end with a white space or a '.' "; false))

        # Ensure no versionless Python shebangs
        (! git --no-pager grep -In '#!.*python$' -- . || (echo "The above lines have versionless Python shebangs; please specify either python2 or python3"; false))

        python3 .github/scripts/collect_ciflow_labels.py --validate-tags

        # C++ docs check
        pushd docs/cpp/source
        ./check-doxygen.sh
        popd

        set -eux
        python3 torch/testing/_internal/check_kernel_launches.py |& tee cuda_kernel_launch_checks.txt

  pr-sanity-checks:
    name: pr-sanity-checks

    runs-on: [self-hosted, "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.large"]

    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' && !contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'skip-pr-sanity-checks')
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PyTorch
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
        with:
          submodules: false
          fetch-depth: -1

      - name: PR size check (nonretryable)
        env:
          BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          bash .github/scripts/pr-sanity-check.sh

  workflow-checks:
    uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/workflows/linux_job_v2.yml@main
    needs: get-label-type
    with:
      timeout: 120
      runner: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.2xlarge"
      docker-image: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-linter
      fetch-depth: -1
      submodules: true
      ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      script: |
        # Regenerate workflows
        .github/scripts/generate_ci_workflows.py

        RC=0
        # Assert that regenerating the workflows didn't change them
        if ! .github/scripts/report_git_status.sh .github/workflows; then
          echo
          echo 'As shown by the above diff, the committed .github/workflows'
          echo 'are not up to date according to .github/templates.'
          echo 'Please run this command, commit, and push again to your PR:'
          echo
          echo '    .github/scripts/generate_ci_workflows.py'
          echo
          echo 'If running that command does nothing, you may need to rebase'
          echo 'onto a more recent commit from the PyTorch main branch.'
          RC=1
        fi

        # Check that jobs will be cancelled
        .github/scripts/ensure_actions_will_cancel.py

        exit $RC

  toc:

      ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

          markdown-toc --bullets='-' -i "$FILE"
        done

        if ! .github/scripts/report_git_status.sh .; then
          echo
          echo 'As shown by the above diff, the table of contents in one or'
          echo 'more Markdown files is not up to date with the file contents.'
          echo 'You can either apply that Git diff directly to correct the'

          echo 'install the npm package markdown-toc and run the following'
          # shellcheck disable=SC2016
          echo 'command (replacing $FILE with the filename for which you want'

          echo
          # shellcheck disable=SC2016
          echo "    markdown-toc --bullets='-' -i \"\$FILE\""

        fi

  quick-checks:

        # Ensure no non-breaking spaces
        # NB: We use 'printf' below rather than '\u000a' since bash pre-4.2
        # does not support the '\u000a' syntax (which is relevant for local linters)
        (! git --no-pager grep -In "$(printf '\xC2\xA0')" -- . || (echo "The above lines have non-breaking spaces (U+00A0); please convert them to spaces (U+0020)"; false))

        # Ensure cross-OS compatible file names
        (! git ls-files | grep -E '([<>:"|?*]|[ .]$)' || (echo "The above file names are not valid across all operating systems. Please ensure they don't contain the characters '<>\"|?*' and don't end with a white space or a '.' "; false))

    name: Test `run_test.py` is usable without boto3

    runs-on: linux.24_04.4x
    steps:
      - name: Checkout PyTorch
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
        with:
          submodules: false

      - name: Setup Python 3.10

        with:

          cache: pip

        run: |
          python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip

          pip install torch --pre --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cpu/
      - name: Run run_test.py (nonretryable)
        run: |

          python3 test/run_test.py --include test_vulkan --verbose

    if: ${{ github.repository == 'pytorch/pytorch' }}
    name: Test collect_env
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - test_type: with_torch
            runner: linux.24_04.4x
          - test_type: without_torch
            runner: linux.24_04.4x
          - test_type: older_python_version

      - name: Checkout PyTorch
        uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
        with:
          submodules: false
          fetch-depth: 1
      - name: Get min python version
        id: get-min-python-version
        if: matrix.test_type == 'older_python_version'
        run: |
          set -eou pipefail

          echo "MIN_PYTHON_VERSION=$(python3 .github/scripts/get_ci_variable.py --min-python-version)" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Setup Old Python version
        if: matrix.test_type == 'older_python_version'
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5.6.0
        with:
          python-version: 3.8
          architecture: x64
          check-latest: false
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: |
            **/requirements-build.txt
            **/requirements.txt
      - name: Setup Min Python version
        if: matrix.test_type != 'older_python_version'
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5.6.0
        with:
          python-version: ${{ steps.get-min-python-version.outputs.MIN_PYTHON_VERSION }}
          architecture: x64
          check-latest: false
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: |
            **/requirements-build.txt
            **/requirements.txt
      - name: Install torch
        if: matrix.test_type == 'with_torch'
        run: |
          pip install -r requirements.txt

          pip install 'torch==2.*'
      - name: Run collect_env.py (nonretryable)

    with:

{"content":"1: # The point of this workflow is to test that a FA3 wheel that was built based off the
2: # stable ABI as of torch nightly 20250830 can still run on the newer torch.
3: #
4: # This workflow is very similar to the _linux-test.yml workflow, with the following
5: # differences:
6: #   1. It is simpler (there is no test matrix)
7: #   2. It pulls flash-attention as a secondary repository in order to access the tests.
8: #      Note that it does not BUILD anything from flash-attention, as we have a prebuilt
9: #      wheel. We pull flash-attention only to run a few tests.
10: #   3. It runs only FA3 tests. No PyTorch tests are run.
11: name: linux-test-stable-fa3
12: 
13: on:
14:   workflow_call:
15:     inputs:
16:       build-environment:
17:         required: true
18:         type: string
19:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
20:       docker-image:
21:         required: true
22:         type: string
23:         description: Docker image to run in.
24:       timeout-minutes:
25:         required: false
26:         type: number
27:         default: 30
28:         description: |
29:           Set the maximum (in minutes) how long the workflow should take to finish
30:       s3-bucket:
31:         description: S3 bucket to download artifact
32:         required: false
33:         type: string
34:         default: "gha-artifacts"
35:     secrets:
36:       HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN:
37:         required: false
38:         description: |
39:           HF Auth token to avoid rate limits when downloading models or datasets from hub
40:       VLLM_TEST_HUGGING_FACE_TOKEN:
41:         required: false
42:         description: |
43:           HF Auth token to test vllm
44:       SCRIBE_GRAPHQL_ACCESS_TOKEN:
45:         required: false
46:         description: |
47:           FB app token to write to scribe endpoint
48: 
49: env:
50:   GIT_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
51: 
52: jobs:
53:   test:
54:     # Don't run on forked repos
55:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
56:     runs-on: linux.aws.h100
57:     timeout-minutes: ${{ inputs.timeout-minutes || 30 }}
58:     permissions:
59:       id-token: write
60:       contents: read
61:     steps:
62:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
63:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
64:         with:
65:           no-sudo: true
66: 
67:       - name: Checkout flash-attention as a secondary repository
68:         uses: actions/checkout@v4
69:         with:
70:           repository: Dao-AILab/flash-attention
71:           path: flash-attention
72: 
73:       - name: Setup Linux
74:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-linux
75: 
76:       - name: Calculate docker image
77:         id: calculate-docker-image
78:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/calculate-docker-image@main
79:         with:
80:           docker-image-name: ${{ inputs.docker-image }}
81: 
82:       - name: Use following to pull public copy of the image
83:         id: print-ghcr-mirror
84:         env:
85:           ECR_DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
86:         shell: bash
87:         run: |
88:           tag=${ECR_DOCKER_IMAGE##*:}
89:           echo "docker pull ghcr.io/pytorch/ci-image:${tag/:/-}"
90: 
91:       - name: Pull docker image
92:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/pull-docker-image@main
93:         with:
94:           docker-image: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
95: 
96:       - name: Check if in a container runner
97:         shell: bash
98:         id: check_container_runner
99:         run: echo "IN_CONTAINER_RUNNER=$(if [ -f /.inarc ] || [ -f /.incontainer ]; then echo true ; else echo false; fi)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
100: 
101:       - name: Setup GPU_FLAG for docker run
102:         id: setup-gpu-flag
103:         run: echo "GPU_FLAG=--gpus all -e NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES=all" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
104: 
105:       - name: Setup SCCACHE_SERVER_PORT environment for docker run when on container
106:         id: setup-sscache-port-flag
107:         run: echo "SCCACHE_SERVER_PORT_DOCKER_FLAG=-e SCCACHE_SERVER_PORT=$((RUNNER_UID + 4226))" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
108:         if: ${{ steps.check_container_runner.outputs.IN_CONTAINER_RUNNER == 'true' }}
109: 
110:       - name: Get workflow job id
111:         id: get-job-id
112:         uses: ./.github/actions/get-workflow-job-id
113:         if: always()
114:         with:
115:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
116: 
117:       - name: Download build artifacts
118:         uses: ./.github/actions/download-build-artifacts
119:         with:
120:           name: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
121:           s3-bucket: ${{ inputs.s3-bucket }}
122: 
123:       - name: Parse ref
124:         id: parse-ref
125:         run: .github/scripts/parse_ref.py
126: 
127:       - name: Set Test step time
128:         id: test-timeout
129:         shell: bash
130:         env:
131:           JOB_TIMEOUT: ${{ inputs.timeout-minutes }}
132:         run: |
133:           echo "timeout=$((JOB_TIMEOUT-30))" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
134: 
135:       - name: Preserve github env variables for use in docker
136:         shell: bash
137:         run: |
138:           env | grep '^GITHUB' >> "/tmp/github_env_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
139:           env | grep '^CI' >> "/tmp/github_env_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
140: 
141:       - name: Test
142:         id: test
143:         timeout-minutes: ${{ fromJson(steps.test-timeout.outputs.timeout) }}
144:         env:
145:           BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
146:           PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
147:           GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
148:           GITHUB_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}
149:           GITHUB_JOB: ${{ github.job }}
150:           GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
151:           GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
152:           GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
153:           JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
154:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
155:           BRANCH: ${{ steps.parse-ref.outputs.branch }}
156:           SHA1: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
157:           BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.sha }}
158:           SHM_SIZE: '2g'
159:           DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ inputs.docker-image }}
160:           VLLM_TEST_HUGGING_FACE_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.VLLM_TEST_HUGGING_FACE_TOKEN }}
161:           HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN }}
162:           SCRIBE_GRAPHQL_ACCESS_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SCRIBE_GRAPHQL_ACCESS_TOKEN }}
163:           ARTIFACTS_FILE_SUFFIX: ${{ github.job }}-${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
164:         run: |
165:           set -x
166: 
167:           TEST_COMMAND=.ci/pytorch/test_fa3_abi_stable.sh
168: 
169:           # Leaving 1GB for the runner and other things
170:           TOTAL_AVAILABLE_MEMORY_IN_GB=$(awk '/MemTotal/ { printf "%.3f \n", $2/1024/1024 - 1 }' /proc/meminfo)
171:           # https://docs.docker.com/engine/containers/resource_constraints/#--memory-swap-details, the 3GB swap
172:           # comes from https://github.com/pytorch/test-infra/pull/6058
173:           TOTAL_MEMORY_WITH_SWAP=$(("${TOTAL_AVAILABLE_MEMORY_IN_GB%.*}" + 3))
174: 
175: 
176:           SHM_OPTS="--shm-size=${SHM_SIZE}"
177:           JENKINS_USER="--user jenkins"
178:           DOCKER_SHELL_CMD=
179: 
180:           # detached container should get cleaned up by teardown_ec2_linux
181:           # TODO: Stop building test binaries as part of the build phase
182:           # Used for GPU_FLAG, SHM_OPTS, JENKINS_USER and DOCKER_SHELL_CMD since that doesn't play nice
183:           # shellcheck disable=SC2086,SC2090
184:           container_name=$(docker run \
185:             ${GPU_FLAG:-} \
186:             ${SCCACHE_SERVER_PORT_DOCKER_FLAG:-} \
187:             -e BUILD_ENVIRONMENT \
188:             -e PR_NUMBER \
189:             -e GITHUB_ACTIONS \
190:             -e GITHUB_REPOSITORY \
191:             -e GITHUB_WORKFLOW \
192:             -e GITHUB_JOB \
193:             -e GITHUB_RUN_ID \
194:             -e GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER \
195:             -e GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT \
196:             -e JOB_ID \
197:             -e JOB_NAME \
198:             -e BASE_SHA \

49:     runs-on: ubuntu-latest

51:       label-type: ${{ steps.set-condition.outputs.label-type }}
52:     env:
53:       GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
54:       ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
55:       TRIGGERING_ACTOR: ${{ inputs.triggering_actor }}
56:       ISSUE_OWNER: ${{ inputs.issue_owner }}
57:       CHECK_EXPERIMENTS: ${{ inputs.check_experiments }}
58:       OPT_OUT_EXPERIMENTS: ${{ inputs.opt_out_experiments }}
59:       PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
60:     steps:
61:       # - name: Checkout PyTorch
62:       #   uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
63:       #   with:
64:       #     fetch-depth: 1

67:       # TODO: Remove the hardcoded step below

69:       # This file below should match the script found in .github/scripts/runner_determinator.py
70:       - name: Hardcode runner-determinator script
71:         id: hardcode-script
72:         run: |
73:           cat <<EOF > runner_determinator.py
74:           # flake8: noqa: G004
75: 
76:           # Note: Copies of this script in runner_determinator.py and _runner-determinator.yml
77:           #       must be kept in sync. You can do it easily by running the following command:
78:           #           python .github/scripts/update_runner_determinator.py
79: 
80:           """
81:           This runner determinator is used to determine which set of runners to run a
82:           GitHub job on. It uses the first comment of a GitHub issue (by default
83:           https://github.com/pytorch/test-infra/issues/5132) to define the configuration
84:           of which runners should be used to run which job.
85: 
86:           The configuration has two parts, the settings and a list of opted-in users,
87:           separated by a line containing "---".  If the line is not present, the
88:           settings are considered to be empty with only the second part, the user
89:           list, defined.
90: 
91:           The first part is a YAML block that defines the rollout settings. This can be
92:           used to define any settings that are needed to determine which runners to use.
93:           It's fields are defined by the RolloutSettings class below.
94: 
95:           The second part is a list of users who are explicitly opted in to the LF fleet.
96:           The user list is also a comma separated list of additional features or
97:           experiments which the user could be opted in to.
98: 
99:           The user list has the following rules:
100: 
101:           - Users are GitHub usernames, which must start with the @ prefix
102:           - Each user is also a comma-separated list of features/experiments to enable
103:           - A "#" prefix opts the user out of all experiments
104: 
105:           Example config:
106:               # A list of experiments that can be opted into.
107:               # This defines the behavior they'll induce when opted into.
108:               # Expected syntax is:
109:               #   [experiment_name]: # Name of the experiment. Also used for the label prefix.
110:               #      rollout_perc: [int] # % of workflows to run with this experiment when users are not opted in.
111: 
112:               experiments:
113:                 lf:
114:                   rollout_percent: 25
115:                   all_branches: false
116:                   default: true
117:               ---
118: 
119:               # Opt-ins:
120:               # Users can opt into the LF fleet by adding their GitHub username to this list
121:               # and specifying experiments to enable in a comma-separated list.
122:               # To always opt out of an experiment, prefix it with a "-".
123:               # Experiments should be from the above list.
124: 
125:               @User1,-lf,split_build
126:               @User2,lf
127:               @User3,split_build
128:           """
129: 
130:           import json
131:           import logging
132:           import os
133:           import random
134:           import re
135:           import sys
136:           from argparse import ArgumentParser
137:           from collections.abc import Iterable
138:           from functools import cache
139:           from logging import LogRecord
140:           from typing import Any, NamedTuple
141:           from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
142: 
143:           import yaml
144:           from github import Auth, Github
145:           from github.Issue import Issue
146: 
147: 
148:           DEFAULT_LABEL_PREFIX = ""  # use meta runners
149:           WORKFLOW_LABEL_LF = "lf."  # use runners from the linux foundation
150:           WORKFLOW_LABEL_LF_CANARY = "lf.c."  # use canary runners from the linux foundation
151: 
152:           GITHUB_OUTPUT = os.getenv("GITHUB_OUTPUT", "")
153:           GH_OUTPUT_KEY_AMI = "runner-ami"
154:           GH_OUTPUT_KEY_LABEL_TYPE = "label-type"
155:           OPT_OUT_LABEL = "no-runner-experiments"
156: 
157:           SETTING_EXPERIMENTS = "experiments"
158: 
159:           LF_FLEET_EXPERIMENT = "lf"
160:           CANARY_FLEET_SUFFIX = ".c"
161: 
162: 
163:           class Experiment(NamedTuple):
164:               rollout_perc: float = (
165:                   0  # Percentage of workflows to experiment on when user is not opted-in.
166:               )
167:               all_branches: bool = (
168:                   False  # If True, the experiment is also enabled on the exception branches
169:               )
170:               default: bool = (
171:                   True  # If True, the experiment is enabled by default for all queries
172:               )
173: 
174:               # Add more fields as needed
175: 
176: 
177:           class Settings(NamedTuple):
178:               """
179:               Settings for the experiments that can be opted into.
180:               """
181: 
182:               experiments: dict[str, Experiment] = {}
183: 
184: 
185:           class ColorFormatter(logging.Formatter):
186:               """Color codes the log messages based on the log level"""
187: 
188:               COLORS = {
189:                   "WARNING": "\033[33m",  # Yellow
190:                   "ERROR": "\033[31m",  # Red
191:                   "CRITICAL": "\033[31m",  # Red
192:                   "INFO": "\033[0m",  # Reset
193:                   "DEBUG": "\033[0m",  # Reset
194:               }
195: 
196:               def format(self, record: LogRecord) -> str:
197:                   log_color = self.COLORS.get(record.levelname, "\033[0m")  # Default to reset
198:                   record.msg = f"{log_color}{record.msg}\033[0m"
199:                   return super().format(record)
200: 
201: 
202:           handler = logging.StreamHandler()
203:           handler.setFormatter(ColorFormatter(fmt="%(levelname)-8s: %(message)s"))
204: 
205:           log = logging.getLogger(os.path.basename(__file__))
206:           log.addHandler(handler)
207:           log.setLevel(logging.INFO)
208: 
209: 
210:           def set_github_output(key: str, value: str) -> None:
211:               """
212:               Defines outputs of the github action that invokes this script
213:               """
214:               if not GITHUB_OUTPUT:
215:                   # See https://github.blog/changelog/2022-10-11-github-actions-deprecating-save-state-and-set-output-commands/ for deprecation notice
216:                   log.warning(
217:                       "No env var found for GITHUB_OUTPUT, you must be running this code locally. Falling back to the deprecated print method."
218:                   )
219:                   print(f"::set-output name={key}::{value}")
220:                   return
221: 
222:               with open(GITHUB_OUTPUT, "a") as f:
223:                   log.info(f"Setting output: {key}='{value}'")
224:                   f.write(f"{key}={value}\n")

226: 
227:           def _str_comma_separated_to_set(value: str) -> frozenset[str]:
228:               return frozenset(
229:                   filter(lambda itm: itm != "", map(str.strip, value.strip(" \n\t").split(",")))
230:               )
231: 
232: 
233:           def parse_args() -> Any:
234:               parser = ArgumentParser("Get dynamic rollout settings")
235:               parser.add_argument("--github-token", type=str, required=True, help="GitHub token")
236:               parser.add_argument(
237:                   "--github-issue-repo",
238:                   type=str,

240:                   default="pytorch/test-infra",
241:                   help="GitHub repo to get the issue",

245:                   type=str,
246:                   required=True,
247:                   help="GitHub repo where CI is running",
248:               )

251:               )
252:               parser.add_argument(
253:                   "--github-actor", type=str, required=True, help="GitHub triggering_actor"
254:               )
255:               parser.add_argument(
256:                   "--github-issue-owner", type=str, required=True, help="GitHub issue owner"
257:               )
258:               parser.add_argument(
259:                   "--github-branch", type=str, required=True, help="Current GitHub branch or tag"
260:               )
261:               parser.add_argument(
262:                   "--github-ref-type",
263:                   type=str,
264:                   required=True,
265:                   help="Current GitHub ref type, branch or tag",
266:               )
267:               parser.add_argument(
268:                   "--eligible-experiments",
269:                   type=_str_comma_separated_to_set,
270:                   required=False,
271:                   default="",
272:                   help="comma separated list of experiments to check, if omitted all experiments marked with default=True are checked",
273:               )
274:               parser.add_argument(
275:                   "--opt-out-experiments",
276:                   type=_str_comma_separated_to_set,
277:                   required=False,
278:                   default="",
279:                   help=(
280:                       "comma separated list of experiments to opt-out of. If unset, no opt-outs will occur. "
281:                       "If the same experiment is listed both here and in '--eligible-experiments' opt-out will take priority."
282:                   ),
283:               )
284:               parser.add_argument(
285:                   "--pr-number",
286:                   type=str,
287:                   required=False,
288:                   default="",
289:                   help="the optional PR number where this is run",
290:               )
291: 
292:               return parser.parse_args()
293: 
294: 
295:           def get_gh_client(github_token: str) -> Github:  # type: ignore[no-any-unimported]
296:               auth = Auth.Token(github_token)
297:               return Github(auth=auth)
298: 
299: 
300:           def get_issue(gh: Github, repo: str, issue_num: int) -> Issue:  # type: ignore[no-any-unimported]
301:               repo = gh.get_repo(repo)
302:               return repo.get_issue(number=issue_num)
303: 
304: 
305:           def get_potential_pr_author(
306:               github_token: str, repo: str, username: str, ref_type: str, ref_name: str
307:           ) -> str:
308:               # If the trigger was a new tag added by a bot, this is a ciflow case
309:               # Fetch the actual username from the original PR. The PR number is
310:               # embedded in the tag name: ciflow/<name>/<pr-number>
311: 
312:               gh = get_gh_client(github_token)
313: 
314:               if username == "pytorch-bot[bot]" and ref_type == "tag":
315:                   split_tag = ref_name.split("/")
316:                   if (
317:                       len(split_tag) == 3
318:                       and split_tag[0] == "ciflow"
319:                       and split_tag[2].isnumeric()
320:                   ):
321:                       pr_number = split_tag[2]
322:                       try:
323:                           repository = gh.get_repo(repo)
324:                           pull = repository.get_pull(number=int(pr_number))
325:                       except Exception as e:
326:                           raise Exception(  # noqa: TRY002
327:                               f"issue with pull request {pr_number} from repo {repository}"
328:                           ) from e
329:                       return pull.user.login  # type: ignore[no-any-return]
330:               # In all other cases, return the original input username
331:               return username
332: 
333: 
334:           def is_exception_branch(branch: str) -> bool:
335:               """
336:               Branches that get opted out of experiments by default, until they're explicitly enabled.
337:               """
338:               return branch.split("/")[0] in {"main", "nightly", "release", "landchecks"}
339: 
340: 
341:           def load_yaml(yaml_text: str) -> Any:
342:               try:
343:                   data = yaml.safe_load(yaml_text)
344:                   return data
345:               except yaml.YAMLError:
346:                   log.exception("Error loading YAML")
347:                   raise
348: 
349: 
350:           def extract_settings_user_opt_in_from_text(rollout_state: str) -> tuple[str, str]:
351:               """
352:               Extracts the text with settings, if any, and the opted in users from the rollout state.
353: 
354:               If the issue body contains "---" then the text above that is the settings
355:               and the text below is the list of opted in users.
356: 
357:               If it doesn't contain "---" then the settings are empty and the rest is the users.
358:               """
359:               rollout_state_parts = rollout_state.split("---")
360:               if len(rollout_state_parts) >= 2:
361:                   return rollout_state_parts[0], rollout_state_parts[1]
362:               else:
363:                   return "", rollout_state
364: 
365: 
366:           class UserOptins(dict[str, list[str]]):
367:               """
368:               Dictionary of users with a list of features they have opted into
369:               """
370: 
371: 
372:           def parse_user_opt_in_from_text(user_optin_text: str) -> UserOptins:
373:               """
374:               Parse the user opt-in text into a key value pair of username and the list of features they have opted into
375: 
376:               Users are GitHub usernames with the @ prefix. Each user is also a comma-separated list of features/experiments to enable.
377:                   - Example line: "@User1,lf,split_build"
378:                   - A "#" prefix indicates the user is opted out of all experiments
379: 
380: 
381:               """
382:               optins = UserOptins()
383:               for user in user_optin_text.split("\n"):
384:                   user = user.strip("\r\n\t -")
385:                   if not user or not user.startswith("@"):
386:                       # Not a valid user. Skip
387:                       continue
388: 
389:                   if user:
390:                       usr_name = user.split(",")[0].strip("@")
391:                       optins[usr_name] = [exp.strip(" ") for exp in user.split(",")[1:]]
392: 
393:               return optins
394:

397:               """
398:               Check if the experiment name is valid.
399:               A valid name:

144:       - name: Build
145:         if: steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' || inputs.test-matrix == ''
146:         id: build
147:         shell: bash
148:         env:
149:           PYTORCH_FINAL_PACKAGE_DIR: /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results/
150:           BRANCH: ${{ steps.parse-ref.outputs.branch }}
151:           BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
152:           BUILD_WHEEL: 1
153:           MAX_JOBS: 8
154:           CUDA_VERSION: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
155:           PYTHON_VERSION: "3.10"
156:           SCCACHE_BUCKET: "ossci-compiler-cache"
157:           SCCACHE_S3_KEY_PREFIX: ${{ github.workflow }}
158:           SCCACHE_REGION: us-east-1
159:           VC_PRODUCT: "BuildTools"
160:           VC_VERSION: ""
161:           VC_YEAR: "${{ inputs.vc-year }}"
162:           ALPINE_IMAGE: "308535385114.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/tool/alpine"
163:           AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1
164:           PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
165:           SHA1: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
166:           DEBUG: ${{ inputs.build-with-debug && '1' || '0' }}
167:           TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "8.6"
168:           USE_CUDA: ${{ inputs.cuda-version != 'cpu' && '1' || '0' }}
169:           USE_XPU: ${{ inputs.use-xpu == true && '1' || '0' }}
170:           XPU_VERSION: "${{ inputs.xpu-version }}"
171:           OUR_GITHUB_JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
172:         run: |
173:           .ci/pytorch/win-build.sh
174: 
175:       # Collect Windows torch libs and CUDA libs for cross-compilation
176:       - name: Collect Windows CUDA libs for cross-compilation
177:         if: steps.build.outcome != 'skipped' && inputs.cuda-version != 'cpu'
178:         shell: bash
179:         run: |
180:           set -ex
181: 
182:           # Create directory structure if does not exist
183:           mkdir -p /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results
184: 
185:           # Copy CUDA libs
186:           CUDA_PATH="/c/Program Files/NVIDIA GPU Computing Toolkit/CUDA/v${{ inputs.cuda-version }}"
187: 
188:           if [ -f "${CUDA_PATH}/lib/x64/cuda.lib" ]; then
189:             cp "${CUDA_PATH}/lib/x64/cuda.lib" /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results/
190:           fi
191: 
192:           if [ -f "${CUDA_PATH}/lib/x64/cudart.lib" ]; then
193:             cp "${CUDA_PATH}/lib/x64/cudart.lib" /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results/
194:           fi
195: 
196:           # List collected files
197:           echo "Collected CUDA libs:"
198:           ls -lah /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results/*.lib
199: 
200:       # Upload to github so that people can click and download artifacts
201:       - name: Upload artifacts to s3
202:         if: steps.build.outcome != 'skipped'
203:         uses: seemethere/upload-artifact-s3@baba72d0712b404f646cebe0730933554ebce96a # v5.1.0
204:         with:
205:           retention-days: 14
206:           if-no-files-found: error
207:           name: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
208:           path: C:\${{ github.run_id }}\build-results
209: 
210:       - name: Upload sccache stats
211:         if: steps.build.outcome != 'skipped'
212:         uses: ./.github/actions/upload-sccache-stats
213:         with:
214:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

216:       - name: Teardown Windows
217:         uses: ./.github/actions/teardown-win
218:         if: always()
219:         timeout-minutes: 120
220:         with:
221:           extra-delete-dir: /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results/

{"content":"1: name: win-test
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_call:
5:     inputs:
6:       build-environment:
7:         required: true
8:         type: string
9:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
10:       cuda-version:
11:         required: true
12:         type: string
13:         description: What CUDA version to build with, "cpu" for none.
14:       test-matrix:
15:         required: true
16:         type: string
17:         description: JSON description of what test configs to run.
18:       sync-tag:
19:         required: false
20:         type: string
21:         default: ""
22:         description: |
23:           If this is set, our linter will use this to make sure that every other
24:           job with the same `sync-tag` is identical.
25:       timeout-minutes:
26:         required: false
27:         type: number
28:         default: 240
29:         description: |
30:           Set the maximum (in minutes) how long the workflow should take to finish
31:       disable-monitor:
32:         description: |
33:           [Experimental] Disable utilization monitoring for tests.
34:           Currently, by default we disable the monitor job and only look for specific tests,
35:           since we are investigating the behaviour of the monitor script with different tests.
36:         required: false
37:         type: boolean
38:         default: true
39:       monitor-log-interval:
40:         description: |
41:           Set the interval for the monitor script to log utilization.
42:         required: false
43:         type: number
44:         default: 5
45:       monitor-data-collect-interval:
46:         description: |
47:           Set the interval for the monitor script to collect data.
48:         required: false
49:         type: number
50:         default: 1
51: env:
52:   GIT_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
53: 
54: jobs:
55:   test:
56:     # Don't run on forked repos or empty test matrix
57:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch' && toJSON(fromJSON(inputs.test-matrix).include) != '[]'
58:     strategy:
59:       matrix: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.test-matrix) }}
60:       fail-fast: false
61:     runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
62:     timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check == 'mem_leak_check' && 600 || inputs.timeout-minutes }}
63:     defaults:
64:       run:
65:         shell: bash
66:     steps:
67:       # Duplicated in win-build because this MUST go before a checkout
68:       - name: Enable git long paths and symlinks on Windows and disable fsmonitor daemon
69:         shell: bash
70:         run: |
71:           git config --global core.longpaths true
72:           git config --global core.symlinks true
73:           git config --global core.ignorecase false
74: 
75:           # https://git-scm.com/docs/git-fsmonitor--daemon.  The daemon could lock
76:           # the directory on Windows and prevent GHA from checking out as reported
77:           # in https://github.com/actions/checkout/issues/1018
78:           git config --global core.fsmonitor false
79: 
80:       - name: Setup SSH (Click me for login details)
81:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-ssh@main
82:         with:
83:           github-secret: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
84:           instructions: |
85:             To forward remote desktop on your local machine ssh as follows:
86:               ssh -L 3389:localhost:3389 %%username%%@%%hostname%%
87:             And then change password using `passwd` command.
88: 
89:             To start tests locally, change working folder to \actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\test,
90:             Activate miniconda and Visual Studio environment and set PYTHON_PATH, by running:
91:               call C:\Jenkins\Miniconda3\Scripts\activate.bat C:\Jenkins\Miniconda3
92:               call "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x64
93:               set PYTHONPATH=C:\actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\build\win_tmp\build
94: 
95:       # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
96:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
97:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
98:         with:
99:           no-sudo: true
100: 
101:       - name: Setup Windows
102:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-win
103:         with:
104:           cuda-version: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
105: 
106:       - name: Get workflow job id
107:         id: get-job-id
108:         uses: ./.github/actions/get-workflow-job-id
109:         if: always()
110:         with:
111:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
112: 
113:       - name: Start monitoring script
114:         id: monitor-script
115:         env:
116:           JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
117:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
118:           WORKFLOW_NAME: ${{ github.workflow }}
119:           WORKFLOW_RUN_ID: ${{github.run_id}}
120:           MONITOR_LOG_INTERVAL: ${{ inputs.monitor-log-interval }}
121:           MONITOR_DATA_COLLECT_INTERVAL: ${{ inputs.monitor-data-collect-interval }}
122:         shell: bash
123:         if: ${{ !inputs.disable-monitor }}
124:         continue-on-error: true
125:         run: |
126:           # Windows conda doesn't have python3 binary, only python, but it's python3
127:           ${CONDA_RUN} python -m pip install psutil==5.9.8 dataclasses_json==0.6.7 nvidia-ml-py==11.525.84
128:           ${CONDA_RUN} python -m tools.stats.monitor --log-interval "$MONITOR_LOG_INTERVAL" --data-collect-interval "$MONITOR_DATA_COLLECT_INTERVAL" > usage_log.txt 2>&1 &
129:           echo "monitor-script-pid=${!}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
130: 
131:       - name: Download PyTorch Build Artifacts
132:         uses: seemethere/download-artifact-s3@1da556a7aa0a088e3153970611f6c432d58e80e6 # v4.2.0
133:         with:
134:           name: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
135:           path: C:\${{ github.run_id }}\build-results
136: 
137:       - name: Check build-results folder
138:         shell: powershell
139:         run: |
140:           tree /F C:\$Env:GITHUB_RUN_ID\build-results
141: 
142:       - name: Download TD artifacts
143:         continue-on-error: true
144:         uses: ./.github/actions/download-td-artifacts
145: 
146:       - name: Check for keep-going label and re-enabled test issues
147:         # This uses the filter-test-configs action because it conveniently
148:         # checks for labels and re-enabled test issues.  It does not actually do
149:         # any filtering.  All filtering is done in the build step.
150:         id: keep-going
151:         uses: ./.github/actions/filter-test-configs
152:         with:
153:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
154:           test-matrix: ${{ inputs.test-matrix }}
155:           job-name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
156: 
157:       - name: Set Test step time
158:         id: test-timeout
159:         shell: bash
160:         env:
161:           JOB_TIMEOUT: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check == 'mem_leak_check' && 600 || inputs.timeout-minutes }}
162:         run: |
163:           echo "timeout=$((JOB_TIMEOUT-30))" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
164: 
165:       - name: Test
166:         id: test
167:         shell: bash
168:         timeout-minutes: ${{ fromJson(steps.test-timeout.outputs.timeout) }}
169:         env:
170:           USE_CUDA: ${{ inputs.cuda-version != 'cpu' && '1' || '0' }}
171:           INSTALL_WINDOWS_SDK: 1
172:           PYTHON_VERSION: "3.10"
173:           CONTINUE_THROUGH_ERROR: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.keep-going }}
174:           VERBOSE_TEST_LOGS: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-verbose-test-logs }}
175:           TEST_SHOWLOCALS: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-test-showlocals }}
176:           NO_TEST_TIMEOUT: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-no-test-timeout }}
177:           NO_TD: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-no-td }}
178:           VC_PRODUCT: "BuildTools"
179:           VC_VERSION: ""
180:           VS_VERSION: "17.4.1"
181:           VC_YEAR: "2022"
182:           AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1
183:           PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
184:           GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
185:           GITHUB_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}
186:           GITHUB_JOB: ${{ github.job }}
187:           GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
188:           GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
189:           GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
190:           JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
191:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
192:           SHA1: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
193:           CUDA_VERSION: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
194:           PYTORCH_FINAL_PACKAGE_DIR: /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results/
195:           BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
196:           ALPINE_IMAGE: "308535385114.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/tool/alpine"
197:           SHARD_NUMBER: ${{ matrix.shard }}
198:           NUM_TEST_SHARDS: ${{ matrix.num_shards }}
199:           TEST_CONFIG: ${{ matrix.config }}
200:           REENABLED_ISSUES: ${{ github.event.pull_request.reenabled-issues }}
201:           TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "8.6"
202:           PYTORCH_TEST_CUDA_MEM_LEAK_CHECK: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check && '1' || '0' }}
203:           PYTORCH_TEST_RERUN_DISABLED_TESTS: ${{ matrix.rerun_disabled_tests && '1' || '0' }}
204:         run: |
205:           pushd "${PYTORCH_FINAL_PACKAGE_DIR}"
206:           # shellcheck disable=SC2046,SC2102
207:           python3 -mpip install $(echo *.whl)[opt-einsum,optree] optree==0.13.0
208:           popd
209: 
210:           .ci/pytorch/win-test.sh
211: 
212:       - name: Upload pytest cache if tests failed
213:         uses: ./.github/actions/pytest-cache-upload
214:         continue-on-error: true
215:         if: failure() && steps.test.conclusion && steps.test.conclusion == 'failure'
216:         with:
217:           cache_dir: .pytest_cache
218:           shard: ${{ matrix.shard }}
219:           sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
220:           test_config: ${{ matrix.config }}
221:           job_identifier: ${{ github.workflow }}_${{ inputs.build-environment }}
222: 
223:       - name: Print remaining test logs
224:         shell: bash
225:         if: always() && steps.test.conclusion
226:         run: |
227:           cat test/**/*_toprint.log || true
228: 
229:       - name: Stop monitoring script
230:         if: ${{ always() && steps.monitor-script.outputs.monitor-script-pid }}
231:         shell: bash
232:         continue-on-error: true
233:         env:
234:           MONITOR_SCRIPT_PID: ${{ steps.monitor-script.outputs.monitor-script-pid }}
235:         run: |
236:           kill "$MONITOR_SCRIPT_PID"
237: 
238:       - name: Upload test artifacts
239:         uses: ./.github/actions/upload-test-artifacts
240:         if: always() && steps.test.conclusion && steps.test.conclusion != 'skipped'
241:         with:
242:           file-suffix: ${{ github.job }}-${{ matrix.config }}-${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ matrix.num_shards }}-${{ matrix.runner }}_${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
243: 
244:       - name: Upload utilization stats
245:         if: ${{ always() && steps.test.conclusion && steps.test.conclusion != 'skipped' && !inputs.disable-monitor }}
246:         continue-on-error: true
247:         uses: ./.github/actions/upload-utilization-stats
248:         with:
249:           job_id: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
250:           job_name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
251:           workflow_name: ${{ github.workflow }}
252:           workflow_run_id: ${{github.run_id}}
253:           workflow_attempt: ${{github.run_attempt}}
254: 
255:       - name: Parse ref
256:         id: parse-ref
257:         shell: bash
258:         run: python3 .github/scripts/parse_ref.py
259: 
260:       - name: Teardown Windows
261:         uses: ./.github/actions/teardown-win
262:         if: always()
263:         timeout-minutes: 120

{"content":"1: name: Build manywheel docker images
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_dispatch:
5:   push:
6:     branches:
7:       - main
8:       - release/*
9:     tags:
10:       # NOTE: Binary build pipelines should only get triggered on release candidate or nightly builds
11:       # Release candidate tags look like: v1.11.0-rc1
12:       - v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+-rc[0-9]+
13:     paths:
14:       - .ci/docker/**
15:       - .github/workflows/build-manywheel-images.yml
16:       - .github/actions/binary-docker-build/**
17:   pull_request:
18:     paths:
19:       - .ci/docker/**
20:       - .github/workflows/build-manywheel-images.yml
21:       - .github/actions/binary-docker-build/**
22: 
23: env:
24:   DOCKER_REGISTRY: "docker.io"
25:   DOCKER_BUILDKIT: 1
26:   WITH_PUSH: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/release') || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) }}
27: concurrency:
28:   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
29:   cancel-in-progress: true
30: 
31: jobs:
32:   get-label-type:
33:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
34:     name: get-label-type

36:     with:
37:       triggering_actor: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
38:       issue_owner: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login || github.event.issue.user.login }}
39:       curr_branch: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
40:       curr_ref_type: ${{ github.ref_type }}
41: 
42:   build:
43:     environment: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/release') || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) && 'docker-build') || '' }}
44:     needs: get-label-type
45:     strategy:
46:       fail-fast: false
47:       matrix:
48:         include: [
49:           { name: "manylinux2_28-builder",          tag: "cuda13.0",          runner: "linux.9xlarge.ephemeral" },
50:           { name: "manylinux2_28-builder",          tag: "cuda12.8",          runner: "linux.9xlarge.ephemeral" },
51:           { name: "manylinux2_28-builder",          tag: "cuda12.9",          runner: "linux.9xlarge.ephemeral" },
52:           { name: "manylinux2_28-builder",          tag: "cuda12.6",          runner: "linux.9xlarge.ephemeral" },
53:           { name: "manylinuxaarch64-builder",       tag: "cuda13.0",          runner: "linux.arm64.2xlarge.ephemeral" },
54:           { name: "manylinuxaarch64-builder",       tag: "cuda12.9",          runner: "linux.arm64.2xlarge.ephemeral" },
55:           { name: "manylinuxaarch64-builder",       tag: "cuda12.8",          runner: "linux.arm64.2xlarge.ephemeral" },
56:           { name: "manylinuxaarch64-builder",       tag: "cuda12.6",          runner: "linux.arm64.2xlarge.ephemeral" },
57:           { name: "manylinux2_28-builder",          tag: "rocm7.0",           runner: "linux.9xlarge.ephemeral" },
58:           { name: "manylinux2_28-builder",          tag: "rocm7.1",           runner: "linux.9xlarge.ephemeral" },
59:           { name: "manylinux2_28-builder",          tag: "cpu",               runner: "linux.9xlarge.ephemeral" },
60:           { name: "manylinux2_28_aarch64-builder",  tag: "cpu-aarch64",       runner: "linux.arm64.2xlarge.ephemeral" },

72:           DOCKER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_TOKEN }}
73:           DOCKER_ID: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_ID }}

{"content":"1: name: Build Triton wheels
2: 
3: on:
4:   push:
5:     branches:
6:       - main
7:     tags:
8:       # NOTE: Binary build pipelines should only get triggered on release candidate builds
9:       # Release candidate tags look like: v1.11.0-rc1
10:       - v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+-rc[0-9]+
11:       - 'ciflow/triton_binaries/*'
12:     paths:
13:       - .github/workflows/build-triton-wheel.yml
14:       - .github/scripts/build_triton_wheel.py
15:       - .github/ci_commit_pins/triton.txt
16:       - .github/scripts/windows/install_vs2022.ps1
17:       - .github/scripts/windows/build_triton.bat
18:       - .ci/docker/ci_commit_pins/triton.txt
19:       - .ci/docker/ci_commit_pins/triton-xpu.txt
20:   workflow_dispatch:
21:   pull_request:
22:     paths:
23:       - .github/workflows/build-triton-wheel.yml
24:       - .github/scripts/build_triton_wheel.py
25:       - .github/ci_commit_pins/triton.txt
26:       - .github/scripts/windows/install_vs2022.ps1
27:       - .github/scripts/windows/build_triton.bat
28:       - .ci/docker/ci_commit_pins/triton.txt
29:       - .ci/docker/ci_commit_pins/triton-xpu.txt
30: 
31: concurrency:
32:   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
33:   cancel-in-progress: true
34: 
35: jobs:
36:   get-label-type:
37:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
38:     name: get-label-type
39:     uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/workflows/_runner-determinator.yml@main
40:     with:
41:       triggering_actor: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
42:       issue_owner: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login || github.event.issue.user.login }}
43:       curr_branch: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
44:       curr_ref_type: ${{ github.ref_type }}
45: 
46:   build-wheel:
47:     name: "Build Triton Wheel"
48:     needs: get-label-type
49:     runs-on: ${{ matrix.runs_on }}
50:     strategy:
51:       fail-fast: false
52:       matrix:
53:         py_vers: [ "3.10", "3.11", "3.12", "3.13", "3.13t", "3.14", "3.14t" ]
54:         device: ["cuda", "rocm", "xpu", "aarch64"]
55:         docker-image: ["pytorch/manylinux2_28-builder:cpu"]
56:         include:
57:           - device: "rocm"
58:             rocm_version: "7.1"
59:             runs_on: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.4xlarge"
60:           - device: "cuda"
61:             rocm_version: ""
62:             runs_on: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.4xlarge"
63:           - device: "xpu"
64:             rocm_version: ""

100:             To start build locally, change working folder to \actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch,
101:             Activate miniconda and Visual Studio environment, by running:
102:               call C:\Jenkins\Miniconda3\Scripts\activate.bat C:\Jenkins\Miniconda3
103:               call "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x64
104: 
105:       # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
106:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
107:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
108:         with:
109:           no-sudo: true
110: 
111:       - name: Setup Windows

114:           cuda-version: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
115: 
116:       - name: Parse ref
117:         id: parse-ref

120: 
121:       - name: Get workflow job id
122:         id: get-job-id
123:         uses: ./.github/actions/get-workflow-job-id
124:         if: always()
125:         with:
126:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
127: 
128:       # Apply the filter logic to the build step too if the test-config label is already there
129:       - name: Select all requested test configurations (if the test matrix is available)
130:         id: filter
131:         uses: ./.github/actions/filter-test-configs
132:         with:
133:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
134:           test-matrix: ${{ inputs.test-matrix }}
135:           job-name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
136: 
137:       - name: Download pytest cache
138:         uses: ./.github/actions/pytest-cache-download
139:         continue-on-error: true
140:         with:
141:           cache_dir: .pytest_cache
142:           job_identifier: ${{ github.workflow }}_${{ inputs.build-environment }}
143: 
144:       - name: Build
145:         if: steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' || inputs.test-matrix == ''
146:         id: build
147:         shell: bash
148:         env:
149:           PYTORCH_FINAL_PACKAGE_DIR: /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results/
150:           BRANCH: ${{ steps.parse-ref.outputs.branch }}
151:           BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
152:           BUILD_WHEEL: 1
153:           MAX_JOBS: 8
154:           CUDA_VERSION: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
155:           PYTHON_VERSION: "3.10"
156:           SCCACHE_BUCKET: "ossci-compiler-cache"
157:           SCCACHE_S3_KEY_PREFIX: ${{ github.workflow }}
158:           SCCACHE_REGION: us-east-1
159:           VC_PRODUCT: "BuildTools"
160:           VC_VERSION: ""
161:           VC_YEAR: "${{ inputs.vc-year }}"
162:           ALPINE_IMAGE: "308535385114.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/tool/alpine"
163:           AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1
164:           PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
165:           SHA1: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
166:           DEBUG: ${{ inputs.build-with-debug && '1' || '0' }}
167:           TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "8.6"
168:           USE_CUDA: ${{ inputs.cuda-version != 'cpu' && '1' || '0' }}
169:           USE_XPU: ${{ inputs.use-xpu == true && '1' || '0' }}
170:           XPU_VERSION: "${{ inputs.xpu-version }}"
171:           OUR_GITHUB_JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
172:         run: |
173:           .ci/pytorch/win-build.sh
174: 
175:       # Collect Windows torch libs and CUDA libs for cross-compilation
176:       - name: Collect Windows CUDA libs for cross-compilation
177:         if: steps.build.outcome != 'skipped' && inputs.cuda-version != 'cpu'

192:           if [ -f "${CUDA_PATH}/lib/x64/cudart.lib" ]; then
193:             cp "${CUDA_PATH}/lib/x64/cudart.lib" /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results/
194:           fi
195: 
196:           # List collected files
197:           echo "Collected CUDA libs:"
198:           ls -lah /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results/*.lib
199: 
200:       # Upload to github so that people can click and download artifacts
201:       - name: Upload artifacts to s3
202:         if: steps.build.outcome != 'skipped'
203:         uses: seemethere/upload-artifact-s3@baba72d0712b404f646cebe0730933554ebce96a # v5.1.0

205:           retention-days: 14
206:           if-no-files-found: error
207:           name: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
208:           path: C:\${{ github.run_id }}\build-results

218:         if: always()
219:         timeout-minutes: 120
220:         with:
221:           extra-delete-dir: /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results/
