{"content":"1: name: win-test
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_call:
5:     inputs:
6:       build-environment:
7:         required: true
8:         type: string
9:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
10:       cuda-version:
11:         required: true
12:         type: string
13:         description: What CUDA version to build with, "cpu" for none.
14:       test-matrix:
15:         required: true
16:         type: string
17:         description: JSON description of what test configs to run.
18:       sync-tag:
19:         required: false
20:         type: string
21:         default: ""
22:         description: |
23:           If this is set, our linter will use this to make sure that every other
24:           job with the same `sync-tag` is identical.
25:       timeout-minutes:
26:         required: false
27:         type: number
28:         default: 240
29:         description: |
30:           Set the maximum (in minutes) how long the workflow should take to finish
31:       disable-monitor:
32:         description: |
33:           [Experimental] Disable utilization monitoring for tests.
34:           Currently, by default we disable the monitor job and only look for specific tests,
35:           since we are investigating the behaviour of the monitor script with different tests.
36:         required: false
37:         type: boolean
38:         default: true
39:       monitor-log-interval:
40:         description: |
41:           Set the interval for the monitor script to log utilization.
42:         required: false
43:         type: number
44:         default: 5
45:       monitor-data-collect-interval:
46:         description: |
47:           Set the interval for the monitor script to collect data.
48:         required: false
49:         type: number
50:         default: 1
51: env:
52:   GIT_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
53: 
54: jobs:
55:   test:
56:     # Don't run on forked repos or empty test matrix
57:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch' && toJSON(fromJSON(inputs.test-matrix).include) != '[]'
58:     strategy:
59:       matrix: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.test-matrix) }}
60:       fail-fast: false
61:     runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
62:     timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check == 'mem_leak_check' && 600 || inputs.timeout-minutes }}
63:     defaults:
64:       run:
65:         shell: bash
66:     steps:
67:       # Duplicated in win-build because this MUST go before a checkout
68:       - name: Enable git long paths and symlinks on Windows and disable fsmonitor daemon
69:         shell: bash
70:         run: |
71:           git config --global core.longpaths true
72:           git config --global core.symlinks true
73:           git config --global core.ignorecase false
74: 
75:           # https://git-scm.com/docs/git-fsmonitor--daemon.  The daemon could lock
76:           # the directory on Windows and prevent GHA from checking out as reported
77:           # in https://github.com/actions/checkout/issues/1018
78:           git config --global core.fsmonitor false
79: 
80:       - name: Setup SSH (Click me for login details)
81:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-ssh@main
82:         with:
83:           github-secret: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
84:           instructions: |
85:             To forward remote desktop on your local machine ssh as follows:
86:               ssh -L 3389:localhost:3389 %%username%%@%%hostname%%
87:             And then change password using `passwd` command.
88: 
89:             To start tests locally, change working folder to \actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\test,
90:             Activate miniconda and Visual Studio environment and set PYTHON_PATH, by running:
91:               call C:\Jenkins\Miniconda3\Scripts\activate.bat C:\Jenkins\Miniconda3
92:               call "C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\BuildTools\VC\Auxiliary\Build\vcvarsall.bat" x64
93:               set PYTHONPATH=C:\actions-runner\_work\pytorch\pytorch\build\win_tmp\build
94: 
95:       # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
96:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
97:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
98:         with:
99:           no-sudo: true
100: 
101:       - name: Setup Windows
102:         uses: ./.github/actions/setup-win
103:         with:
104:           cuda-version: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
105: 
106:       - name: Get workflow job id
107:         id: get-job-id
108:         uses: ./.github/actions/get-workflow-job-id
109:         if: always()
110:         with:
111:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
112: 
113:       - name: Start monitoring script
114:         id: monitor-script
115:         env:
116:           JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
117:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
118:           WORKFLOW_NAME: ${{ github.workflow }}
119:           WORKFLOW_RUN_ID: ${{github.run_id}}
120:           MONITOR_LOG_INTERVAL: ${{ inputs.monitor-log-interval }}
121:           MONITOR_DATA_COLLECT_INTERVAL: ${{ inputs.monitor-data-collect-interval }}
122:         shell: bash
123:         if: ${{ !inputs.disable-monitor }}
124:         continue-on-error: true
125:         run: |
126:           # Windows conda doesn't have python3 binary, only python, but it's python3
127:           ${CONDA_RUN} python -m pip install psutil==5.9.8 dataclasses_json==0.6.7 nvidia-ml-py==11.525.84
128:           ${CONDA_RUN} python -m tools.stats.monitor --log-interval "$MONITOR_LOG_INTERVAL" --data-collect-interval "$MONITOR_DATA_COLLECT_INTERVAL" > usage_log.txt 2>&1 &
129:           echo "monitor-script-pid=${!}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
130: 
131:       - name: Download PyTorch Build Artifacts
132:         uses: seemethere/download-artifact-s3@1da556a7aa0a088e3153970611f6c432d58e80e6 # v4.2.0
133:         with:
134:           name: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
135:           path: C:\${{ github.run_id }}\build-results
136: 
137:       - name: Check build-results folder
138:         shell: powershell
139:         run: |
140:           tree /F C:\$Env:GITHUB_RUN_ID\build-results
141: 
142:       - name: Download TD artifacts
143:         continue-on-error: true
144:         uses: ./.github/actions/download-td-artifacts
145: 
146:       - name: Check for keep-going label and re-enabled test issues
147:         # This uses the filter-test-configs action because it conveniently
148:         # checks for labels and re-enabled test issues.  It does not actually do
149:         # any filtering.  All filtering is done in the build step.
150:         id: keep-going
151:         uses: ./.github/actions/filter-test-configs
152:         with:
153:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
154:           test-matrix: ${{ inputs.test-matrix }}
155:           job-name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
156: 
157:       - name: Set Test step time
158:         id: test-timeout
159:         shell: bash
160:         env:
161:           JOB_TIMEOUT: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check == 'mem_leak_check' && 600 || inputs.timeout-minutes }}
162:         run: |
163:           echo "timeout=$((JOB_TIMEOUT-30))" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
164: 
165:       - name: Test
166:         id: test
167:         shell: bash
168:         timeout-minutes: ${{ fromJson(steps.test-timeout.outputs.timeout) }}
169:         env:
170:           USE_CUDA: ${{ inputs.cuda-version != 'cpu' && '1' || '0' }}
171:           INSTALL_WINDOWS_SDK: 1
172:           PYTHON_VERSION: "3.10"
173:           CONTINUE_THROUGH_ERROR: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.keep-going }}
174:           VERBOSE_TEST_LOGS: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-verbose-test-logs }}
175:           TEST_SHOWLOCALS: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-test-showlocals }}
176:           NO_TEST_TIMEOUT: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-no-test-timeout }}
177:           NO_TD: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-no-td }}
178:           VC_PRODUCT: "BuildTools"
179:           VC_VERSION: ""
180:           VS_VERSION: "17.4.1"
181:           VC_YEAR: "2022"
182:           AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1
183:           PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
184:           GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
185:           GITHUB_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}
186:           GITHUB_JOB: ${{ github.job }}
187:           GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
188:           GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
189:           GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
190:           JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
191:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
192:           SHA1: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
193:           CUDA_VERSION: ${{ inputs.cuda-version }}
194:           PYTORCH_FINAL_PACKAGE_DIR: /c/${{ github.run_id }}/build-results/
195:           BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
196:           ALPINE_IMAGE: "308535385114.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/tool/alpine"
197:           SHARD_NUMBER: ${{ matrix.shard }}
198:           NUM_TEST_SHARDS: ${{ matrix.num_shards }}
199:           TEST_CONFIG: ${{ matrix.config }}
200:           REENABLED_ISSUES: ${{ github.event.pull_request.reenabled-issues }}
201:           TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST: "8.6"
202:           PYTORCH_TEST_CUDA_MEM_LEAK_CHECK: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check && '1' || '0' }}
203:           PYTORCH_TEST_RERUN_DISABLED_TESTS: ${{ matrix.rerun_disabled_tests && '1' || '0' }}
204:         run: |
205:           pushd "${PYTORCH_FINAL_PACKAGE_DIR}"
206:           # shellcheck disable=SC2046,SC2102
207:           python3 -mpip install $(echo *.whl)[opt-einsum,optree] optree==0.13.0
208:           popd
209: 
210:           .ci/pytorch/win-test.sh
211: 
212:       - name: Upload pytest cache if tests failed
213:         uses: ./.github/actions/pytest-cache-upload
214:         continue-on-error: true
215:         if: failure() && steps.test.conclusion && steps.test.conclusion == 'failure'
216:         with:
217:           cache_dir: .pytest_cache
218:           shard: ${{ matrix.shard }}
219:           sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
220:           test_config: ${{ matrix.config }}
221:           job_identifier: ${{ github.workflow }}_${{ inputs.build-environment }}
222: 
223:       - name: Print remaining test logs
224:         shell: bash
225:         if: always() && steps.test.conclusion
226:         run: |
227:           cat test/**/*_toprint.log || true
228: 
229:       - name: Stop monitoring script
230:         if: ${{ always() && steps.monitor-script.outputs.monitor-script-pid }}
231:         shell: bash
232:         continue-on-error: true
233:         env:
234:           MONITOR_SCRIPT_PID: ${{ steps.monitor-script.outputs.monitor-script-pid }}
235:         run: |
236:           kill "$MONITOR_SCRIPT_PID"
237: 
238:       - name: Upload test artifacts
239:         uses: ./.github/actions/upload-test-artifacts
240:         if: always() && steps.test.conclusion && steps.test.conclusion != 'skipped'
241:         with:
242:           file-suffix: ${{ github.job }}-${{ matrix.config }}-${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ matrix.num_shards }}-${{ matrix.runner }}_${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
243: 
244:       - name: Upload utilization stats
245:         if: ${{ always() && steps.test.conclusion && steps.test.conclusion != 'skipped' && !inputs.disable-monitor }}
246:         continue-on-error: true
247:         uses: ./.github/actions/upload-utilization-stats
248:         with:
249:           job_id: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
250:           job_name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
251:           workflow_name: ${{ github.workflow }}
252:           workflow_run_id: ${{github.run_id}}
253:           workflow_attempt: ${{github.run_attempt}}
254: 
255:       - name: Parse ref
256:         id: parse-ref
257:         shell: bash
258:         run: python3 .github/scripts/parse_ref.py
259: 
260:       - name: Teardown Windows
261:         uses: ./.github/actions/teardown-win
262:         if: always()
263:         timeout-minutes: 120

{"content":"1: name: Build manywheel docker images
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_dispatch:
5:   push:
6:     branches:
7:       - main
8:       - release/*
9:     tags:
10:       # NOTE: Binary build pipelines should only get triggered on release candidate or nightly builds

13:     paths:

17:   pull_request:

19:       - .ci/docker/**
20:       - .github/workflows/build-manywheel-images.yml
21:       - .github/actions/binary-docker-build/**
22: 
23: env:
24:   DOCKER_REGISTRY: "docker.io"
25:   DOCKER_BUILDKIT: 1
26:   WITH_PUSH: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/release') || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) }}
27: concurrency:
28:   group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
29:   cancel-in-progress: true
30: 
31: jobs:

36:     with:

39:       curr_branch: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
40:       curr_ref_type: ${{ github.ref_type }}
41: 
42:   build:
43:     environment: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' && (github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/release') || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) && 'docker-build') || '' }}
44:     needs: get-label-type
45:     strategy:
46:       fail-fast: false
47:       matrix:
48:         include: [
49:           { name: "manylinux2_28-builder",          tag: "cuda13.0",          runner: "linux.9xlarge.ephemeral" },
50:           { name: "manylinux2_28-builder",          tag: "cuda12.8",          runner: "linux.9xlarge.ephemeral" },
51:           { name: "manylinux2_28-builder",          tag: "cuda12.9",          runner: "linux.9xlarge.ephemeral" },
52:           { name: "manylinux2_28-builder",          tag: "cuda12.6",          runner: "linux.9xlarge.ephemeral" },
53:           { name: "manylinuxaarch64-builder",       tag: "cuda13.0",          runner: "linux.arm64.2xlarge.ephemeral" },
54:           { name: "manylinuxaarch64-builder",       tag: "cuda12.9",          runner: "linux.arm64.2xlarge.ephemeral" },
55:           { name: "manylinuxaarch64-builder",       tag: "cuda12.8",          runner: "linux.arm64.2xlarge.ephemeral" },
56:           { name: "manylinuxaarch64-builder",       tag: "cuda12.6",          runner: "linux.arm64.2xlarge.ephemeral" },
57:           { name: "manylinux2_28-builder",          tag: "rocm7.0",           runner: "linux.9xlarge.ephemeral" },
58:           { name: "manylinux2_28-builder",          tag: "rocm7.1",           runner: "linux.9xlarge.ephemeral" },
59:           { name: "manylinux2_28-builder",          tag: "cpu",               runner: "linux.9xlarge.ephemeral" },
60:           { name: "manylinux2_28_aarch64-builder",  tag: "cpu-aarch64",       runner: "linux.arm64.2xlarge.ephemeral" },
61:           { name: "manylinux2_28-builder",          tag: "xpu",               runner: "linux.9xlarge.ephemeral" },

70:           custom-tag-prefix: ${{ matrix.tag }}
71:           docker-build-dir: manywheel
72:           DOCKER_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_TOKEN }}
73:           DOCKER_ID: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_ID }}

{"content":"1: name: mac-build
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_call:
5:     inputs:
6:       build-environment:
7:         required: true
8:         type: string
9:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
10:       runner-type:
11:         required: true
12:         type: string
13:         description: Name of the GitHub-managed runner type to use for the build.
14:       build-generates-artifacts:
15:         required: true
16:         type: boolean
17:         description: If set, upload generated build artifacts.
18:       xcode-version:
19:         required: false
20:         type: string
21:         default: ""
22:         description: What xcode version to build with.
23:       sync-tag:
24:         required: false
25:         type: string
26:         default: ""
27:         description: |
28:           If this is set, our linter will use this to make sure that every other
29:           job with the same `sync-tag` is identical.
30:       python-version:
31:         required: false
32:         type: string
33:         default: "3.12"
34:         description: |
35:           The python version to be used. Will be 3.9 by default
36:       test-matrix:
37:         required: false
38:         type: string
39:         description: |
40:           An option JSON description of what test configs to run later on. This
41:           is moved here from the Linux test workflow so that we can apply filter
42:           logic using test-config labels earlier and skip unnecessary builds
43:       sccache-use-gha:
44:         required: false
45:         type: boolean
46:         default: false
47:         description: If true, use the Github cache as the storage option for sccache instead of S3.
48: 
49:     outputs:
50:       test-matrix:
51:         value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.test-matrix }}
52:         description: An optional JSON description of what test configs to run later on.
53:       build-outcome:
54:         value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.build-outcome }}
55:         description: The outcome of the build step. This is used to influence test filtering logic later on.
56:       build-environment:
57:         value: ${{ jobs.build.outputs.build-environment }}
58:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
59: 
60: jobs:
61:   build:
62:     # Don't run on forked repos.
63:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
64:     runs-on: ${{ inputs.runner-type }}
65:     env:
66:       BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
67:       SCCACHE_USE_GHA: ${{ inputs.sccache-use-gha }}  # this is placed here instead of the sccache step to appease actionlint
68:     outputs:
69:       build-outcome: ${{ steps.build.outcome }}
70:       test-matrix: ${{ steps.filter.outputs.test-matrix }}
71:       build-environment: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
72:     steps:
73:       - name: Clean up disk space before running MacOS workflow
74:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/check-disk-space@main
75: 
76:       # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
77:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
78:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
79: 
80:       - name: Set xcode version
81:         env:
82:           XCODE_VERSION: ${{ inputs.xcode-version }}
83:         run: |
84:           if [ -n "${XCODE_VERSION}" ]; then
85:             echo "DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode_${XCODE_VERSION}.app/Contents/Developer" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
86:           fi
87: 
88:       - name: Setup Python
89:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-python@main
90:         with:
91:           python-version: ${{ inputs.python-version }}
92:           pip-requirements-file: .ci/docker/requirements-ci.txt
93: 
94:       - name: Install sccache (only for non-forked PRs, and pushes to trunk)
95:         uses: nick-fields/retry@7152eba30c6575329ac0576536151aca5a72780e # v3.0.0
96:         if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository }}
97:         with:
98:           timeout_minutes: 5
99:           max_attempts: 3
100:           retry_wait_seconds: 90
101:           command: |
102:             set -ex
103: 
104:             DOWNLOAD_SCCACHE=0
105:             SCCACHE_VERSION="0.4.1"
106:             LOCAL_PATH="/usr/local/bin"
107: 
108:             if [ ! -f "${LOCAL_PATH}/sccache" ]; then
109:               DOWNLOAD_SCCACHE=1
110:             else
111:               LOCAL_VERSION=$("${LOCAL_PATH}/sccache" --version | cut -d" " -f2)
112: 
113:               if [ "${LOCAL_VERSION}" != "${SCCACHE_VERSION}" ]; then
114:                 DOWNLOAD_SCCACHE=1
115:               fi
116:             fi
117: 
118:             if [ "${DOWNLOAD_SCCACHE}" == "1" ]; then
119:               sudo curl --retry 3 --retry-all-errors "https://s3.amazonaws.com/ossci-macos/sccache/sccache-v0.4.1-${RUNNER_ARCH}" --output "${LOCAL_PATH}/sccache"
120:               sudo chmod +x "${LOCAL_PATH}/sccache"
121:             fi
122: 
123:             if [[ "${SCCACHE_USE_GHA}" == "true" ]]; then
124:               echo "ACTIONS_CACHE_URL=${ACTIONS_CACHE_URL}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
125:               echo "ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN=${ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
126:               echo "SCCACHE_GHA_ENABLED=on" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
127:             else
128:               # The runner has access to the S3 bucket via IAM profile without the need
129:               # for any credential
130:               echo "SCCACHE_BUCKET=ossci-compiler-cache-circleci-v2" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
131:               echo "SCCACHE_S3_KEY_PREFIX=${GITHUB_WORKFLOW}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
132:             fi
133: 
134:             # This is needed so that later build script could find sccache (which sccache)
135:             echo "${LOCAL_PATH}" >> $GITHUB_PATH
136: 
137:       - name: Get workflow job id
138:         id: get-job-id
139:         uses: ./.github/actions/get-workflow-job-id
140:         if: always()
141:         with:
142:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
143: 
144:       # Apply the filter logic to the build step too if the test-config label is already there
145:       - name: Select all requested test configurations (if the test matrix is available)
146:         id: filter
147:         uses: ./.github/actions/filter-test-configs
148:         with:
149:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
150:           test-matrix: ${{ inputs.test-matrix }}
151:           job-name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
152: 
153:       - name: Build
154:         if: steps.filter.outputs.is-test-matrix-empty == 'False' || inputs.test-matrix == ''
155:         id: build
156:         env:
157:           OUR_GITHUB_JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
158:         run: |
159:           # TODO: Remove me later, and properly activate venv
160:           PATH="$VENV_PATH/bin:$PATH"
161:           export PATH
162: 
163:           # NB: Same trick as Linux, there is no need to initialize sccache with the risk of getting
164:           # it hangs or timeout at initialization. The cache will be started automatically
165:           export SKIP_SCCACHE_INITIALIZATION=1
166:           .ci/pytorch/macos-build.sh
167: 
168:       - name: Archive artifacts into zip
169:         if: inputs.build-generates-artifacts && steps.build.outcome != 'skipped'
170:         run: |
171:           zip -1 -r artifacts.zip dist/ build/.ninja_log build/compile_commands.json .additional_ci_files
172: 
173:       - name: Store PyTorch Build Artifacts on GHA
174:         uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
175:         if: inputs.build-generates-artifacts && steps.build.outcome != 'skipped'
176:         with:
177:           name: ${{ env.BUILD_ENVIRONMENT }}
178:           retention-days: 14
179:           if-no-files-found: error
180:           path: artifacts.zip
181: 
182:       - name: Upload sccache stats to GHA
183:         uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
184:         # Only if sccache is installed, see above
185:         if: ${{ (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository) && steps.build.outcome != 'skipped' }}
186:         with:
187:           name: sccache-stats-${{ inputs.build-environment }}-runattempt${{ github.run_attempt }}-${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
188:           retention-days: 14
189:           if-no-files-found: warn
190:           path: sccache-stats-*.json
191: 
192:       - name: Clean up disk space
193:         if: always()
194:         continue-on-error: true
195:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/check-disk-space@main
196: ","url":"https://sourcegraph.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/pytorch--863edc78@76b8fdafad537579cd97b5ec2502c6ac3bc473e0/-/blob/.github/workflows/_mac-build.yml"}

{"content":"1: name: mac-test
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_call:
5:     inputs:
6:       build-environment:
7:         required: true
8:         type: string
9:         description: Top-level label for what's being built/tested.
10:       test-matrix:
11:         required: true
12:         type: string
13:         description: JSON description of what test configs to run.
14:       sync-tag:
15:         required: false
16:         type: string
17:         default: ""
18:         description: |
19:           If this is set, our linter will use this to make sure that every other
20:           job with the same `sync-tag` is identical.
21:       python-version:
22:         required: false
23:         type: string
24:         default: "3.12"
25:         description: |
26:           The python version to be used. Will be 3.9 by default
27:       timeout-minutes:
28:         required: false
29:         type: number
30:         default: 270
31:         description: |
32:           Set the maximum (in minutes) how long the workflow should take to finish
33:       disable-monitor:
34:         description: |
35:           [Experimental] Disable utilization monitoring for tests.
36:           Currently, by default we disable the monitor job and only look for specific tests,
37:           since we are investigating the behaviour of the monitor script with different tests.
38:         required: false
39:         type: boolean
40:         default: true
41:       monitor-log-interval:
42:         description: |
43:           Set the interval for the monitor script to log utilization.
44:         required: false
45:         type: number
46:         default: 5
47:       monitor-data-collect-interval:
48:         description: |
49:           Set the interval for the monitor script to collect data.
50:         required: false
51:         type: number
52:         default: 1
53:     secrets:
54:       HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN:
55:         required: false
56:         description: |
57:           HF Auth token to avoid rate limits when downloading models or datasets from hub
58: 
59: jobs:
60:   test:
61:     # Don't run on forked repos or empty test matrix
62:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch' && toJSON(fromJSON(inputs.test-matrix).include) != '[]'
63:     defaults:
64:       run:
65:         shell: bash -e -l {0}
66:     strategy:
67:       matrix: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.test-matrix) }}
68:       fail-fast: false
69:     runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
70:     timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check == 'mem_leak_check' && 600 || inputs.timeout-minutes }}
71:     env:
72:       GIT_DEFAULT_BRANCH: ${{ github.event.repository.default_branch }}
73:       BUILD_ENVIRONMENT: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
74:       TEST_CONFIG: ${{ matrix.config }}
75:       SHARD_NUMBER: ${{ matrix.shard }}
76:       NUM_TEST_SHARDS: ${{ matrix.num_shards }}
77:       PR_BODY: ${{ github.event.pull_request.body }}
78:     steps:
79:       - name: Print runner OS/HW info
80:         run: |
81:           sysctl machdep.cpu.brand_string kern.osproductversion
82: 
83:       - name: Clean up leftover processes on MacOS pet runner
84:         continue-on-error: true
85:         run: |
86:           for PROCESS in "python" "conda" "ninja" "clang"; do
87:             echo "Cleaning up all remaining ${PROCESS} process"
88:             pkill "${PROCESS}" || true
89:           done
90: 
91:       - name: Clean up brew miniconda, if installed
92:         continue-on-error: true
93:         run: |
94:           if brew list miniconda; then
95:             brew uninstall miniconda
96:             echo "REINSTALL_BREW_MINICONDA=1" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
97:           fi
98: 
99:       - name: Clean up leftover local python3 site-packages on MacOS pet runner
100:         continue-on-error: true
101:         run: |
102:           for dir in  ~/.local/lib/python3.*/site-packages; do
103:             echo "Cleaning up ${dir}"
104:             rm -rf "${dir}"
105:           done
106: 
107:       - name: Clean up disk space before running MacOS workflow
108:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/check-disk-space@main
109: 
110:       # [see note: pytorch repo ref]
111:       - name: Checkout PyTorch
112:         uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/actions/checkout-pytorch@main
113: 
114:       - name: Get workflow job id
115:         id: get-job-id
116:         uses: ./.github/actions/get-workflow-job-id
117:         if: always()
118:         with:
119:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
120: 
121:       - name: Setup Python
122:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-python@main
123:         with:
124:           python-version: ${{ inputs.python-version }}
125:           pip-requirements-file: .ci/docker/requirements-ci.txt
126: 
127:       - name: Start monitoring script
128:         id: monitor-script
129:         if: ${{ !inputs.disable-monitor }}
130:         continue-on-error: true
131:         env:
132:           JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
133:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
134:           WORKFLOW_NAME: ${{ github.workflow }}
135:           WORKFLOW_RUN_ID: ${{github.run_id}}
136:           MONITOR_LOG_INTERVAL: ${{ inputs.monitor-log-interval }}
137:           MONITOR_DATA_COLLECT_INTERVAL: ${{ inputs.monitor-data-collect-interval }}
138:         run: |
139:           "$VENV_PATH/bin/python3" -m pip install psutil==5.9.8 dataclasses_json==0.6.7
140:           "$VENV_PATH/bin/python3" -m tools.stats.monitor --log-interval "$MONITOR_LOG_INTERVAL" --data-collect-interval "$MONITOR_DATA_COLLECT_INTERVAL" > usage_log.txt 2>&1 &
141:           echo "monitor-script-pid=${!}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
142: 
143:       - name: Download build artifacts
144:         uses: ./.github/actions/download-build-artifacts
145:         with:
146:           name: ${{ inputs.build-environment }}
147:           use-gha: true
148: 
149:       - name: Download TD artifacts
150:         continue-on-error: true
151:         uses: ./.github/actions/download-td-artifacts
152:         with:
153:           use-gha: true
154: 
155:       - name: Parse ref
156:         id: parse-ref
157:         run: .github/scripts/parse_ref.py
158: 
159:       - name: Check for keep-going label and re-enabled test issues
160:         # This uses the filter-test-configs action because it conveniently
161:         # checks for labels and re-enabled test issues.  It does not actually do
162:         # any filtering.  All filtering is done in the build step.
163:         id: keep-going
164:         uses: ./.github/actions/filter-test-configs
165:         with:
166:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
167:           test-matrix: ${{ inputs.test-matrix }}
168:           job-name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
169: 
170:       - name: Set Test step time
171:         id: test-timeout
172:         shell: bash
173:         env:
174:           JOB_TIMEOUT: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check == 'mem_leak_check' && 600 || inputs.timeout-minutes }}
175:         run: |
176:           echo "timeout=$((JOB_TIMEOUT-30))" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
177: 
178:       - name: Test
179:         id: test
180:         timeout-minutes: ${{ fromJson(steps.test-timeout.outputs.timeout) }}
181:         env:
182:           PYTORCH_TEST_CUDA_MEM_LEAK_CHECK: ${{ matrix.mem_leak_check && '1' || '0' }}
183:           PYTORCH_TEST_RERUN_DISABLED_TESTS: ${{ matrix.rerun_disabled_tests && '1' || '0' }}
184:           CONTINUE_THROUGH_ERROR: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.keep-going }}
185:           VERBOSE_TEST_LOGS: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-verbose-test-logs }}
186:           TEST_SHOWLOCALS: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-test-showlocals }}
187:           NO_TEST_TIMEOUT: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-no-test-timeout }}
188:           NO_TD: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.ci-no-td }}
189:           PIP_REQUIREMENTS_FILE: .github/requirements/pip-requirements-${{ runner.os }}.txt
190:           GITHUB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
191:           GITHUB_WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}
192:           GITHUB_JOB: ${{ github.job }}
193:           GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
194:           GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER: ${{ github.run_number }}
195:           GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
196:           JOB_ID: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
197:           JOB_NAME: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
198:           REENABLED_ISSUES: ${{ steps.keep-going.outputs.reenabled-issues }}
199:           HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HUGGING_FACE_HUB_TOKEN }}
200:         run: |
201:           # shellcheck disable=SC1090
202:           set -ex
203: 
204:           # TODO: Remove me later, and properly activate venv
205:           PATH="$VENV_PATH/bin:$PATH"
206:           export PATH
207: 
208:           # Print out some information about the test environment
209:           for tool in python3 python; do
210:             which $tool
211:             $tool --version
212:           done
213: 
214:           python3 -mpip install --no-index --no-deps dist/*.whl
215: 
216:           set +e
217:           pushd "${RUNNER_TEMP}"
218:           # Install pip dependencies if they are not found. This is to mitigate a peculiar
219:           # flaky missing dependencies on MacOS
220:           python3 -c "import torch"
221:           RC=$?
222:           popd
223: 
224:           if [ "${RC}" -ne 0 ]; then
225:             python3 -mpip install --ignore-installed -r "${PIP_REQUIREMENTS_FILE}"
226:           fi
227:           set -e
228: 
229:           .ci/pytorch/macos-test.sh
230: 
231:       - name: Print remaining test logs
232:         shell: bash
233:         if: always() && steps.test.conclusion
234:         run: |
235:           cat test/**/*_toprint.log || true
236: 
237:       - name: Run OP benchmark
238:         shell: bash
239:         if: ${{ contains(steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name, 'mps') }}
240:         run: |
241:           python3 test/bench_mps_ops.py
242: 
243: 
244:       - name: Stop monitoring script
245:         if: ${{ always() && steps.monitor-script.outputs.monitor-script-pid }}
246:         continue-on-error: true
247:         env:
248:           MONITOR_SCRIPT_PID: ${{ steps.monitor-script.outputs.monitor-script-pid }}
249:         run: |
250:           kill "$MONITOR_SCRIPT_PID"
251: 
252:       - name: Upload test artifacts
253:         uses: ./.github/actions/upload-test-artifacts
254:         if: always() && steps.test.conclusion && steps.test.conclusion != 'skipped'
255:         with:
256:           use-gha: true
257:           file-suffix: ${{ github.job }}-${{ matrix.config }}-${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ matrix.num_shards }}-${{ matrix.runner }}_${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
258: 
259:       - name: Upload the benchmark results
260:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/upload-benchmark-results@main
261:         with:
262:           benchmark-results-dir: test/test-reports
263:           dry-run: false
264:           schema-version: v3
265:           github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
266: 
267:       - name: Upload utilization stats
268:         if: ${{ always() && steps.test.conclusion && steps.test.conclusion != 'skipped' && !inputs.disable-monitor }}
269:         continue-on-error: true
270:         uses: ./.github/actions/upload-utilization-stats
271:         with:
272:           job_id: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-id }}
273:           job_name: ${{ steps.get-job-id.outputs.job-name }}
274:           workflow_name: ${{ github.workflow }}
275:           workflow_run_id: ${{github.run_id}}
276:           workflow_attempt: ${{github.run_attempt}}
277:           local_path: usage_log.txt
278: 
279:       - name: Reinstall brew miniconda, if was installed
280:         if: always()
281:         continue-on-error: true
282:         run: |
283:           if [[ -n "$REINSTALL_BREW_MINICONDA" ]]; then
284:               brew install --cask miniconda
285:           fi
286: 
287:       - name: Clean up disk space
288:         if: always()
289:         continue-on-error: true
290:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/check-disk-space@main

import json, re, os

def strip_ln(content):
    lines = content.split('\n')
    out = []
    for line in lines:
        m = re.match(r'^\d+: (.*)$', line)
        if m:
            out.append(m.group(1))
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^\d+:$', line.rstrip('\r'))
        if m:
            out.append('')
            continue
        out.append(line)
    while out and out[-1] == '':
        out.pop()
    return '\n'.join(out) + '\n'

# Read the JSONL session file to find sg_read_file results
jsonl_path = '/logs/agent/sessions/projects/-workspace/320af8c1-2dd1-41cc-aa19-d3a83cbfd0b2.jsonl'
with open(jsonl_path) as f:
    lines = f.readlines()

print(f"Total JSONL lines: {len(lines)}")
# Look at last few entries for sg_read_file results
results = []
for line in lines[-100:]:
    try:
        entry = json.loads(line)
        if entry.get('type') == 'tool_result':
            content = entry.get('content', '')
            if 'content' in content[:100] if isinstance(content, str) else False:
                results.append(entry)
    except:
        pass
print(f"Found {len(results)} tool results in last 100 lines")

python3 << 'PYEOF'
import json, re, os

jsonl_path = '/logs/agent/sessions/projects/-workspace/320af8c1-2dd1-41cc-aa19-d3a83cbfd0b2.jsonl'
with open(jsonl_path) as f:
    raw = f.read()

def strip_ln(content):
    ls = content.split('\n')
    out = []
    for line in ls:
        m = re.match(r'^\d+: (.*)$', line)
        if m:
            out.append(m.group(1))
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^\d+:$', line.rstrip('\r'))
        if m:
            out.append('')
            continue
        out.append(line)
    while out and out[-1] == '':
        out.pop()
    return '\n'.join(out) + '\n'

# Find all sg_read_file response blocks
# Pattern: {"content":"1: ...", "url": "..."}
# Search for all JSON objects that have both "content" and "url" fields

# Use regex to find all occurrences
pattern = r'\{"content":"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)","url":"([^"]*)"\}'
matches = re.findall(pattern, raw)
print(f"Found {len(matches)} sg_read_file responses")

written = 0
for content_escaped, url in matches:
    # Unescape the content
    content = content_escaped.replace('\\n', '\n').replace('\\"', '"').replace('\\\\', '\\')
    
    # Extract filename from URL
    if '.github/workflows/' in url:
        fname = url.split('.github/workflows/')[-1]
        outpath = f'/workspace/.github/workflows/{fname}'
    elif '.github/templates/' in url:
        fname = url.split('.github/templates/')[-1]
        outpath = f'/workspace/.github/templates/{fname}'
    elif '.github/scripts/' in url:
        fname = url.split('.github/scripts/')[-1]
        outpath = f'/workspace/.github/scripts/{fname}'
    elif '.github/ci_commit_pins/' in url:
        fname = url.split('.github/ci_commit_pins/')[-1]
        outpath = f'/workspace/.github/ci_commit_pins/{fname}'
    elif '.ci/pytorch/' in url:
        fname = url.split('.ci/pytorch/')[-1]
        outpath = f'/workspace/.ci/pytorch/{fname}'
    elif 'tools/stats/' in url:
        fname = url.split('tools/stats/')[-1]
        outpath = f'/workspace/tools/stats/{fname}'
    else:
        print(f"Unknown path: {url}")
        continue
    
    # Check if already exists
    if os.path.exists(outpath):
        print(f"Already exists: {outpath}")
        continue
    
    # Process content (strip line numbers)
    processed = strip_ln(content)
    
    # Write file
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(outpath), exist_ok=True)
    with open(outpath, 'w') as f:
        f.write(processed)
    print(f"Written: {outpath} ({len(processed)} bytes)")
    written += 1

print(f"\nTotal written: {written}")
PYEOF

        continue

26:     continue-on-error: true
27:     needs: get-label-type
28:     steps:
29:       - name: Clone PyTorch
30:         uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
31:         with:
32:           repository: pytorch/pytorch
33:           fetch-depth: 0
34:           path: pytorch
35: 
36:       - name: Setup Linux
37:         uses: ./pytorch/.github/actions/setup-linux
38: 
39:       - name: Clone CodeLlama
40:         uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
41:         with:
42:           repository: osalpekar/codellama
43:           ref: main
44:           path: codellama
45: 
46:       - name: Clone Target Determination Code
47:         uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
48:         with:
49:           repository: osalpekar/llm-target-determinator
50:           ref: v0.0.2
51:           path: llm-target-determinator
52: 
53:       - name: Install requirements
54:         shell: bash
55:         run: |
56:           set -euxo pipefail
57:           python3 -m pip install -r llm-target-determinator/requirements.txt
58:           cd "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/codellama"
59:           python3 -m pip install -e .
60: 
61:       - name: Fetch CodeLlama Checkpoint
62:         shell: bash
63:         run: |
64:           set -euxo pipefail
65:           cd "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/codellama"
66:           mkdir "CodeLlama-7b-Python"
67:           aws s3 cp "s3://target-determinator-assets/CodeLlama-7b-Python" "CodeLlama-7b-Python" --recursive --no-progress
68: 
69:       - name: Fetch indexes
70:         uses: nick-fields/retry@7152eba30c6575329ac0576536151aca5a72780e # v3.0.0
71:         with:
72:           max_attempts: 3
73:           retry_wait_seconds: 10
74:           timeout_minutes: 5
75:           shell: bash
76:           command: |
77:             set -euxo pipefail
78:             python3 -m pip install awscli==1.29.40
79:             cd "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}"/llm-target-determinator/assets
80:             aws s3 cp "s3://target-determinator-assets/indexes/latest" . --recursive
81: 
82:             unzip -o indexer-files\*.zip
83:             rm indexer-files*.zip
84: 
85:       - name: Run Retriever
86:         id: run_retriever
87:         continue-on-error: true  # ghstack not currently supported due to problems getting git diff
88:         shell: bash
89:         run: |
90:           set -euxo pipefail
91:           cd "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}"/llm-target-determinator
92:           export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
93:           torchrun \
94:             --standalone \
95:             --nnodes=1 \
96:             --nproc-per-node=1 \
97:             retriever.py \
98:             --experiment-name indexer-files \
99:             --pr-parse-format GITDIFF
100:           cd assets
101:           zip -r mappings.zip mappings
102: 
103:       - name: Upload results to s3
104:         uses: seemethere/upload-artifact-s3@baba72d0712b404f646cebe0730933554ebce96a # v5.1.0
105:         if: ${{ steps.run_retriever.outcome == 'success' }}
106:         with:
107:           name: llm_results
108:           retention-days: 14
109:           if-no-files-found: warn
110:           path: llm-target-determinator/assets/mappings.zip
111:         env:
112:           AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ""
113:           AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ""
114:           AWS_SESSION_TOKEN: ""
115:           AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: ""
116:           AWS_REGION: ""
117: 
118:       - name: Teardown Linux
119:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/teardown-linux@main
120:         if: always()

{"content":"1: name: Index PyTorch Tests for Target Determination
2: 
3: on:
4:   workflow_dispatch:
5:   schedule:
6:     - cron: '0 0 * * *'
7: 
8: permissions:
9:   id-token: write
10:   contents: read
11: 
12: jobs:
13:   get-label-type:
14:     if: github.repository_owner == 'pytorch'
15:     name: get-label-type
16:     uses: pytorch/pytorch/.github/workflows/_runner-determinator.yml@main
17:     with:
18:       triggering_actor: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
19:       issue_owner: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login || github.event.issue.user.login }}
20:       curr_branch: ${{ github.head_ref || github.ref_name }}
21:       curr_ref_type: ${{ github.ref_type }}
22: 
23:   index:
24:     needs: get-label-type
25:     runs-on: "${{ needs.get-label-type.outputs.label-type }}linux.g5.4xlarge.nvidia.gpu" # 1 GPU A10G 24GB each
26:     environment: target-determinator-env
27:     steps:
28:       - name: Clone PyTorch
29:         uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
30:         with:
31:           path: pytorch
32: 
33:       - name: Setup Linux
34:         uses: ./pytorch/.github/actions/setup-linux
35: 
36:       - name: Calculate docker image
37:         id: calculate-docker-image
38:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/calculate-docker-image@main
39:         with:
40:           docker-image-name: ci-image:pytorch-linux-jammy-cuda12.8-cudnn9-py3-gcc11
41:           working-directory: pytorch
42: 
43:       - name: Use following to pull public copy of the image
44:         id: print-ghcr-mirror
45:         env:
46:           ECR_DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
47:         shell: bash
48:         run: |
49:           tag=${ECR_DOCKER_IMAGE##*:}
50:           echo "docker pull ghcr.io/pytorch/ci-image:${tag/:/-}"
51: 
52:       - name: Pull docker image
53:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/pull-docker-image@main
54:         with:
55:           docker-image: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
56: 
57:       - name: Install nvidia driver, nvidia-docker runtime, set GPU_FLAG
58:         id: install-nvidia-driver
59:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/setup-nvidia@main
60: 
61:       - name: Clone CodeLlama
62:         uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
63:         with:
64:           repository: osalpekar/codellama
65:           ref: 1ec50e0cfc0fadc3b6ceb146617e2119ab26eb34
66:           path: codellama
67: 
68:       - name: Clone Target Determination Code
69:         uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
70:         with:
71:           repository: osalpekar/llm-target-determinator
72:           ref: v0.0.2
73:           path: llm-target-determinator
74: 
75:       - name: Configure AWS credentials
76:         uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@ececac1a45f3b08a01d2dd070d28d111c5fe6722 # v4.1.0
77:         with:
78:           role-to-assume: arn:aws:iam::308535385114:role/gha_target_determinator_s3_read_write
79:           aws-region: us-east-1
80: 
81:       - name: Download checkpoint
82:         shell: bash
83:         env:
84:           AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1
85:         run: |
86:           # Do this outside of docker so I don't have to put env vars in
87:           pip3 install awscli==1.29.40
88:           cd codellama
89:           mkdir "CodeLlama-7b-Python"
90:           aws s3 cp \
91:             "s3://target-determinator-assets/CodeLlama-7b-Python" \
92:             "CodeLlama-7b-Python" \
93:             --recursive
94: 
95:       - name: Run indexer
96:         shell: bash -l {0}
97:         env:
98:           DOCKER_IMAGE: ${{ steps.calculate-docker-image.outputs.docker-image }}
99:           GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
100:           AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1
101:         run: |
102:           # detached container should get cleaned up by teardown_ec2_linux
103:           # Disable shellcheck warning for GPU_FLAG
104:           # shellcheck disable=SC2086
105:           container_name=$(docker run \
106:             ${GPU_FLAG:-} \
107:             -e MAX_JOBS="$(nproc --ignore=2)" \
108:             -e AWS_DEFAULT_REGION \
109:             --env-file="/tmp/github_env_${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" \
110:             --security-opt seccomp=unconfined \
111:             --cap-add=SYS_PTRACE \
112:             --tty \
113:             --detach \
114:             --user jenkins \
115:             -v "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}:/var/lib/jenkins/workspace" \
116:             -w /var/lib/jenkins/workspace \
117:             "${DOCKER_IMAGE}"
118:           )
119:           chmod +x pytorch/.github/scripts/td_llm_indexer.sh
120:           docker exec -t "${container_name}" sh -c 'pytorch/.github/scripts/td_llm_indexer.sh'
121: 
122:       - name: Upload to s3
123:         shell: bash -l {0}
124:         env:
125:           AWS_DEFAULT_REGION: us-east-1
126:         run: |
127:           cd llm-target-determinator/assets
128: 
129:           TIMESTAMP=$(date -Iseconds)
130:           ZIP_NAME="indexer-files-${TIMESTAMP}.zip"
131: 
132:           # Create a zipfile with all the generated indices
133:           zip -r "${ZIP_NAME}" indexer-files
134: 
135:           # Note that because the below 2 operations are not atomic, there will
136:           # be a period of a few seconds between these where there is no index
137:           # present in the latest/ folder. To account for this, the retriever
138:           # should have some retry logic with backoff to ensure fetching the
139:           # index doesn't fail.
140:           # Move the old index into the archived/ folder
141:           aws s3 mv \
142:             "s3://target-determinator-assets/indexes/latest" \
143:             "s3://target-determinator-assets/indexes/archived" \
144:             --recursive
145: 
146:           # Move the new index into the latestl/ folder
147:           aws s3 cp \
148:             "${ZIP_NAME}" \
149:             "s3://target-determinator-assets/indexes/latest/${ZIP_NAME}"
150: 
151:       - name: Teardown Linux
152:         uses: pytorch/test-infra/.github/actions/teardown-linux@main
153:         if: always()
154: 
155: concurrency:

    lines = content.split('\n')
    out = []
    for line in lines:
        m = re.match(r'^\d+: (.*)', line)
        if m:
            out.append(m.group(1))
            continue
        m = re.match(r'^\d+:$', line.rstrip('\r'))
        if m:
            out.append('')
            continue
        out.append(line)
    while out and out[-1] == '':
        out.pop()
    return '\n'.join(out) + '\n'

jsonl_path = '/logs/agent/sessions/projects/-workspace/320af8c1-2dd1-41cc-aa19-d3a83cbfd0b2.jsonl'
with open(jsonl_path) as f:
    raw = f.read()

pattern = r'\{"content":"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*?)","url":"(https://sourcegraph[^"]*?)"\}'
matches = re.findall(pattern, raw)
print(f"Total matches: {len(matches)}")

written = 0
skipped_url = 0
skipped_exists = 0
errors = 0

base_path = '/workspace'

for content_escaped, url in matches:
    # Skip URL-encoded (line range) fetches
    if '%3F' in url or '?L' in url:
        skipped_url += 1
        continue
    
    # Extract file path from URL
    # URL pattern: https://sourcegraph.sourcegraph.com/github.com/sg-evals/pytorch--863edc78@HASH/-/blob/PATH
    m = re.search(r'/-/blob/(.+)$', url)
    if not m:
        continue
    
    rel_path = m.group(1)
    out_path = os.path.join(base_path, rel_path)
    
    if os.path.exists(out_path):
        skipped_exists += 1
        continue
    
    # Decode content
    try:
        content = content_escaped.replace('\\n', '\n').replace('\\"', '"').replace('\\\\', '\\').replace('\\t', '\t').replace('\\r', '\r')
        processed = strip_ln(content)
        
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(out_path), exist_ok=True)
        with open(out_path, 'w') as f:
            f.write(processed)
        written += 1
        print(f"  Wrote: {rel_path}")
    except Exception as e:
        errors += 1
        print(f"  ERROR for {rel_path}: {e}")
